APIKey.description: A credential used to authenticate API requests.

created_by.description: The API key or user that created this key. An API key creator can belong to another mode, such as a live key that creates a sandbox key. Absent when the creator is unavailable.

revoked_at.description: When this key was revoked, in RFC 3339 format. Present only for revoked keys. For keys revoked before revocation timestamps were recorded, this is the last update time.

status.description: Current key status. A non-revoked key is expired when expires_at is at or before the current time; otherwise it is active. Revoked keys remain revoked regardless of expires_at.
x-enum-descriptions: The key has not been revoked and has no expiration time or expires in the future.
The key has not been revoked, but expires_at is at or before the current time and the key cannot authenticate requests.
The key was revoked and cannot authenticate requests, regardless of expires_at.

secret_key.description: One-time secret returned only when the API key is created.

APIKeyWithSecret.description: An API key including its `secret_key`, returned by the calls that create or issue a key.

APIRequestLog.description: A record of an API request and its response.

caller.description: The public resource that made this request. Absent when Flint cannot attribute the request.

client_request_id.description: The caller's X-Request-Id, matched exactly and case-sensitively. Absent when the caller sent none.

client_trace_id.description: The trace ID from a valid W3C traceparent, for correlation with the caller's tracing. Flint starts its own trace. Absent when no valid traceparent was sent.

error_summary.description: A concise explanation of why the request failed.

error_type.description: The error envelope's `type` for this response.

expand.description: Normalized expand paths Flint applied. Absent when the request did not use expand.

recommended_action.description: The next step to resolve this failure.

reference_url.description: A Flint guide that explains this failure. Absent when no guide applies.

request_id.description: Records created before server-minted request IDs keep their original ID.

retry.description: How to recover: same_request resends the identical request with the same Idempotency-Key; after_refresh re-reads the resource and rebuilds the request with a new key; none requires correcting the request or following next_steps or next_actions.
x-enum-descriptions: Resend the identical request with the same Idempotency-Key after Retry-After when present, otherwise with exponential backoff and jitter.
Read the resource again, rebuild the request from its current state, and use a new Idempotency-Key.
Do not retry automatically. Correct the request or follow next_steps or next_actions.

APIRequestLogDetail.description: Full detail for one logged API request visible to the calling credential: headers, bodies, error summary, and how to reproduce it.

caller.description: The public resource that made this request. Absent when Flint cannot attribute the request.

client_request_id.description: The caller's X-Request-Id, matched exactly and case-sensitively. Absent when the caller sent none.

client_trace_id.description: The trace ID from a valid W3C traceparent, for correlation with the caller's tracing. Flint starts its own trace. Absent when no valid traceparent was sent.

error_summary.description: A concise explanation of why the request failed.

error_type.description: The error envelope's `type` for this response.

expand.description: Normalized expand paths Flint applied. Absent when the request did not use expand.

ip_address.description: The integration caller's IP address. Absent for buyer-side callers.

recommended_action.description: The next step to resolve this failure.

reference_url.description: A Flint guide that explains this failure. Absent when no guide applies.

request_body.description: The captured body. A JSON object or array body is returned as redacted JSON. Any other body, or a body Flint truncated or could not parse, is returned as a string. Absent when there was no body or the route does not capture bodies.

request_headers.description: Request headers as received, keyed by header name. Sensitive values read [REDACTED].

request_id.description: Records created before server-minted request IDs keep their original ID.

response_body.description: The captured body. A JSON object or array body is returned as redacted JSON. Any other body, or a body Flint truncated or could not parse, is returned as a string. Absent when there was no body or the route does not capture bodies.

retry.description: How to recover: same_request resends the identical request with the same Idempotency-Key; after_refresh re-reads the resource and rebuilds the request with a new key; none requires correcting the request or following next_steps or next_actions.
x-enum-descriptions: Resend the identical request with the same Idempotency-Key after Retry-After when present, otherwise with exponential backoff and jitter.
Read the resource again, rebuild the request from its current state, and use a new Idempotency-Key.
Do not retry automatically. Correct the request or follow next_steps or next_actions.

user_agent.description: The integration caller's user agent. Absent for buyer-side callers.

APIRequestLogQueryParam.description: A query string parameter from a logged API request, as a name and value.

APIRequestLogReproduction.description: A reproduction of the captured request. Replaying a non-GET request changes data. Replay with a sandbox key.

body.description: The captured request body to resend. A JSON object or array body is returned as redacted JSON. Any other body, or a body Flint truncated or could not parse, is returned as a string. Absent when there was no body or the route does not capture bodies.

curl.description: A curl command using the recorded served_api_version in Flint-Version when available. Replace credential and body placeholders before running it.

headers.description: Headers for reproducing the request. Flint-Version uses the served_api_version recorded in the log when available.

AccessLink.description: A link that opens an order, subscription, Return, or customer's account in the merchant's Flint-hosted customer account. Its purpose describes whether it signs the buyer in and how long it works. Its url is a bearer credential, returned only when the link is created.

expires_at.description: When the link stops opening the resource or signing the buyer in.

purpose.description: What the link opens and how long it works. New purposes may be added; treat one you don't recognize as opening its resource.
x-enum-descriptions: Opens an order and lets the buyer have its receipt sent again. Works for 30 days or 10 opens.
Opens a subscription without letting the buyer change it. Works for 14 days or 5 opens.
Opens one subscription and lets the buyer cancel, pause, or undo a scheduled cancellation, subject to store policy and subscription state. Works for 14 days or 5 opens.
Opens a Return and its order. Works for 30 days or 10 opens.
Signs the buyer in to your Flint-hosted customer account as this customer. Works for 15 minutes and one open.

url.description: The link to send the buyer. It carries a bearer credential, so anyone with it can open the resource or sign in as the customer, as its purpose describes, until expires_at or until it reaches its open limit. The link uses the merchant's customer account host.

AddLineItemsRequest.description: The request body for: Add line items.

expected_version.description: Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.

AddOrderChargeRequest.description: The request body for: Add order charge.

expected_version.description: Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.

AddReturnLineItemRequest.description: The request body for: Add return line item.

AddRiskListItemsRequest.description: Values to add to the risk list. Values are trimmed and compared exactly after item-type normalization for deduplication and membership. card_fingerprint is the 32-character hexadecimal value from PaymentMethod.fingerprint and is lowercased; case_sensitive_string preserves case and Unicode composition. string and email are lowercased, with accents preserved. email requires a bare address. email_domain is lowercased, has one final dot removed, and converts internationalized domains to ASCII. ip_address uses canonical IP form, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 conversion to IPv4. country uses uppercase ISO codes. card_bin preserves 6 through 8 digits, including leading zeros, and matches the full value. customer_id preserves the validated ID.

values.description: Values to add to the risk list, in request order. Values are trimmed and compared exactly after item-type normalization for deduplication and membership. card_fingerprint is the 32-character hexadecimal value from PaymentMethod.fingerprint and is lowercased; case_sensitive_string preserves case and Unicode composition. string and email are lowercased, with accents preserved. email requires a bare address. email_domain is lowercased, has one final dot removed, and converts internationalized domains to ASCII. ip_address uses canonical IP form, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 conversion to IPv4. country uses uppercase ISO codes. card_bin preserves 6 through 8 digits, including leading zeros, and matches the full value. customer_id preserves the validated ID.

items.description: Limited to 512 characters (Unicode code points) before normalization and after normalization.

AddRiskListItemsResult.description: Risk list item additions, one per request value in request order. Repeated values report existing after their first entry.

Address.description: A postal address, as returned on customers, invoices, tax locations, and fulfillment recipients.

city.description: City or locality of the address.

line1.description: Street address, including the building number.

line2.description: Apartment, suite, floor, or other address details.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the address.

state.description: State, province, or region of the address.

AddressInput.description: A postal address you supply when creating or updating a customer, invoice, fulfillment, or delivery selection. Send null for `line2` to clear it.

AdjustGiftCardBalanceRequest.description: The request body for: Adjust gift card value.

amount_money.description: Nonzero USD amount to change the card's value by: positive adds value and negative removes it.

expected_version.description: The gift card version last read. The command changes this card only when its current version matches.

reason.description: Why you're adjusting the value. A negative amount_money takes suspicious_activity, balance_accidentally_increased, or support_issue; a positive one takes complimentary, balance_accidentally_decreased, or support_issue.

AdjustGiftCardBalanceResult.description: The result of adjusting a gift card's value: the updated gift card, the transactions the adjustment created, and a gift card load when one was made.

AnalyticsOverview.description: Payments are selected by payment created_at and current succeeded status. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

currencies.description: Currencies of succeeded payments selected by payment created_at or counted refunds selected by refund created_at in the period, regardless of the currency filter. Empty when neither has rows. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for amounts and payment counts. Defaults to the merchant's default currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

gross_volume_money.description: Sum of succeeded payment amounts selected by payment created_at in the period, in currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

new_customers_count.description: Customers selected by customer created_at in the period, across all currencies. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

payments_count.description: Succeeded payments selected by payment created_at in the period, restricted to currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

period_end_at.description: Exclusive resolved end instant. Omitted or future request ends resolve to the request time truncated to the second. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

period_start_at.description: Inclusive start instant. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

refunded_money.description: Refund amounts selected by refund created_at in the period, excluding failed and canceled refunds. Parent refunds with child executions count through the children once, regardless of payment creation time. Uses currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

ApplyDiscountRequest.description: The request body for: Apply discount.

expected_version.description: Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.

ApplyOrderGiftCardRequest.description: The request body for: Apply a gift card to an order.

expected_version.description: Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.

AssessInvoiceLateFeeRequest.description: The request body for: Assess an invoice late fee.

AssignToUnconfiguredDeliveryProfileReque.description: The request body for: Assign unconfigured catalog entries.

expected_version.description: Current version of the delivery profile.

Balance.description: Current balances for one currency at observed_at. Available and pending amounts are separate buckets and can be negative. Reserve and held amounts are excluded from available_money.

available_by_source_type.description: Signed available amounts grouped by balance source type. Keys are an open set; US accounts use card and bank_account. When supplied as a complete breakdown, entries sum to available_money. Active payout holds reduce both available_money and one source entry by the same amount. A payout with no recorded source type uses card. A hold whose source is absent from the map uses the largest source amount, with ties broken by source name.

available_money.description: Signed amount available for payouts after active payout holds are deducted. Separate from pending_money, reserve_money, and held_money.

balance_id.description: Stable identifier of this currency's balance.

held_money.description: Funds set aside for payouts you created that haven't been debited from your balance yet. They aren't payable and aren't included in `available_money`.

observed_at.description: When Flint observed these amounts, as an RFC 3339 UTC instant at second precision. Stored balances retain their observation time; a fresh provider read uses the time of that read.

payouts_enabled.description: Whether your account can receive payouts. While it is false, payments can still succeed, and their funds wait in your balance.

pending_by_source_type.description: Signed pending amounts grouped by balance source type. Keys are an open set; US accounts use card and bank_account. When supplied as a complete breakdown, entries sum to pending_money. These amounts are separate from available_by_source_type.

pending_money.description: Signed amount awaiting availability. Separate from available_money; pending_by_source_type breaks down this amount when source details are supplied.

reserve_money.description: Amount held in reserve. It doesn't overlap available_money or held_money.

next_page_token.description: Omitted because all currency balances fit on one page.

BalanceTransaction.description: A change to the merchant's balance.

amount_money.description: Signed gross amount of this balance movement, before any fee.

available_at.description: When the funds become, or became, available to pay out. Present on pending transactions as the expected time; status says whether they are available now.

balance_transaction_id.description: Stable identifier of this balance transaction.

description.description: Short text describing the movement, from Flint or your processor. Use it for display, not for matching.

fee_money.description: Flint fee for this balance movement, never a provider cost passed through. Charges are positive; returned fees are negative. A payment of 5000 with a fee of 175 has a net amount of 4825. A payout reversal returning a fee of 25 reports fee_money -25.

merchant_id.description: Merchant whose balance this transaction moved.

net_money.description: Signed net effect on your Flint balance: amount_money minus fee_money in the same currency.

order.description: The order, inlined when you request expand=order. null when expanded and the transaction has no order_id.

order_id.description: The Flint order this movement relates to, such as the order a payment was for. Absent when the movement isn't tied to an order.

payout_id.description: The payout that carried this balance transaction to your bank. Set once, when that payout's contents are prepared, and never changed afterward, including if the payout later fails or is reversed. Absent until then, and on transactions no payout carries.

related_balance_transaction_ids.description: Earlier balance transactions this one is linked to, such as the payout transaction that a payout_failure, payout_cancellation, or payout_reversal returns, or the collection a merchant_billing_collection_reversal reverses. Empty when there are none.

related_resource.description: The Flint resource behind this movement: a payment_intent, refund, dispute, payout, payout_destination, or merchant_billing_invoice. Absent when the movement has none.

status.description: Whether the funds can be paid out yet: pending until they become available, then available. Only these two values appear, and the change to available sends balance_transaction.updated.

type.description: Kind of balance movement. Unmapped movement types are returned as other.

BrandingSettings.description: A merchant's branding settings: colors, corner radius, and font family. Checkout uses them as its default theme.

BrandingSettingsInput.description: Branding values to change when updating settings. Send null for a color or `font_family` to clear it.

Bundle.description: A group of items sold together.

available_for_sale.description: Whether the bundle is currently eligible for sale.

barcode.description: Barcode assigned to this sellable item.

categories.description: Always present. Empty collections are returned as [].

component_count.description: Number of components in the bundle.

components.description: The bundle's components in position order, on every bundle response including list rows. [] only when the bundle has no components.

created_at.description: When this resource was created, as an RFC3339 timestamp.

delivery_configuration_status.description: Delivery readiness aggregated across the bundle's components.

description.description: Description of the bundle shown to buyers.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

images.description: Images attached to this resource, in display order. The first image is primary.

merchant_id.description: Identifier of the merchant that owns this resource.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata stored on this resource.

modifier_set.description: Attached modifier set, included when expand=modifier_set is requested. Requires commerce.catalog.read in addition to the resource's read scope.

modifier_set_id.description: Attached modifier set. Send null on update to remove it.

name.description: Bundle name shown to buyers.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit assigned to this sellable item.

status.description: Bundle lifecycle status. Archived bundles remain readable and cannot be edited.

taxable.description: Whether this item is subject to tax.

unit_price_money.description: Price charged for one unit, in the currency's smallest unit.

updated_at.description: When this resource last changed, as an RFC3339 timestamp.

version.description: Current resource version. Send it as expected_version to reject a write if the resource has changed.

BundleComponent.description: An item included in a bundle.

bundle_component_id.description: Stable identifier of this component within its bundle.

delivery_configuration_reason.description: Reason the component's delivery configuration needs attention.

delivery_configuration_status.description: Whether the component's delivery configuration is ready, needs attention, or does not apply.

delivery_profile_id.description: Delivery profile used for this component, including any component override.

position.description: Display order among the bundle's components, starting at zero.

product_id.description: Identifier of the product the component's variant belongs to.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

variant.description: Summary of the component's variant and its selected options.

variant_id.description: Identifier of the product variant included in the bundle.

next_page_token.description: Token for the next page. Omitted when there are no more results.

request_id.description: Identifier of this API request, useful when contacting support.

BundleComponentVariantSummary.description: A summary of the variant that fills a bundle component: its names, SKU, selected options, and whether it is available for sale.

available_for_sale.description: Whether the component's variant and its product are both active.

name.description: Name of the component's variant, when set.

product_name.description: Name of the product the variant belongs to.

selected_options.description: Option names and values selected by the component's variant.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit assigned to the component's variant, when set.

variant_id.description: Identifier of the product variant included in the component.

next_page_token.description: Token for the next page. Omitted when there are no more results.

request_id.description: Identifier of this API request, useful when contacting support.
Identifier of this API request, useful when contacting support.

BuyerAction.description: One thing a buyer can do with an order, subscription, invoice or return they read through /v1/me. Show the actions with is_required as what needs the buyer's attention, and the first available action as the primary action on the resource's page in your account.

cancel.description: Present only on an available cancel action.

due_at.description: When the buyer needs to act by. Omitted when the action has no deadline, or when the resource's state or the store's policy doesn't allow it.

is_available.description: Whether this session can take the action now.

is_required.description: Whether the store needs the buyer to take the action, such as paying a due invoice. It stays true when the only thing in the way is signing in.

kind.description: What the action is. Each resource lists its own kinds in a fixed order. New kinds may be added; ignore kinds you don't recognize.
x-enum-descriptions: Order: start a return of delivered items with POST /v1/me/return-previews, then POST /v1/me/returns.
Order: email the receipt again with POST /v1/me/orders/{order_id}/send-receipt.
Subscription: cancel it with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel. Read cancel for the accepted reasons, timing and retention offer.
Subscription: pause it with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/pause. Read pause for the accepted pause duration.
Subscription: resume a paused subscription with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/resume.
Subscription: keep a subscription scheduled to cancel with cancel_at_period_end false on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Subscription: change the card it charges with payment_method_id on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Invoice: pay what is due now through a checkout session from POST /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}/checkout-session.
Return: withdraw a return the store has not decided on, with POST /v1/me/returns/{return_id}/cancel.
Return: send or drop off the items the return's handoff_requirements list.

Return: pay each resolution in pay_balance.return_resolution_ids through POST /v1/me/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}/checkout-session. Read each amount with GET /v1/me/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}.

Subscription: charge the past-due amount again now with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/payment-retries, for example after changing the card. Unavailable with not_in_state while cancellation is scheduled; reactivate the subscription to keep it before retrying payment.
Subscription: change shipping details with the delivery field on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Subscription: skip the next renewal with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/skip-cycle.
Subscription: choose an offered frequency with billing_interval and billing_interval_count on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Subscription: choose an offered quantity with quantity on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Subscription: change an eligible variant with PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/line-items/{subscription_line_item_id}.
Subscription: order the next renewal now with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/renew.

pause.description: Present only on an available pause action.

pay_balance.description: Present only on an available pay_balance action.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the action can't be taken now. Present exactly when is_available is false. New reasons may be added; show a general message for a reason you don't recognize.
x-enum-descriptions: The session came from an email link that opens only this resource, and the action needs the buyer to sign in. Customer sessions you create with POST /v1/customer-sessions never have this reason.
The store turned the action off, such as letting buyers pause, or its return policies don't let the buyer return these items.
The resource's current state doesn't allow the action, such as resuming a subscription that isn't paused, or returning items not yet delivered.
The return window ended for everything left on the order.
Everything delivered on the order is already in a return.
The invoice can't be paid online, such as one the store collects outside Flint.
The buyer has reached the store's maximum consecutive skipped renewals. A paid renewal resets the count.

BuyerCancelActionOptions.description: The cancellation choices this subscription accepts from its buyer.

cancellation_reasons.description: Reasons to offer, in the store's order. Empty means do not ask. Sending a reason is always optional.

retention_offer.description: An available pause the buyer may accept instead of canceling, using POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/pause. The buyer may always decline and cancel.

timing.description: The cancellation timing accepted by this subscription. New values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: Omit cancel_immediately to end at the subscription's cancellation boundary: current_period_end_at, trial end, or the next retry. Sending true is refused by the buyer policy.
Cancel now. Send cancel_immediately: true; it is required when no period-end boundary exists. An active delivery hold past its period end cancels now even when omitted.
Send cancel_immediately: true to end now; omit it or send false to end at the subscription's cancellation boundary.

BuyerCancelRetentionOffer.description: An optional alternative to cancellation that this subscription can accept.

kind.description: The alternative offered. Ignore kinds you do not recognize.

pause_duration_cycles.description: Send this pause_duration_cycles to accept the offer.

BuyerCapabilities.description: What a store lets buyers do to their own subscriptions. Send at least one field; each field you omit takes its default.

can_update_delivery.description: Whether buyers may change the shipping address and delivery method of their physical subscriptions.

cancellation_reasons.description: Reasons a buyer is asked to choose from when canceling, in the order shown. Empty: the buyer is not asked. When the list is not empty, a buyer's cancellation_reason_code must be one of them.

cancellation_timing.description: When a subscription a buyer cancels ends. end_of_period: at trial_end_at while trialing, current_period_end_at while active, or next_retry_at while past_due. buyer_chooses: the buyer picks the scheduled time or right away. When no scheduled cancellation time is available, including scheduled, incomplete, paused, and past_due without next_retry_at, the buyer may send cancel_immediately: true under either policy.

pause.description: Replaced as a whole: send every field you want to keep. Whether buyers may pause, and for how long. Omit it to let buyers pause with no limit.

retention_offer.description: Replaced as a whole: send every field you want to keep. The offer a buyer sees before canceling. The buyer can always decline it and cancel. Omit it for no offer.

skip.description: Replaced as a whole: send every field you want to keep. Whether buyers may skip renewals. Omit it to allow skipping with no consecutive limit.

BuyerCheckoutProblemResource.description: A checkout problem shown to the buyer, including whether it blocks completion and how to resolve it.

x-enum-descriptions: The delivery quote or selection behind this checkout is out of date. Create a new delivery quote.
The delivery selection expired, was released, or was replaced. Create a new delivery quote and select an option.
Flint could not read the checkout's delivery. Read the session again when remediation.retry is same_request; otherwise follow the remediation next action.
Another payment for this order is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then read the checkout session again.

BuyerCheckoutSession.description: A session in which a buyer completes an order's payment.

buyer_contact.description: Contact the buyer entered in checkout before paying, saved with the session's checkout credential. Separate from merchant-supplied prefill and customer_prefill from the customer record. Omitted until the buyer saves or clears a field. When a checkout session payment omits buyer_contact.email or buyer_contact.phone, Flint uses these values. Flint clears the contact 30 days after the session ends, and when a customer linked to the session is deleted.

buyer_fields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

can_save_payment_method.description: Whether checkout offers the buyer the option to save the card they type for faster checkout at this merchant. When true and save_payment_method_requires_verification is false, PayOrder accepts save_payment_method: true for one newly collected card. False when the merchant turned checkout.saved_payment_details off, customer accounts are merchant hosted, card is not an available payment option, the checkout collects an invoice, a subscription, or a return, or the checkout acts for no customer and Flint cannot email the buyer a verification code. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

can_save_payment_method_with_phone.description: Whether the buyer can save the card they type by giving a US or Canadian mobile phone number with the payment, in save_payment_method_phone on POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay, and confirming it with a texted code after paying. True while Flint can send texts and either save_payment_method_requires_verification is true, so the number replaces confirming an email before paying, or the checkout acts for the customer whose email the buyer confirmed with this credential, so the number joins that customer's saved details once the buyer confirms it. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

customer_id.description: The customer of the session's order. Omitted when the order has none. A checkout credential issued for this session acts for this customer. Add expand=customer to include the customer.

customer_prefill.description: Contact and default addresses of the customer the checkout acts for, with the recipient name on its default shipping address: the customer the merchant created the session for, or the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. Present on GET and PATCH responses while the session is open and acts for a customer. Separate from merchant-supplied prefill and buyer_contact saved by the buyer. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

delivery_method_ids.description: Immutable delivery method assignment captured when the checkout was created.

delivery_selection_required.description: Whether the order has at least one remaining quote-resolved fulfillment choice that must be selected before payment.

expires_in_seconds.description: The lifetime the session got. expires_at is its deadline. Omitted for invoice sessions, which take their deadline from the invoice.

fulfillment.description: Current fulfillment choices for Flint-owned pricing. External pricing reports requires_explicit_quote; reading this field does not request a delivery quote. Omitted when the session is not open, has no order, or Flint cannot read its delivery.

gift_card_challenge.description: Where the buyer completes a gift card challenge for this checkout. Returned on single-session reads, session create and update responses, checkout launch results, and customer verification confirmation results while the session is open and can show the challenge. Omitted from lists, webhooks, expanded resources, and delivery selection results.

is_in_recovery.description: Whether this terminal session credential is temporarily restricted to recovering its owning payment attempt.

merchant_icon.description: The merchant's square icon, shown in browser tabs and compact headers. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_logo.description: The merchant's logo. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_name.description: The merchant's business name, which hosted checkout shows when `theme.title` is unset. Reads `Merchant` when the merchant has not set a business name. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_support.description: How the buyer can reach the merchant for help: the support email, phone, and URL the merchant set. Present on GET and PATCH responses when the merchant set at least one of them. Show it where your checkout tells the buyer to contact the merchant, such as an expired or closed checkout, or your receipt. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page that renders this embedded checkout. Omitted when not set.

payment_collection.description: Guidance for collecting a payment source. Checkout-credential reads include it only while the session is open. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

payment_link_image.description: The current image of the payment link that opened this session. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when that link has an image; other responses and webhooks omit it.

payment_method_save.description: The card the buyer saved with this checkout's payment by giving a mobile phone number, and whether they confirmed it. Present on GET and PATCH responses after a payment that paid the order in full, or that was approved for the merchant to capture later, and saved a card this way. A checkout whose payment is approved stays open until the capture. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

payment_return_url.description: Embedded sessions only. Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

payments.description: Configured payment options for merchant credentials; currently available payment options for the checkout credential.

prefill.description: Contact details and addresses to fill in for the buyer, who can change them. For a customer with saved addresses, Flint fills in any address you leave out, and reads include it. With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

problems.description: Named conditions that affect checkout completion. Follow each problem's remediation action instead of reconstructing delivery lifecycle rules in the client. payment_in_progress means another payment for the order must finish before this checkout can complete. When Flint cannot read the checkout's delivery, the read still succeeds and reports delivery_unreadable; its remediation says whether reading the session again can succeed, and its next action's reason_code names the error.

recovery_expires_at.description: RFC3339 deadline for the restricted payment-attempt recovery window.

recovery_payment_attempt_id.description: Payment attempt that this checkout credential may recover while is_in_recovery is true.

redirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

save_payment_method_requires_verificatio.description: Whether the buyer must confirm their email with a code before the checkout can save their card or use their saved cards. True when can_save_payment_method is true and the checkout acts for no customer for this credential: the merchant created it without one, and either the buyer has not confirmed an email with this credential, or the customer whose email they confirmed has since changed that email or been deleted. A credential other than the one a confirmation returned, such as the hosted checkout link opened on another device, reads true. Send the code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications. False while the checkout acts for a customer, and whenever can_save_payment_method is false. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

save_payment_method_types.description: What save_payment_method keeps, present when can_save_payment_method is true: card, a card the buyer types into checkout. Show the save option with that payment method only. A pay request that sends save_payment_method: true with Apple Pay, Google Pay, a bank account, or Affirm, through a confirmation token created with setup_future_usage none, still pays, and its payment attempt's payment_method_save reports not_saved. The values can grow. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

setup_collection.description: Guidance for collecting a payment method to save. Checkout-credential reads include it only while the session is open. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

show_flint_mark.description: Whether Flint's hosted pages show the Powered by Flint mark for this merchant. `false` when the merchant's agreement with Flint removes it. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

x-enum-descriptions: The buyer can pay through the session.
The session collected the full amount due.
The session collected part of the amount due.
The session's deadline passed before it completed.
Another action ended the session; terminal_reason explains why.

subscription_terms.description: Renewal terms a subscription checkout commits the buyer to. Frozen when the session's order was created, so later plan changes do not alter them. Absent when the checkout starts no subscription.

x-enum-descriptions: The buyer pays on Flint's hosted checkout page.
The buyer pays through a presentation on the merchant's site.

tax.description: The session's tax settings. Omitted when the session sets none.

x-enum-descriptions: Payment collected the full amount due.
Payment collected part of the amount due.
An order edit ended the session.
A replacement checkout session took its place.
Payment outside the session collected the order.
Payment outside the session collected the invoice.
The amount due on the invoice changed.

theme.description: The theme checkout renders with: your branding settings, with the session's `title`, `primary_color`, and `accent_color` over them. A session sets only those three; the other fields come from branding settings. Omitted when neither sets a value.

x-enum-descriptions: Pays an order that existed before the session, including a return resolution's replacement order.
Pays the order Flint created from quick_pay_item.
Signs the buyer up for subscription_plan_id. Flint created the order from the plan.
Started from the payment link in payment_link_id.

url.description: Hosted checkout URL that carries a one-time launch credential. Send the buyer here to pay. Present only for hosted sessions read with a merchant credential that can manage checkout sessions. Launch results include it for hosted sessions: create, payment-link resolve, and invoice and return-resolution checkout. Omitted for embedded sessions.

version.description: Persisted version of this resource's owned state. Expanded resources and external observations can change independently.

checkout_auth_token.description: Checkout credential. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <checkout_auth_token>. Present on checkout launch and customer binding confirmation; omitted when a saved-card confirmation keeps the current credential.

BuyerCheckoutSessionWithSecret.description: The checkout session with its checkout credential. For hosted checkout, send the buyer to url. For embedded checkout, pass checkout_auth_token to your checkout client.

BuyerCreateReturnPreviewRequest.description: The request body for: Preview Return eligibility or resolution amounts for the current buyer.

BuyerCreateReturnRequest.description: The request body for: Create a Return for the current buyer.

BuyerCreateReturnResolutionPreviewReques.description: The buyer's proposed resolution type, returned quantities, and replacement items to preview for a Return.

x-enum-descriptions: Money back to the original payment, with gift card value sent to the chosen gift card destination.
Different merchandise; the buyer may owe or be owed the difference.
The same merchandise again, with no money moving.

BuyerCreditNote.description: The buyer-visible view of a credit note. Drafts are never returned, and how much credit is left to allocate is omitted.

buyer_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

credit_note_id.description: Unique identifier of the credit note.

credit_note_number.description: Assigned at issue and stable from then on. Absent while the credit note is a draft.

invoice_id.description: The invoice this credit note corrects.

issued_at.description: When the credit note was issued.

latest_refund_status.description: Status of the most recent refund linked to this credit note. Absent when no refund has been requested.
x-enum-descriptions: At least one payment refund or tender allocation is still in progress.
Every payment refund and tender allocation succeeded. Can still become partially_succeeded or failed after a bank rejection.
Some payment refunds or tender allocations succeeded and the rest failed or were canceled. failure_reason is payment_refund_failed. Can still become failed.
No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again.

line_items.description: Itemized corrections against frozen invoice lines. Amount and quantity corrections share each source line's remaining value, discount, and tax across issued, non-void credit notes. Drafts reserve no credit.

memo.description: Free text shown on the credit note. Null when none was set.

pending_refund_money.description: Credit reserved by linked refunds that have not resolved yet.

reason.description: Why the invoice is being corrected. Shown on the credit note document.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer returned goods they were billed for.
The order changed after the invoice was issued.
The invoice billed the wrong items, quantities, or amounts.
Any other reason. Explain it in memo.

refunded_money.description: Credit consumed by linked refunds that succeeded.

seller_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

status.description: draft while the credit note is editable, issued once it is numbered and frozen, void once retired.
x-enum-descriptions: Numbered and frozen. Its credit can be allocated to the invoice or refunded.
Retired. Its corrections stop counting against the invoice lines' remaining value, and available_money is 0.

total_money.description: The face value of the credit note, the sum of its lines.

voided_at.description: When the credit note was voided. Absent unless it is void.

email.description: Customer email, or null when the customer has none. Unique among the environment's customers.

name.description: Customer name, or null when none.

phone.description: Customer phone number, or null when none.

x-enum-descriptions: The customer can be changed and used for new purchases.
Deletion was approved and is in progress. The customer can't be changed, charged, or signed in to.
The customer's personal data was erased. Only its ID, created_at, and the records that reference it remain. It can't be changed or restored.

BuyerDeliveryFulfillmentDetails.description: Buyer-facing details of a local delivery fulfillment: courier, timing, and tracking. Some fields are omitted for credentials that don't act for the verified customer.

carrier.description: Carrier responsible for the local delivery.

courier_pickup_at.description: Time at which the courier collected the order.

courier_pickup_window_duration_seconds.description: Width of the promised courier pickup window, from 0 to 86400 seconds.

courier_provider_name.description: Delivery network or merchant fleet provider handling the job.

courier_support_phone.description: Buyer-safe support number for the courier or merchant fleet.

delivered_at.description: When the items were delivered, in RFC3339 format.

dispatched_at.description: When the delivery was dispatched, in RFC3339 format.

dropoff_notes.description: Driver-facing notes for the final handoff. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

expires_at.description: Deadline after which an undelivered job should enter merchant review.

instructions.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

no_contact.description: Whether the buyer requested a no-contact handoff. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

prep_time_duration_seconds.description: Expected preparation time before courier pickup, from 0 to 86400 seconds.

ready_at.description: Time at which the order became ready for courier pickup.

timezone.description: Timezone used to display the local delivery window.

tracking_url.description: Absolute HTTPS carrier tracking URL. Embedded URL credentials are rejected. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

window_end_at.description: End of the promised delivery window, in RFC3339 format.

window_start_at.description: Start of the promised delivery window, in RFC3339 format.

BuyerErrorRemediation.description: Guidance for recovering from a payment error: whether and how to retry (`retry`), and optional next steps.

next_steps.description: What to change or check before attempting the operation again.

retry.description: How to recover: same_request resends the identical request with the same Idempotency-Key; after_refresh re-reads the resource and rebuilds the request with a new key; none requires correcting the request or following next_steps or next_actions.
x-enum-descriptions: Resend the identical request with the same Idempotency-Key after Retry-After when present, otherwise with exponential backoff and jitter.
Read the resource again, rebuild the request from its current state, and use a new Idempotency-Key.
Do not retry automatically. Correct the request or follow next_steps or next_actions.

BuyerExpandedOrderSummary.description: An order summary in a buyer response, with order status and totals. Recorded buyer contact is omitted.

closed_at.description: When the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at the transition and never changed.

closed_reason.description: Why the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at closure. Unrecognized reasons are returned as other; new values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection completed, including zero-balance completion through POST /pay.
A merchant closed the order through POST /close.
The order's invoice was marked uncollectible.
A newer subscription renewal attempt replaced this unpaid order.
The return resolution that created this replacement order was canceled.
The stored closure reason is not recognized.

created_at.description: When the order was created, in RFC3339 format.

customer_id.description: Customer associated with the order, when one is set.

fulfillment_status.description: Aggregate progress across the order's fulfillment quantities.
x-enum-descriptions: No quantity has been fulfilled or canceled.
Some quantities have been fulfilled and others remain.
Every quantity was fulfilled or canceled.

order_id.description: Stable identifier of the expanded order.

order_number.description: Human-readable order number for receipts and merchant reference.

payment_intent_ids.description: Payment intents associated with the order.

payment_status.description: Collection progress. An invoice write-off also completes collection without receiving the written-off amount.
x-enum-descriptions: Part of the total was collected and a balance remains.
Collection is complete, including when the remaining invoice balance was written off.

pricing_amounts.description: Order totals before accounting for collected payments and refunds.

settlement_amounts.description: Payments, refunds, credits, and amounts still owed for the order.

status.description: Whether the order still accepts changes and new payments. Refunds, fulfillment, disputes, returns, and metadata or note edits continue on a closed order.
x-enum-descriptions: You can edit the order and collect payment.
The order no longer accepts changes to what was sold or new payments; closed_reason says why.

updated_at.description: When the order was last updated, in RFC3339 format.

BuyerExpandedPackageSummary.description: A package on a buyer's fulfillment, with its carrier, status, tracking details, and timestamps. Buyer credentials get no supported actions.

created_at.description: When the package was created, in RFC3339 format.

delivered_at.description: When the package was delivered, in RFC3339 format.

expected_delivery_at.description: When the carrier or merchant expects this package to arrive. Null when no estimate is set. Retained after delivery as history. This estimate is separate from the fulfillment's promised shipment window.

fulfillment_id.description: Fulfillment whose items are in the package.

package_id.description: Stable identifier of the expanded package.

service_code.description: Carrier service used for the package.

shipped_at.description: When the package was shipped, in RFC3339 format.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.
x-enum-descriptions: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
The package was handed to the carrier.
The carrier is moving the package through its network.
The package is on its final delivery route.
The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
The package was returned toward or to its origin.
The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.
