x-flint-enum-descriptions.delivery_attempted: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.exception: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.in_transit: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.out_for_delivery: The package is on its final delivery route.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.packed: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.returned: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.shipped: The package was handed to the carrier.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.voided: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

tracking_number.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

tracking_url.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

updated_at.description: When the package was last updated, in RFC3339 format.

version.description: Monotonic package version for expected_version checks.

BuyerExpandedSubscriptionPlanSummary.description: A subscription plan expanded on a buyer's order: billing interval, setup fee, trial length, status, and line items.

status.description: Active plans accept new signups. Inactive plans refuse new signups with PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE while existing subscriptions keep renewing. Archived plans are read-only and their status is set only by DELETE /v1/subscription-plans/{subscription_plan_id}.

BuyerFulfillment.description: Work required to deliver an order's items.

charges.description: Order charges associated with this fulfillment.

created_at.description: When the fulfillment was created, in RFC3339 format.

customer_id.description: Customer receiving this fulfillment, when one is set.

digital_details.description: Delivery URL and completion time for a digital fulfillment.

dispatched_at.description: First time this fulfillment reached dispatched.

line_items.description: Order lines and quantities allocated to this fulfillment.

local_delivery_details.description: Courier, delivery window, and handoff details for a local delivery fulfillment.

order.description: Order summary returned when the order relationship is expanded.

order_id.description: Order whose items this fulfillment delivers.

order_number.description: Human-readable number of the order this fulfillment belongs to. Omitted when the order has no number.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome details. Present exactly when status is no_show.

packed_at.description: First time this fulfillment reached packed.

picked_at.description: First time this fulfillment reached picked.

pickup_details.description: Pickup window, pickup mode, and handoff times for a pickup fulfillment.

recipient.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

scheduled_start_at.description: Derived start of the service schedule or pickup, local delivery, or shipment window. Null when no schedule is booked, including digital fulfillments. Details remain the authoritative schedule inputs. Nulls sort first ascending and last descending, then by fulfillment_id in the same direction.

service_details.description: Schedule and completion details for a service fulfillment.

shipment_details.description: Shipping schedule and ship time for a shipment fulfillment. Present only on shipment fulfillments with at least one value.

status.description: Buyer-visible fulfillment status. Held fulfillments show their pre-hold status.
x-enum-descriptions: Work has not started and has not been accepted. Approval may be required before work can begin.
Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
The provider accepted the fulfillment; work has not started.
Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
The assigned items have been picked.
The assigned items have been packed.
The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.
The pickup or appointment was missed. Read outcome for the recorded reason.

x-flint-enum-descriptions.accepted: The provider accepted the fulfillment; work has not started.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.canceled: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.dispatched: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.failed: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.in_progress: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.no_show: The pickup or appointment was missed. Read outcome for the recorded reason.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.on_hold: Work is paused. Release the hold to restore active_hold.previous_status, or use a supported forward action.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.packed: The assigned items have been packed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.pending: Work has not started and has not been accepted. Approval may be required before work can begin.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.picked: The assigned items have been picked.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.preparing: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ready: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.scheduled: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.

terminal_at.description: When the fulfillment entered a terminal state: completed, canceled, failed, or no_show. This records the state transition; completed_at records completion evidence supplied for the fulfillment.

updated_at.description: When the fulfillment was last updated, in RFC3339 format.

version.description: Monotonic fulfillment version for expected_version checks.

BuyerFulfillmentEvent.description: An action recorded during an order's fulfillment.

BuyerFulfillmentLineItem.description: An order line item and quantity included in a buyer's fulfillment, with the line's modifiers.

modifiers.description: Modifier selections snapshotted from the order line for fulfillment.

order_line_item_id.description: Order line whose quantity is allocated to the fulfillment.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

BuyerFulfillmentOutcome.description: A terminal outcome recorded on a fulfillment, such as a no-show, with its `reason` and when it occurred.

outcome_type.description: Recorded fulfillment outcome, such as a missed service appointment.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the recorded outcome.
x-enum-descriptions: The customer did not arrive for the scheduled service or pickup.
The service provider did not arrive for the appointment.
An incorrect schedule prevented the appointment from taking place.
The appointment or pickup was missed for another recorded cause.

BuyerGiftCard.description: A prepaid balance a customer can spend with the merchant.

last4.description: Last four characters of the card's current code.

BuyerGiftCardTransaction.description: A record of a change to a gift card's balance.

BuyerInstructionsConfig.description: Controls buyer instructions for a delivery option. Omit it from a method configuration to disable instruction collection.

label.description: Checkout field label, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted.

placeholder.description: Checkout field placeholder, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted.

required.description: Whether the buyer must enter instructions before selecting the option. Requires enabled=true.

BuyerInvoice.description: A bill issued to a customer.

active_payment_attempt.description: The payment attempt in progress for this invoice, such as a bank debit still processing. Omitted when none is open. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

balance_rows.description: What changed after the invoice was issued, in display order, such as late fees, payments, credit notes, and write-offs. When present, rows where `is_informational` is `false` sum to `outstanding_money`. The opening `total` row contributes to the sum; the closing `amount_due` row is informational and states it. `[]` when nothing changed or the invoice is void. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the invoice: pay. pay is available when a checkout session can take a payment now, and then required, due by due_at or by the due date of the installment it collects.

cc_emails.description: Additional recipients copied on the invoice email and every reminder.

closed_at.description: When the current closed interval began. Cleared when status returns to open or partially_paid. A direct move between closed statuses preserves this timestamp.

collection_block_status.description: Whether collection is blocked. While it is inventory_blocked, collection attempts return INVOICE_COLLECTION_BLOCKED.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection is paused because items on a subscription renewal invoice ran out of inventory. Collection attempts return INVOICE_COLLECTION_BLOCKED.
The inventory block ended. Flint voids the renewal invoice when stock returns and collects the renewal on its order instead.

collection_mode.description: How the invoice is collected: buyer_initiated, automatic, or external. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer pays from the hosted invoice page with the payment options in payment_policy.
Flint charges the buyer's saved card after issue, or on each schedule entry's due date. The buyer can also pay by card from the hosted invoice page.
Payment happens outside Flint, and the merchant records it.

credit_money.description: Credit note credit allocated to this invoice, minus reversed allocations. Unallocated credit isn't included.

currently_due_money.description: The part of the balance due now. Without schedule_entries, it equals outstanding_money. With schedule_entries, it is the outstanding amount of the first entry, in schedule order, whose due time has arrived and that still has a balance, or 0 when there is none. It is the amount the next collect call or checkout session charges. To total everything past due, add the outstanding_money of the entries whose status is due or overdue. Always 0 unless the invoice is open or partially_paid.

customer.description: Summary of the billed customer. Returned only with expand=customer.

customer_id.description: Customer billed by this invoice. Absent when the invoice has no customer.

due_at.description: When payment is due. With payment terms, issue sets it from issued_at and the terms, counted in the invoice's timezone. Absent when the invoice has no due date.

footer.description: Fine print at the bottom of the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. null when unset.

invoice_number.description: Sequential document number assigned when the invoice is issued. Numbering is per merchant, with test and live mode numbered independently.

is_overdue.description: Whether the invoice is open or partially_paid and past due with a balance remaining. Without schedule_entries, due_at has passed and outstanding_money is above zero; with them, at least one entry is overdue. Computed when the invoice is read.

issue_rows.description: The rows of the invoice's totals as issued, in display order. Rows where `is_informational` is `false` sum to `snapshot.pricing_amounts.total_money`. A closing `total` row is informational and states that sum. Show the rows in order without merging or summing them. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

issued_at.description: When the invoice was issued. Absent on a draft.

late_fee_money.description: Late fees assessed after issue, minus waivers, including amounts since paid or written off. Itemized in late_fees.

late_fees.description: Late fees assessed on this invoice, each with its paid, waived, written-off, and outstanding amounts. late_fee_money is their assessed total minus waivers.

memo.description: Message to the customer, printed on the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. null when unset.

merchant_icon.description: The merchant's square icon, shown in browser tabs and compact headers. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

merchant_logo.description: The merchant's logo. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

merchant_support.description: How the buyer can reach the merchant: the support email, phone, and URL the merchant set. Omitted when the merchant set none. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

order.description: Summary of the backing order. Returned only with expand=order.

order_id.description: The order this invoice bills. Every invoice has one; quick pay creates it.

outstanding_money.description: What is still owed. On an open or partially_paid invoice it is total_money + late_fee_money - paid_money - credit_money, never below zero. 0 on paid, credited, uncollectible, and void invoices. Refunds don't change it.

paid_at.description: When the invoice most recently became paid. Cleared when status leaves paid and set again on a later paid transition.

paid_money.description: Payments collected toward this invoice, online or as recorded manual payments, minus reversed payments, including payments toward late fees. Never below zero. Refunds don't reduce it; they are in refunded_money.

payment_option_cost_comparison.description: A payment option that costs the merchant less to accept for this invoice, with the estimated savings. Present when the invoice's payment policy turns on `show_cost_comparison` and Flint can compare the options. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

payment_options.description: Ways the buyer can pay this invoice online, leaving out any option whose limit the amount exceeds. `[]` when it can't be paid online. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

payment_terms_snapshot.description: The payment term captured on the draft, with its due date rule and late fee policy. Later changes to the payment term don't affect this invoice.

po_number.description: The buyer's purchase order number, printed on the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. null when unset.

recipient_email.description: Where Flint emails the invoice and its reminders. Email delivery requires it at issue. null when unset.

reference.description: Your reference for the invoice, printed on the invoice and PDF. The buyer's purchase order number goes in po_number. It cannot change after issue. null when unset.

refund_status.description: How much of the collected money has been refunded. It doesn't change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Some money has been refunded, less than paid_money.
Refunds have returned all of paid_money.

refunded_money.description: Money refunded to the buyer after collection. Refunds don't reopen the balance; refund_status summarizes them.

remit_to_address.description: Where the buyer sends offline payments, shown on the invoice. Defaults to the invoice settings remit-to address.

schedule_entries.description: The payment schedule, in schedule order. Always [] when the invoice has no schedule and is collected in one balance.

scheduled_issue_at.description: When Flint will issue and deliver this draft. null when no issue is scheduled. Cleared when the draft is issued or voided, or when you send null.

service_date.description: The calendar date of the billed service, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The invoice and PDF print it as written, without timezone conversion. null when unset.

show_flint_mark.description: Whether Flint's hosted pages show the Powered by Flint mark for this merchant. `false` when the merchant's agreement with Flint removes it. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

snapshot.description: The billing content of the invoice: line items, discounts, charges, tip, tax, and totals. A draft previews the backing order; issue freezes it, and later order changes don't reach an issued invoice.

status.description: Current invoice status. paid and credited close the current balance and can reopen to open or partially_paid after a payment or credit allocation reversal; invoice.reopened reports that change. void and uncollectible are final. Refunds change refund_status without reopening the balance.
x-enum-descriptions: An issued invoice that remains open for collection.
An issued invoice with positive net collection and an outstanding balance.
The current balance is cleared and positive net collection remains. Allocated credit or waived fees can help close it. Payment or credit allocation reversals can reopen it.
A voided invoice that cannot be collected. Final.
An invoice whose outstanding balance was written off. Final.
The current balance is cleared with positive applied credit and no positive net collection. Reversing credit allocation can reopen it.

subscription_id.description: The subscription the backing order belongs to, copied when the draft is created and never changed. null when the order isn't part of a subscription.

theme.description: The theme Flint's hosted invoice page renders with, from your branding settings. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the invoice's calendar dates, such as due dates from payment terms and reminder and late fee day counts. At issue, an invoice without one takes the invoice settings timezone.

total_money.description: What the invoice bills, equal to snapshot.pricing_amounts.total_money and fixed at issue. Late fees are in late_fee_money.

version.description: Current invoice version. Send this as expected_version when updating the draft.

viewed_at.description: When the buyer first opened the invoice through its hosted invoice link. Recorded on a best-effort basis.

BuyerInvoiceCheckoutSessionResult.description: The invoice is the primary resource, with its checkout session, credential, and any invoice payment attempt.

BuyerInvoiceLateFee.description: A charge assessed because an invoice payment is overdue.

amount_money.description: The assessed fee: the policy's fixed amount, or its percent of base_outstanding_money.

base_outstanding_money.description: The unpaid balance the fee was calculated from, excluding late fees, captured at assessment.

invoice_schedule_entry_id.description: The schedule entry this fee applies to. Absent on an invoice without a schedule, where the fee applies to the whole invoice. Each invoice, or each entry, takes at most one fee, even after a waiver.

late_fee_policy.description: The late fee policy from payment_terms_snapshot, copied when the fee was assessed.

outstanding_money.description: What is still owed on this fee: amount_money - paid_money - waived_money - written_off_money, never below zero.

paid_money.description: Payments applied to this fee, minus reversed payments.

waived_at.description: When the fee was waived. Absent unless it was waived.

waived_money.description: The amount waived. A waiver removes the fee's whole outstanding amount at that time, so it is less than amount_money when part of the fee was already paid.

written_off_money.description: The part of this fee written off when the invoice was marked uncollectible.

BuyerOrder.description: A customer's purchase and its payment and fulfillment progress.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the order, in this order: start_return, then resend_receipt. A buyer's read through a customer session on /v1/me, or in Flint's buyer account, lists both every time; a merchant read gets an empty list. A list of orders leaves start_return out, since only a read of one order checks return eligibility. start_return is due when the last open return window ends.

buyer_contact.description: Email and phone saved when payment started, from the pay request's buyer_contact or the paying checkout session's saved contact. It does not change the linked customer.

closed_at.description: When the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at the transition and never changed.

closed_reason.description: Why the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at closure. Unrecognized reasons are returned as other; new values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection completed, including zero-balance completion through POST /pay.
A merchant closed the order through POST /close.
The order's invoice was marked uncollectible.
A newer subscription renewal attempt replaced this unpaid order.
The return resolution that created this replacement order was canceled.
The stored closure reason is not recognized.

delivery_destination.description: The shipment or local-delivery destination committed for this order. Payment freezes this value; fulfillment recipient changes do not replace it. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

fulfillment_status.description: Aggregate progress across the order's fulfillment quantities.
x-enum-descriptions: No quantity has been fulfilled or canceled.
Some quantities have been fulfilled and others remain.
Every quantity was fulfilled or canceled.

governing_delivery_selection_id.description: ID of the delivery selection that governs this order, including pickup choices without a delivery destination. Read with GET /v1/orders/{order_id}; other order responses may omit this field. While present, change the destination through the delivery selection. Omitted when no selection governs the order.

payment_link_id.description: Payment link whose checkout created this order. Absent for orders that did not come from a payment link. Filter GET /v1/orders by payment_link_id to list a link's orders.

payment_status.description: Collection progress. An invoice write-off also completes collection without receiving the written-off amount.
x-enum-descriptions: Part of the total was collected and a balance remains.
Collection is complete, including when the remaining invoice balance was written off.

return_credit_settlements.description: Value applied to this order from items the buyer returned, such as an exchange's replacement order. Included in settlement_amounts.paid_money.

return_resolution_id.description: ID of the return resolution that created this order as a replacement. Omitted for orders a return did not create.

status.description: Whether the order still accepts changes and new payments. Refunds, fulfillment, disputes, returns, and metadata or note edits continue on a closed order.
x-enum-descriptions: You can edit the order and collect payment.
The order no longer accepts changes to what was sold or new payments; closed_reason says why.

subscription_cycle.description: Charged subscription cycle associated with this order. Signup is cycle 1; unpaid retries and skipped renewals do not advance the cycle.

subscription_delivery_changed_at.description: Time the subscriber changed delivery after this paid renewal was prepared. The order keeps its committed destination until you correct it or refund and replace it.

ticketed_event.description: Event and tickets this order sold through an event payment link. Absent on other orders.

version.description: Order version for optimistic concurrency. Send this value as the expected version when changing the order.

BuyerOrderCharge.description: An additional charge applied to an order.

BuyerOrderLineItem.description: An item purchased in an order.

fulfillment_quantities.description: Current quantities for each required fulfillment obligation: one entry for a single item or one per bundle component that requires fulfillment. Quantities use line units for single items and component units for bundles. required_quantity equals unassigned_quantity + assigned_quantity + fulfilled_quantity + canceled_quantity + failed_quantity. Omitted when the line needs no fulfillment or the order's obligations cannot be computed, including older lines without recorded requirements.

fulfillment_requirements.description: Fulfillment requirements fixed when the line item was created. direct describes a single item; components describes each bundle component. Omitted for older line items without recorded requirements.

purchased_gift_cards.description: Masked card identities for fully funded units of this purchase line. Partial consideration does not issue a card.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

refunded_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

x-enum-descriptions: Sold from a product variant, named by variant_id.
Sold from a bundle, named by bundle_id.

subscription.description: Recurring offer and cadence frozen for this line at signup.

subscription_id.description: Subscription created for this line after the order is paid.

subscription_offer.description: Applicable active offer for a one-time line, or the offer terms frozen for a subscribed line.

unit_dimensions.description: Dimensions of one unit fixed when the line was created. Omitted when unknown and for bundle lines.

unit_weight.description: Weight of one unit fixed when the line was created. Omitted when unknown and for bundle lines.

BuyerOrderLineItemModifier.description: A modifier on a buyer's order line item, either a catalog modifier or entered text, with its quantity and price change.

modifier_group_name.description: Name of the modifier group recorded when this selection was added to the order line item.

modifier_id.description: Identifier of the selected catalog modifier. If its group is owned by a modifier set (source: inline), read the group through GET /v1/modifier-sets/{modifier_set_id}; /v1/modifier-groups doesn't return it.

name.description: Name of the selected modifier recorded on the order line item.

order_line_item_modifier_id.description: Stable identifier of the selected modifier on this order line item.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

show_on_fulfillment.description: Whether this selection appears in fulfillment details, recorded when selected.

show_on_receipt.description: Whether this selection appears on buyer receipts, recorded when selected.

source_type.description: Whether the selection is a catalog list modifier or buyer-entered text.

text.description: Selected text group and buyer-entered value. Read an inline text group through its owning modifier set.

text_value.description: Buyer-entered text recorded for a text modifier selection.

total_money.description: Total price added by this selection. Multiplies unit_price_delta_money by the modifier quantity and, for per_item pricing, by the line item quantity.

unit_price_delta_money.description: Amount added to the item's unit price for each unit of this selection, recorded when selected.

BuyerOrderPaymentAttempt.description: An attempt to pay an order.

is_resumable.description: Whether the attempt can continue through PayOrder with action: resume and this order_payment_attempt_id after any pending client action is complete. If false, check status before starting another payment; the attempt may still be in progress.

last_payment_error.description: The concluded failure of a payment leg that failed this attempt. Absent for non-payment failures.

payment_method_save.description: Set when the pay request sent save_payment_method: true and the attempt paid without saving the payment method. A card typed into checkout and saved has no entry here; read payment_method_save on the checkout session for a card saved with a mobile phone number.

status_reason.description: Non-payment reason an attempt failed, was canceled, or expired. Failed attempts with an unmapped non-payment reason report other. Canceled and expired attempts include a reason only when it adds information beyond status. New values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: The coupon could not be reserved.
The gift card balance could not be reserved.
The selected payment source is invalid.
The order changed before payment started.
The payment customer does not match the order.
The attempt failed for another non-payment reason.
The confirmation request was rejected before a payment outcome.
The payment link capacity could not be claimed.
The payment link capacity could not be validated.
The payment method is awaiting activation.
The payment option is not allowed.
The payment source could not be assigned.
The payment source conflicts with this attempt.
The payment source cannot be updated.
The payment source belongs to another customer.
The resources required for payment could not be secured.
The payment setup action is unavailable.
The payment setup hold could not be acquired.
The payment setup result is incomplete.
The tip allocation could not be synchronized.
The resources for a zero-balance payment could not be secured.

BuyerOrderTax.description: Tax details on a buyer's order: whether tax is enabled, its mode and status, location, exemption, and tax breakdowns.

automatic_profile.description: Identifies which automatic tax behavior applies to this order. connected means the account's tax connection calculated it. standard marks an order calculated before automatic tax required a tax connection.

price_mode.description: Whether the order's prices include tax (`inclusive`) or tax is added to them (`additive`). Present on every order Flint renders after 2026-10-20; a response replayed for an idempotent retry of an earlier request omits it. Each line item and charge also states its own mode in `tax.calculation.price_mode`, which decides that item's tax.

BuyerOrderTaxLocation.description: The location used to calculate tax on a buyer's order, and where its address came from.

address.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

dimensions.description: Physical length, width, and height of the package.

expected_delivery_at.description: When the carrier or merchant expects this package to arrive. Null when no estimate is set. Retained after delivery as history. This estimate is separate from the fulfillment's promised shipment window.

fulfillment_id.description: Fulfillment whose items are in the package.

label_url.description: Merchant or integration supplied HTTPS shipping-label URL for authenticated merchant workflows. Non-Flint URLs must include external_system for provenance. Flint does not currently manage label file hosting or buyer-facing label downloads. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

order_id.description: Order whose items are in the package.

return_id.description: Return this package belongs to. Present only on packages of return shipments.

return_line_items.description: Return line quantities allocated to this parcel. Present only on packages of return shipments.

service_code.description: Carrier service used for the package.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state. Package states are the source used to derive shipment status.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.
x-enum-descriptions: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
The package was handed to the carrier.
The carrier is moving the package through its network.
The package is on its final delivery route.
The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
The package was returned toward or to its origin.
The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

x-flint-enum-descriptions.created: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.delivery_attempted: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.exception: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.in_transit: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.out_for_delivery: The package is on its final delivery route.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.packed: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.returned: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.shipped: The package was handed to the carrier.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.voided: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

tracking_number.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

tracking_url.description: Absolute HTTPS carrier tracking URL. Embedded URL credentials are rejected. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

version.description: Monotonic package version for expected_version checks.

BuyerPauseActionOptions.description: The pause lengths this subscription accepts from its buyer.

max_pause_duration_cycles.description: When present, pause_duration_cycles is required and must be between 1 and this value. When absent, omit pause_duration_cycles to pause until the buyer resumes.

BuyerPauseCapability.description: Whether buyers may pause their own subscriptions. Send at least one field.

enabled.description: Whether buyers may pause. When false, a buyer's pause returns PAUSE_NOT_ALLOWED.

max_cycles.description: The longest pause a buyer may choose, in billing periods. When set, a buyer's pause must send pause_duration_cycles from 1 to this value. Omit it for no limit, which also lets a buyer pause until they resume.

BuyerPayBalanceActionOptions.description: The return resolutions the buyer can pay now.

return_resolution_ids.description: Payable resolutions in creation order. Read each amount with GET /v1/me/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}, then create its checkout session with POST /v1/me/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}/checkout-session.

BuyerPaymentAttemptPaymentIntent.description: The payment intent behind an order payment attempt, with its status, amounts, authorization expiry, and last payment error.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

authorization_expires_at.description: Capture is unavailable at or after this time, even if the payment still has requires_capture status.

capturable_money.description: Payment intent's stored capturable amount. A positive amount does not override authorization_expires_at or the payment status.

payment_intent_id.description: Flint payment intent ID.

selected_payment_option.description: Payment option used by this leg, using the same values as PaymentIntent.selected_payment_option. Fixed when the attempt becomes terminal. Omitted when no payment option has been selected.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. The payment_intent.updated event reports changes into this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. The confirm result's current_payment_action describes a standalone payment's step; call confirm with an empty body to retrieve it again. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.
A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent.

BuyerPaymentCollection.description: What a client needs to collect payment for a buyer's order. The `stripe` field holds the Stripe values.

stripe.description: Client configuration for collecting the payment through Stripe.

BuyerPaymentCollectionStripe.description: Stripe values for collecting payment on a buyer's order: the account ID, publishable key, return URL, and Elements settings.

account_id.description: Stripe account to use when initializing the payment client.

elements.description: Stripe Elements configuration for the available payment methods and amounts.

publishable_key.description: Publishable Stripe key for initializing the payment client.

return_url.description: URL the buyer returns to after a redirect payment step.

BuyerPaymentCollectionStripeElements.description: Stripe Elements collection guidance. Follow next_step in the browser, then submit the result to submit_to through Flint.

amount_money.description: Amount and currency used to initialize the payment form.

digital_wallets.description: Digital wallets that the payment form can offer.

mode.description: Whether Elements is collecting a payment source for an immediate payment or a setup source for future use.

next_step.description: Browser collection operation to perform before calling submit_to.

payment_method_creation.description: Stripe Elements payment method creation mode. Follow next_step: standalone PaymentIntents and checkout-authenticated order collection create a ConfirmationToken, while merchant-authenticated order collection and setup collection create a PaymentMethod.

payment_method_options.description: Payment method settings passed to the payment form.

payment_method_types.description: Payment method types that the payment form can offer.

selectable_payment_intents.description: Order payment intents that the buyer can select for collection.

submit_to.description: Flint operation that accepts the result of next_step.

BuyerPaymentErrorSummary.description: Why a payment attempt failed: a normalized `code`, a message, when it failed, and recovery guidance.

code.description: Flint-normalized payment failure code. Unknown provider values are returned as payment_failed.

failed_at.description: Time the payment attempt concluded in failure.

message.description: Flint-authored merchant-facing payment failure message. This is stable explanatory text, not raw provider copy.

remediation.description: Guidance for resolving the payment failure before trying to collect again.

BuyerPaymentIntent.description: A payment as the buyer sees it. Omits the store's fees, net, risk assessment, and dispute state.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected.

authorization_expires_at.description: When the hold lapses if it hasn't been collected. Set when the hold is placed.

authorized_at.description: When the processor authorized the payment. Absent until then.

authorized_money.description: The amount the processor authorized. It always equals amount_money and doesn't change once set. Absent until the payment is authorized, and on payments canceled before authorization.

cancellation_reason.description: Flint-normalized reason the payment intent was canceled. Present only while status is canceled. Unknown processor values are returned as payment_canceled.

capturable_money.description: The part of the authorization that can still be collected. Positive only while status is requires_capture, and zero after it is collected, released, or expires. Absent until the payment is authorized.

capture_method.description: When money is collected. Defaults to automatic.
x-enum-descriptions: The payment is collected when it is confirmed.
Confirming places a hold on the payment method. The merchant collects all or part of it, or releases it, before authorization_expires_at.

captured_at.description: When money was captured. For automatic capture, this is when the payment succeeded. Absent until capture.

captured_money.description: The amount collected from the buyer. Zero while a hold is open, and positive whenever status is succeeded. Absent until the payment is authorized.

checkout_session_id.description: Flint checkout session ID associated with this payment, when present.

customer_id.description: Customer linked to this payment intent.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

fulfillment_hold.description: Present when a payment provider asked Flint to pause fulfillment for this payment. While its status is active, open fulfillments are on hold.

invoice_id.description: Bill this payment collects, when it pays a bill.

last_payment_error.description: Most recent payment error. Null when no payment error is recorded.

merchant_id.description: Merchant that owns this payment intent.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint and aren't returned.

order_id.description: Order this payment belongs to.

payment_flow.description: How the payment was started. Fixed when the payment is created.
x-enum-descriptions: Started in a Flint checkout session.
The first payment of a subscription.
Entered in the Dashboard virtual terminal.
Created through the merchant's API integration.

payment_intent_id.description: Flint payment intent ID.

payment_options.description: Payment options the buyer can use for this payment.

payment_source.description: Summary of the card or bank account used for the payment. Absent until a payment source is attached.

receipt_email.description: Email address for this payment's receipt. When it isn't set, Flint uses the buyer's email.

refund_status.description: How much of captured_money has been refunded, including value issued as store credit, based on refunded_money.
x-enum-descriptions: Part of captured_money has been refunded.
All of captured_money has been refunded.

refunded_money.description: Total refunded against captured_money, including value issued as store credit and processor refunds still pending. Failed and canceled refunds aren't counted. Zero when nothing has been refunded.

released_money.description: The part of the authorization returned to the buyer without being charged: the uncollected remainder after a partial capture, or the whole authorization after a cancellation or expiry. It was never collected, so it needs no refund. Absent until the payment is authorized.

return_id.description: Flint return ID associated with this payment, when present.

selected_payment_option.description: The payment option the most recent confirmation used. Absent until the payment intent is first confirmed.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Submit payment details again to retry.
Payment details are attached, but the payment hasn't been confirmed yet. This status is brief unless the confirmation was interrupted.
A step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, must be finished before the payment can continue.
Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly.
A hold is in place on the payment method and no money has been collected. The merchant collects some or all of it, or releases it, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected. Final. cancellation_reason says why when it is known. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.
A hold reached authorization_expires_at without being collected, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent.

support_reference.description: Opaque payment reference to share with merchant support. Do not parse its format.

tip_money.description: Portion of amount_money that is a tip. Uses amount_money's currency and is at most amount_money.

transaction_purpose.description: Why a bank debit is taken. Set only when payment_options includes ach_debit, and fixed once the payment intent exists.

version.description: Persisted version of this resource's owned state. Expanded resources and external observations can change independently.

is_default.description: Whether this is the customer's default payment method, the one Customer.default_payment_method_id names. Change the default with PATCH /v1/customers/{customer_id}; that sends customer.updated, not a payment method event.

saved_with.description: Where the buyer saved this payment method. Returned on /v1/me/payment-methods responses when Flint wallet support is enabled. Accept future values.

usage.description: When Flint may charge the payment method. off_session payment methods can pay subscriptions, automatic invoices, and other charges without the buyer, and can be a customer's default. on_session payment methods were saved by the buyer in checkout for faster checkout at this merchant; Flint charges them only in checkouts the buyer completes and refuses them for any charge without the buyer and as a default. Payment methods saved before usage existed are off_session.

client_setup.description: Present when the buyer must complete processor setup before using this payment method.

BuyerPaymentMethodWithSetup.description: The saved payment method, with `client_setup` when the buyer must still complete processor setup before the payment method can be used.

BuyerRefund.description: Money returned against a collected payment.

failure_code.description: Reason code for a failed Return resolution, when available. refund_line_value_unavailable means another refund already returned part of an order line, so retrying cannot succeed; cancel the resolution and resolve the line for fewer units or without a refund. replacement_fulfillment_canceled means the replacement Order's fulfillment was canceled, so it won't be sent. gift_card_refund_destination_required means the original gift card cannot accept the refund; retry with gift_card_refund_destination set to new_gift_card. store_credit_unavailable means the original payment cannot fund store credit; cancel the resolution and create a refund resolution.
x-enum-descriptions: The original gift card cannot receive the refund. Retry with gift_card_refund_destination set to new_gift_card.
The original payment cannot fund store credit. Cancel this resolution, then create a refund resolution.
Flint couldn't create the Refund after retrying.
The Refund was created and failed; failure_message says why. Retry creates a new Refund.
Another refund already covered part of this line, so this refund can't be paid. Cancel the resolution, then resolve fewer units or choose an outcome without a refund.
Flint couldn't create the buyer's PaymentIntent after retrying. Retry resumes it.
The buyer's PaymentIntent was canceled or expired. Retry starts a new payment.
Flint couldn't create the replacement Order after retrying.
The replacement Order's fulfillment was canceled, so it won't be sent.
Another execution failure. Retry, and contact support if it repeats.

failure_message.description: Explanation of a failed Return resolution, when available.

gift_card_refund_destination.description: Where the gift-card-paid portion is refunded. original credits the original gift card; new_gift_card issues new gift cards. amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

last_payment_error.description: Most recent payment failure, when one is recorded.

payment_collection.description: Client setup details for collecting this payment.

payment_intent_id.description: Flint payment intent ID.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. The payment_intent.updated event reports changes into this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. The confirm result's current_payment_action describes a standalone payment's step; call confirm with an empty body to retrieve it again. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.
A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent.

tip_money.description: Portion of this payment's amount allocated to a tip.

status.description:
Read-only shipment state derived from the shipment's package states. An empty shipment remains a created draft.
- `created`: The shipment leg exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The shipment leg is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The shipment leg was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the shipment through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The shipment is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The shipment was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The shipment was voided and will not continue through delivery.

BuyerSkipCapability.description: Whether buyers may skip renewals. Send at least one field.

enabled.description: Whether buyers may skip a renewal. Merchant credentials may always skip an eligible cycle.

max_consecutive_skips.description: Maximum consecutive cycles a buyer may skip. Omit it for no limit. The count resets after a paid renewal.

awaiting_billing_schedule.description: True while an active or trialing subscription on an external billing schedule has no next billing date.

billing_anchor_day.description: UTC day of the month used for monthly and yearly billing. Applies only to Flint-owned schedules.

billing_interval_count.description: Number of billing_interval units between charges. Changes with billing_interval.

billing_schedule_owner.description: Who supplies billing dates: flint advances the schedule after each paid renewal; external uses dates you supply. Change it with billing_schedule on PATCH /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the subscription, in this order: cancel, pause, resume, reactivate, update_payment_method, retry_payment, update_delivery, skip, update_billing_interval, update_quantity, swap_items, then renew, under the store's buyer policy. The available cancel and pause actions carry the choices they accept. A buyer's read or change through a customer session on /v1/me, or in Flint's buyer account, lists all twelve every time; a merchant read gets an empty list. update_payment_method is required while a payment is past due, due by next_retry_at when a retry is scheduled, and when the card expires before next_billing_at, due by then.

cancel_at_period_end.description: True when the subscription is scheduled to cancel at scheduled_cancel_at. Schedule with POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel; undo with PATCH and cancel_at_period_end false.

cancellation_details.description: Who asked to cancel, when, and why. Present once a cancellation is requested, whether it takes effect at the end of the billing period or right away. Omitted when no one asked, and removed when a scheduled cancellation is undone. See cancellation_reason for voluntary and payment-related cancellations.

cancellation_reason.description: Why the subscription is canceled or scheduled to cancel. Uses cancellation_details.requested_by when recorded, payment_failed for a canceled subscription without a requester, and other for a scheduled cancellation without a requester. Omitted otherwise.
x-enum-descriptions: Payment failed without a recorded cancellation request.
A cancellation is scheduled without a recorded requester.

contract_end_at.description: When the recorded contract term ends. Does not move when the subscription pauses or changes plan. Flint does not stop the buyer from canceling earlier.

contract_start_at.description: When the recorded contract term started. Does not move when the subscription pauses or changes plan.

delivery.description: Saved delivery preference with the current delivery method display. Write responses use the same display as GET: fixed shipping reflects the current method configuration, and quoted shipping shows the last paid shipping amount when available.

delivery_hold.description: Current delivery issue that blocks collection. Mutually exclusive with upcoming_delivery_hold.

early_termination_fee_money.description: The fee in the recorded contract terms. Present whenever those terms include a fee. It applies only to a cancellation before contract_end_at. Flint never charges it. Later plan changes do not change this fee.

last_payment_error.description: Why the latest subscription renewal payment failed. Omits merchant remediation and sensitive decline signals.

code.description: Flint-normalized payment failure code. Unknown provider values are returned as payment_failed.

failed_at.description: Time the payment attempt concluded in failure.

line_items.description: What each renewal bills. Plan edits do not change it. Adding, changing or swapping a line takes that variant's current catalog price, which then stays until the line changes again.

missed_billing_at.description: The billing date whose payment failed, as an RFC3339 timestamp. Present only while status is past_due.

next_billing_at.description: When Flint next starts a scheduled renewal charge, as an RFC3339 timestamp. Present only while a trialing or active subscription has a billing date and isn't set to cancel at the end of its period. Absent when no renewal is scheduled: a paused subscription resumes at scheduled_resume_at, a past_due one reports the failed billing date in missed_billing_at and retries at next_retry_at, an incomplete one retries at next_retry_at, a scheduled start begins at starts_at, one set to cancel ends at scheduled_cancel_at, and an external schedule awaiting a date reports awaiting_billing_schedule.

next_retry_at.description: Recorded automatic payment retry time. Null when no retry time is available.

open_renewal_order_id.description: ID of the paid renewal order whose shipment has not been dispatched. It keeps its committed delivery destination after preference changes and cancellation. Absent when no such renewal order exists. Only renewal orders count; the signup order is not included.

outstanding_money.description: Unpaid balance of the failed renewal order, including tax, shipping and discounts, after payments and credits. Present only while status is past_due and a positive balance remains.

pause_reason.description: Why the subscription is paused: merchant for a pause made with your API key or dashboard, buyer for the buyer's own pause, delivery_action_required for a pause during or after a delivery hold, and payment_failed when renewal payment retries ran out and your dunning settings pause the subscription. Omitted when the subscription is not paused.

payment_method_id.description: The saved payment method renewals charge. Change it with PATCH.

promotions.description: Recurring promotions applying to the next charged cycle. Empty when none apply; signup-only and exhausted promotions are excluded.

quantity.description: How many of each line the subscription bills each period, as a whole number; fractional quantities are not supported. A change applies from the next renewal that has not been paid.

recurring_subtotal_money.description: What one billing period's items cost before discounts, shipping, and tax: each line's price with modifiers, times quantity. It changes when items, quantity, or the plan change; editing the plan doesn't change it. For the next charge, use a subscription preview in next_renewal mode.

resume_requested_at.description: When Flint accepted a pending resume request. Set only while paused with a resume Flint has not applied yet. Clears when Flint resumes the subscription or refuses the request.

scheduled_cancel_at.description: When the scheduled cancellation takes effect: trial_end_at while trialing, current_period_end_at while active, or next_retry_at while past_due. Null when cancel_at_period_end is false or no cancellation time is available.

scheduled_resume_at.description: When a pause with a length (pause_duration_cycles) resumes on its own: that many billing intervals after paused_at. Null when the subscription is not paused or the pause has no length, such as a pause until you resume it or the pause Flint starts when a delivery hold runs out.

service_location.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

starts_at.description: When a scheduled start's first billing period begins. Present only until that first payment succeeds.

x-enum-descriptions: In the free trial. Nothing has been charged.
Current. After a trial it is active while the first charge runs.
A charge failed and Flint is retrying, or waiting for a new payment method.
The first period's payment is being collected, or is held (see delivery_hold and inventory_wait). Don't provision yet.
Created with a scheduled start. Nothing is charged before starts_at. At starts_at Flint collects the first period; it becomes active once paid, or past_due if the payment fails.

subscription_plan_id.description: Subscription plan ID. Omitted when terms_type is subscription_offer.

terms_type.description: Terms come from the subscription plan in subscription_plan_id, or from subscription offers identified on each offer line by subscription_offer_id.
x-enum-descriptions: Terms come from the subscription plan in subscription_plan_id.
Terms come from subscription offers; each offer line carries subscription_offer_id. There is no subscription_plan_id.

upcoming_delivery_hold.description: Delivery issue forecast for the next renewal at renewal_at. Mutually exclusive with delivery_hold.

BuyerSubscriptionCancellationDetails.description: The cancellation request behind a scheduled or completed cancellation.

reason_code.description: The reason the requester chose. Omitted when none was given.

requested_by.description: buyer: the buyer, in Flint's buyer account or with a customer session. merchant: a merchant credential, such as an API key or the dashboard.

BuyerSubscriptionLineItem.description: An item included in a customer's recurring purchase.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

x-enum-descriptions: Sold from a product variant, named by variant_id.

BuyerSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: A retry of a past-due payment on the buyer's subscription. Includes, when available, the buyer's order and a failure they can act on. Omits the store's idempotency keys and payment attempt IDs.

BuyerSubscriptionPlanLineItem.description: A line item of a subscription plan as a buyer sees it: the product, bundle, or variant, quantity, unit price, and swap variants.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

swap_variants.description: Current sellable alternatives in swap_variant_ids order, excluding the line's own variant and variants priced in a different currency. Present on variant lines, including an empty array.

BuyerSubscriptionPreview.description: Available subscription delivery methods shown to the buyer.

delivery_methods.description: Present in delivery_options mode ([] when no method applies); absent in create mode.

BuyerTip.description: A tip on a buyer's order, with its requested, effective, settled, and refunded amounts and how it was allocated to payments.

CancelPaymentIntentRequest.description: The request body for: Cancel payment intent.

expected_version.description: Optional expected version of this resource. A stale value returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with the current version. Retrieve the resource and rebuild the request before retrying.

CancelPayoutRequest.description: The request body for: Cancel a payout.

CancelReturnDispositionRequest.description: The request body for: Cancel return disposition.

CancelReturnLineItemRequest.description: The request body for: Cancel return line item.

handback_quantity.description: How many of the canceled units the buyer no longer has to send back, as a whole number; fractional quantities are not supported. Lowers return_required_quantity. Omit it to lower it only as far as the canceled quantity requires.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

CancelReturnRequest.description: The request body for: Cancel one of the current buyer's Returns; Cancel return.

CancelReturnResolutionRequest.description: The request body for: Cancel return resolution.

CancelSubscriptionRequest.description: The request body for: Cancel one of the current buyer's subscriptions; Cancel subscription.

cancel_immediately.description: When true, ends the subscription now. Otherwise, schedules cancellation at trial_end_at while trialing, current_period_end_at while active, or next_retry_at while past_due, instead of that charge. An active subscription with an expired renewal delivery hold ends now. A scheduled, incomplete, or paused subscription, or a past_due subscription without next_retry_at, requires cancel_immediately: true; otherwise returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason period_end_unavailable. A buyer may cancel immediately when the store allows buyer_chooses or no scheduled cancellation time is available. Under end_of_period, a trial continues until trial_end_at.

cancellation_comment.description: Free text about the cancellation, up to 500 characters after surrounding spaces are trimmed. Recorded in cancellation_details.comment, which only merchant credentials read.

cancellation_reason_code.description: Optional. Why the subscription is being canceled. When the store lists customer_account.buyer_capabilities.cancellation_reasons, a reason a buyer sends must be one of them; merchant credentials may send any code. Recorded in cancellation_details.reason_code.

CapabilityReadiness.description: Merchant capability readiness for a payment or money movement capability.

capability.description: Flint-owned capability name. Payment capabilities describe transaction acceptance readiness; money movement capabilities describe payout and balance movement readiness.

domain.description: Product domain this capability belongs to: payments for payment acceptance or money_movement for balances and payouts.

next_actions.description: Actions that can remediate or refresh this capability when Flint can suggest one.

requirements.description: Merchant requirements that affect this capability.

status.description: Current readiness status for this capability.

amount_money.description: Amount to capture, in the authorization's currency. Omit it to capture all of capturable_money. A smaller amount is a partial capture: Flint releases the rest in the same request, and the payment intent can't be captured again. Must be greater than zero and at most capturable_money. Affirm payments can only be captured in full.

expected_version.description: Optional expected version of this resource. A stale value returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with the current version. Retrieve the resource and rebuild the request before retrying.

CardDetails.description: Card details on a payment method: brand, expiration month and year, last four digits, and the wallet when one was used.

cash_out_reference.description: Your reference for the cash you paid the buyer outside Flint, such as a receipt number. Required; 1 to 255 characters. The value is preserved exactly as sent.

expected_version.description: The gift card version last read. The command changes this card only when its current version matches.

targeting_reference_count.description: Number of live targeting references that prevent deleting the category.

name.description: Category name recorded with this reference.

billing_interval.description: Send with billing_interval_count to choose a target plan option. Omit both to keep the current interval.

billing_interval_count.description: Required when billing_interval is sent; billing_interval is required when this field is sent.

billing_starts.description: now bills a new period with credit for unused paid item time. next_renewal changes the plan immediately and keeps the current paid period and next billing date.
