is_email_cleared.description: True when the buyer explicitly cleared the email, including before entering one. Saving an email resets it to false. Do not restore a prefilled email while true.

is_phone_cleared.description: True when the buyer explicitly cleared the phone, including before entering one. Saving a phone resets it to false. Do not restore a prefilled phone while true.

phone.description: Phone supplied for the buyer, in E.164 format. Null when no phone is saved; is_phone_cleared distinguishes an explicit clear.

updated_at.description: When the buyer last changed the saved checkout contact. Omitted on order buyer contact.

CheckoutBuyerContactInput.description: Buyer contact to supply with payment or save during checkout. Send at least one field. Values are stored exactly as sent, so an email with surrounding spaces is rejected. Checkout session updates keep omitted fields and accept null to clear a field. Payment requests do not accept null.

email.description: Email for the buyer, such as buyer@example.com. On checkout session updates, null clears the saved email.

phone.description: Phone for the buyer, in E.164 format, such as +14155551234. On checkout session updates, null clears the saved phone.

CheckoutBuyerFields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

address_autocomplete_enabled.description: Whether checkout offers address suggestions while the buyer enters an address.

require_billing_address.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's billing address.

require_email.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's email address. Subscription plan sessions always require email, so only true is allowed with type: subscription_plan.

require_phone.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's phone number.

CheckoutCustomTextConfig.description: Custom text shown in checkout: an order summary message and a shipping address label.

CheckoutCustomTextWriteConfig.description: Custom checkout text you supply when creating a checkout session: an order summary message and a shipping address label.

CheckoutCustomerPrefill.description: Details the buyer's checkout can prefill from the customer it acts for.

billing_address.description: The customer's default billing address. Omitted when the customer has none.

shipping_address.description: The customer's default shipping address. Omitted when the customer has none.

shipping_recipient_name.description: Recipient name saved with the customer's default shipping address. Present only with `shipping_address`; omitted when that address was set on the customer without a saved recipient.

CheckoutDeliveryPinnedDependency.description: A delivery dependency pinned to a checkout, such as the assigned method, eligibility, or pricing callback, with the revision it was pinned at.

location_geography_version.description: Version of the Location geography used by this assignment or dependency.

CheckoutDerivedDeliveryResource.description: The delivery options Flint derived for a checkout as a buyer sees them: choice groups, input requirements, and evaluation status.

input_requirements.description: Inputs the checkout's delivery methods need. Once the checkout has a delivery quote, these are the quote's input_requirements. Before that, they come from the methods alone and name no choice group: the fields in each method's quote_input_fields, and each recipient field a method requires.

merchant_diagnostics.description: Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

CheckoutGiftCardChallenge.description: A URL to load in an iframe when applying a gift card returns `GIFT_CARD_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED`.

url.description: Load this URL in an iframe on page_origin when applying a gift card returns GIFT_CARD_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED. On a hosted session, Flint's checkout loads it for you, so you don't need to do anything. The page posts a single-use proof to your page; send it in Flint-Gift-Card-Challenge. Treat the URL as opaque. It stays the same for the session and stops working when the session ends.

CheckoutLegalConfig.description: Legal settings for a checkout: whether buyers must accept terms, and links to the terms, refund policy, shipping policy, and contract.

CheckoutLegalConfigInput.description: Legal settings you supply when creating a checkout session: whether buyers must accept terms, and links to the terms, refund policy, shipping policy, and contract.

CheckoutMerchantSupport.description: The merchant's support contact. Each field is omitted when the merchant has not set it.

url.description: Support page, as an absolute http or https URL.

CheckoutPaymentConfig.description: Payment settings for a checkout: the enabled payment options and a note shown with payment.

CheckoutPaymentConfigInput.description: Payment settings you supply when creating a checkout session: the enabled payment options and a note shown with payment.

CheckoutPaymentMethodSave.description: A card the buyer saved with the checkout's payment by giving a mobile phone number. It works for nothing until the buyer confirms it with a code: request one with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications and purpose confirm_saved_payment_method.

email_confirmation_required.description: True while status is pending after the buyer confirmed the number by text, when the number alone can't save the card: the customer with the buyer's email existed before this payment, the buyer did not confirm that email in this checkout, and the number isn't already the customer's saved number with an active card saved with it. The buyer confirms the email with an emailed code to finish; the card is then saved with the number, which replaces the customer's saved number.

expires_at.description: When a pending save stops waiting: 24 hours after the payment succeeded or was approved.

phone_last_digits.description: Last two digits of the number the buyer gave, which a code is texted to. Set while status is pending.

CheckoutPrefill.description: Contact details and addresses to fill in for the buyer, who can change them. For a customer with saved addresses, Flint fills in any address you leave out, and reads include it. With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

CheckoutPrefillInput.description: Contact details and addresses to fill in for the buyer, who can change them. For a customer with saved addresses, Flint fills in any address you leave out, and reads include it. With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

CheckoutProblemResource.description: A problem with a checkout session, such as a stale delivery selection, with its `code`, whether it blocks completion, and remediation.

x-enum-descriptions: The delivery quote or selection behind this checkout is out of date. Create a new delivery quote.
The delivery selection expired, was released, or was replaced. Create a new delivery quote and select an option.
Flint could not read the checkout's delivery. Read the session again when remediation.retry is same_request; otherwise follow the remediation next action.
Another payment for this order is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then read the checkout session again.

CheckoutPromotionConfig.description: Promotion settings for a checkout: whether automatic promotions apply and whether the buyer can apply promotion codes.

codes_enabled.description: Object-level override for whether this checkout's buyer can apply promotion codes, hosted or headless. Hosted checkout shows or hides code entry to match. Omit to inherit checkout.promotion_codes_enabled. True allows codes when the merchant's promotion settings allow them; false blocks them for this checkout.

CheckoutQuickPayItemInput.description: A single custom item to charge on a checkout session, supplied as `quick_pay_item`: a name, an amount, and optional tax settings.

CheckoutRecoveryEmailSettings.description: Checkout reminder email settings. On update, an omitted field keeps its value.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after the buyer last changed their email or phone before sending the reminder. Must be a multiple of 60. Defaults to 3600.

enabled.description: Whether Flint sends checkout reminders. Turning them on requires a business address on the merchant, which the reminder prints; without one the update returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason configuration_required and the merchant reference.

CheckoutRedirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

cancel_url.description: Where the buyer goes when they leave checkout without paying. The session stays open until it expires. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

expired_url.description: Where Flint sends a buyer who opens the session after it expires. Without it, the buyer sees Flint's expired-checkout page. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

success_url.description: Where the buyer goes after paying. Flint adds checkout_session_id and order_id query parameters, replacing any with those names. The redirect doesn't prove payment: confirm with the order.paid webhook or by reading the session. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

CheckoutRedirectsInput.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

cancel_url.description: Where the buyer goes when they leave checkout without paying. The session stays open until it expires. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

expired_url.description: Where Flint sends a buyer who opens the session after it expires. Without it, the buyer sees Flint's expired-checkout page. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

success_url.description: Where the buyer goes after paying. Flint adds checkout_session_id and order_id query parameters, replacing any with those names. The redirect doesn't prove payment: confirm with the order.paid webhook or by reading the session. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

CheckoutSavedPaymentDetailsSettings.description: Saved payment details settings for hosted checkout. On update, an omitted field keeps its value.

enabled.description: Whether hosted checkout shows buyers an unchecked option to save the card they type. A card is saved only when the buyer checks it and the payment succeeds, with usage on_session: Flint charges it only in checkouts the buyer completes, never for subscriptions, automatic invoices, or other charges without the buyer. Checkout never shows the option when customer accounts are merchant hosted, or for invoice, subscription, and return checkouts.

CheckoutSession.description: A session in which a buyer completes an order's payment.

buyer_contact.description: Contact the buyer entered in checkout before paying, saved with the session's checkout credential. Separate from merchant-supplied prefill and customer_prefill from the customer record. Omitted until the buyer saves or clears a field. When a checkout session payment omits buyer_contact.email or buyer_contact.phone, Flint uses these values. Flint clears the contact 30 days after the session ends, and when a customer linked to the session is deleted.

buyer_fields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

can_save_payment_method.description: Whether checkout offers the buyer the option to save the card they type for faster checkout at this merchant. When true and save_payment_method_requires_verification is false, PayOrder accepts save_payment_method: true for one newly collected card. False when the merchant turned checkout.saved_payment_details off, customer accounts are merchant hosted, card is not an available payment option, the checkout collects an invoice, a subscription, or a return, or the checkout acts for no customer and Flint cannot email the buyer a verification code. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

can_save_payment_method_with_phone.description: Whether the buyer can save the card they type by giving a US or Canadian mobile phone number with the payment, in save_payment_method_phone on POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay, and confirming it with a texted code after paying. True while Flint can send texts and either save_payment_method_requires_verification is true, so the number replaces confirming an email before paying, or the checkout acts for the customer whose email the buyer confirmed with this credential, so the number joins that customer's saved details once the buyer confirms it. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

closed_reason_message.description: The note supplied when the checkout session was closed.

customer_id.description: The customer of the session's order. Omitted when the order has none. A checkout credential issued for this session acts for this customer. Add expand=customer to include the customer.

customer_prefill.description: Contact and default addresses of the customer the checkout acts for, with the recipient name on its default shipping address: the customer the merchant created the session for, or the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. Present on GET and PATCH responses while the session is open and acts for a customer. Separate from merchant-supplied prefill and buyer_contact saved by the buyer. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

delivery_method_ids.description: Immutable delivery method assignment captured when the checkout was created.

delivery_pinned_dependencies.description: Immutable configuration lineage used to evaluate delivery quotes.

delivery_selection_required.description: Whether the order has at least one remaining quote-resolved fulfillment choice that must be selected before payment.

expires_in_seconds.description: The lifetime the session got. expires_at is its deadline. Omitted for invoice sessions, which take their deadline from the invoice.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

fulfillment.description: Current fulfillment choices for Flint-owned pricing. External pricing reports requires_explicit_quote; reading this field does not request a delivery quote. Omitted when the session is not open, has no order, or Flint cannot read its delivery.

gift_card_challenge.description: Where the buyer completes a gift card challenge for this checkout. Returned on single-session reads, session create and update responses, checkout launch results, and customer verification confirmation results while the session is open and can show the challenge. Omitted from lists, webhooks, expanded resources, and delivery selection results.

is_in_recovery.description: Whether this terminal session credential is temporarily restricted to recovering its owning payment attempt.

merchant_icon.description: The merchant's square icon, shown in browser tabs and compact headers. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_logo.description: The merchant's logo. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_name.description: The merchant's business name, which hosted checkout shows when `theme.title` is unset. Reads `Merchant` when the merchant has not set a business name. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_support.description: How the buyer can reach the merchant for help: the support email, phone, and URL the merchant set. Present on GET and PATCH responses when the merchant set at least one of them. Show it where your checkout tells the buyer to contact the merchant, such as an expired or closed checkout, or your receipt. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page that renders this embedded checkout. Omitted when not set.

payment_collection.description: Guidance for collecting a payment source. Checkout-credential reads include it only while the session is open. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

payment_link_image.description: The current image of the payment link that opened this session. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when that link has an image; other responses and webhooks omit it.

payment_method_save.description: The card the buyer saved with this checkout's payment by giving a mobile phone number, and whether they confirmed it. Present on GET and PATCH responses after a payment that paid the order in full, or that was approved for the merchant to capture later, and saved a card this way. A checkout whose payment is approved stays open until the capture. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

payment_return_url.description: Embedded sessions only. Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

payments.description: Configured payment options for merchant credentials; currently available payment options for the checkout credential.

prefill.description: Contact details and addresses to fill in for the buyer, who can change them. For a customer with saved addresses, Flint fills in any address you leave out, and reads include it. With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

problems.description: Named conditions that affect checkout completion. Follow each problem's remediation action instead of reconstructing delivery lifecycle rules in the client. payment_in_progress means another payment for the order must finish before this checkout can complete. When Flint cannot read the checkout's delivery, the read still succeeds and reports delivery_unreadable; its remediation says whether reading the session again can succeed, and its next action's reason_code names the error.

recovery_expires_at.description: RFC3339 deadline for the restricted payment-attempt recovery window.

recovery_payment_attempt_id.description: Payment attempt that this checkout credential may recover while is_in_recovery is true.

redirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

save_payment_method_requires_verificatio.description: Whether the buyer must confirm their email with a code before the checkout can save their card or use their saved cards. True when can_save_payment_method is true and the checkout acts for no customer for this credential: the merchant created it without one, and either the buyer has not confirmed an email with this credential, or the customer whose email they confirmed has since changed that email or been deleted. A credential other than the one a confirmation returned, such as the hosted checkout link opened on another device, reads true. Send the code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications. False while the checkout acts for a customer, and whenever can_save_payment_method is false. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

save_payment_method_types.description: What save_payment_method keeps, present when can_save_payment_method is true: card, a card the buyer types into checkout. Show the save option with that payment method only. A pay request that sends save_payment_method: true with Apple Pay, Google Pay, a bank account, or Affirm, through a confirmation token created with setup_future_usage none, still pays, and its payment attempt's payment_method_save reports not_saved. The values can grow. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

setup_collection.description: Guidance for collecting a payment method to save. Checkout-credential reads include it only while the session is open. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

show_flint_mark.description: Whether Flint's hosted pages show the Powered by Flint mark for this merchant. `false` when the merchant's agreement with Flint removes it. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

x-enum-descriptions: The buyer can pay through the session.
The session collected the full amount due.
The session collected part of the amount due.
The session's deadline passed before it completed.
Another action ended the session; terminal_reason explains why.

subscription_terms.description: Renewal terms a subscription checkout commits the buyer to. Frozen when the session's order was created, so later plan changes do not alter them. Absent when the checkout starts no subscription.

x-enum-descriptions: The buyer pays on Flint's hosted checkout page.
The buyer pays through a presentation on the merchant's site.

tax.description: The session's tax settings. Omitted when the session sets none.

terminal_reason.description: Why the session ended. The checkout credential can still read its own closed or expired session; every other call returns CHECKOUT_SESSION_NOT_OPEN. order_paid_elsewhere applies only to invalidated sessions when payment succeeds or partially succeeds outside the session. order_mutated applies when an edit closes or completes its order, or ends an invoice, return-resolution, or subscription-plan session. Other merchant edits keep hosted and embedded sessions open. A session already past expires_at ends with expired before the edit is applied.
x-enum-descriptions: Payment collected the full amount due.
Payment collected part of the amount due.
An order edit ended the session.
A replacement checkout session took its place.
Payment outside the session collected the order.
Payment outside the session collected the invoice.
The amount due on the invoice changed.

theme.description: The theme checkout renders with: your branding settings, with the session's `title`, `primary_color`, and `accent_color` over them. A session sets only those three; the other fields come from branding settings. Omitted when neither sets a value.

type.description: What the session collects payment for, fixed at creation.
x-enum-descriptions: Pays an order that existed before the session, including a return resolution's replacement order.
Pays the order Flint created from quick_pay_item.
Signs the buyer up for subscription_plan_id. Flint created the order from the plan.
Started from the payment link in payment_link_id.

url.description: Hosted checkout URL that carries a one-time launch credential. Send the buyer here to pay. Present only for hosted sessions read with a merchant credential that can manage checkout sessions. Launch results include it for hosted sessions: create, payment-link resolve, and invoice and return-resolution checkout. Omitted for embedded sessions.

version.description: Persisted version of this resource's owned state. Expanded resources and external observations can change independently.

CheckoutSessionCustomerVerification.description: A request for a checkout verification code. A request with channel email reads the same whether or not Flint sent a code.

channel.description: How the code reached the buyer: email or sms.

checkout_session_customer_verification_i.description: ID to confirm the code with.

checkout_session_id.description: The checkout session the code belongs to.

email.description: The address the code is for, lowercased: the email the buyer typed, or for an emailed confirm_saved_payment_method code, the customer's email masked to its first character and domain, such as a•••@example.com. Omitted for a texted confirm_saved_payment_method code.

expires_at.description: When the code stops working: 15 minutes after the request for an emailed code, and 10 minutes after the text provider first sent a texted code, which a new request within them texts again.

phone_last_digits.description: Last two digits of the number a texted code went to, so the buyer knows which phone to check. Set only for channel sms.

purpose.description: Why the buyer asked for the code, as sent in the request.

CheckoutSessionTax.description: Tax settings of a checkout session: whether it collects tax and any tax location the merchant fixed.

enabled.description: Whether the session collects tax, as set when it was created.

location_fixed_by_merchant.description: The tax location your order already held when this session was created over it. Hosted checkout shows it and does not ask the buyer for another. Omitted when the buyer may give or change the location.

checkout_auth_token.description: Checkout credential. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <checkout_auth_token>. Present on checkout launch and customer binding confirmation; omitted when a saved-card confirmation keeps the current credential.

CheckoutSessionWithSecret.description: The checkout session with its checkout credential. For hosted checkout, send the buyer to url. For embedded checkout, pass checkout_auth_token to your checkout client.

CheckoutSettings.description: Merchant defaults for checkout: custom domain, delivery methods, expiration, payment options, required contact fields, promotion codes, recovery email, and saved payment details.

default_delivery_method_ids.description: Default delivery methods for checkout creation requests that omit delivery_method_ids, payment links without delivery_method_ids, and invoice checkouts. The default applies only when the order has items to deliver; otherwise no methods are assigned. Methods and their dependencies must be active when saved. Send [] to clear this default; null is rejected. Each checkout pins its assigned methods when created.

default_expires_in_seconds.description: Default lifetime in seconds for generic checkout sessions. Invoice checkout sessions instead use the fixed deadline of the active invoice public-link generation.

promotion_codes_enabled.description: Merchant default for whether a checkout session's buyer can apply promotion codes, hosted or headless; hosted checkout shows or hides code entry to match. Object-level promotion_config.codes_enabled can override it for a session or payment link.

recovery_email.description: Patch object: fields you send are applied, fields you omit are unchanged. Checkout reminder email: one email to a buyer who entered an email address in hosted checkout and left without paying. Merchant scope only. Effective settings default it to off with a 3600 second delay.

saved_payment_details.description: Patch object: fields you send are applied, fields you omit are unchanged. Whether hosted checkout offers buyers the option to save the card they type for faster checkout at this merchant. Merchant scope only. Effective settings default it to on.

CheckoutSubscriptionRecurringShipping.description: Recurring shipping charged on a checkout's subscription: the delivery method name, whether the price is fixed or quoted, and the amount.

CheckoutSubscriptionTerms.description: Renewal terms a subscription checkout commits the buyer to. Frozen when the session's order was created, so later plan changes do not alter them.

billing_interval_count.description: Number of billing intervals between recurring charges.

contract_term_months.description: The term agreed with the buyer, in months, when configured. Flint records it on the subscription and does not stop the buyer from canceling earlier.

delivery_required.description: Whether any line in the subscription plan's frozen checkout terms requires delivery. Available before delivery selection. One-time order lines do not affect this value.

early_termination_fee_money.description: The fee agreed for canceling before the recorded term ends, when configured. Flint records it on the subscription but never charges it.

plan_name.description: Plan name shown to the buyer.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

recurring_total_money.description: Charge for one billing interval before tax: each line's unit price times its quantity, plus modifiers.

setup_fee_money.description: One-time fee charged with the first payment, when the plan has one.

subscription_plan_id.description: Flint subscription plan ID the terms come from.

trial_period_days.description: Days before the first recurring charge, when the plan has a trial.

CheckoutSubscriptionTermsInput.description: Subscription terms you set on a checkout session: billing interval, interval count, and quantity.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

CheckoutTaxConfig.description: Whether tax is collected for a checkout session or payment link.

CheckoutTaxLocation.description: A tax location: country and postal code, with address lines, city, and state when set.

city.description: City of the tax location, when set.

line1.description: First line of the tax location's address, when set.

line2.description: Second line of the tax location's address, when set.

postal_code.description: Postal code used to calculate tax.

state.description: State, province, or region of the tax location, when set.

CheckoutTheme.description: Colors, corner radius, font family, and title that style a checkout, taken from the session or link theme or the merchant's branding settings.

accent_color.description: Accent color, from the session or link theme, or from branding settings.

background_color.description: Page background color from branding settings, as a six-digit hex value such as `#ffffff`.

corner_radius.description: Corner radius in pixels from branding settings, from 0 to 32. 0 is a square corner.

font_family.description: Font family from branding settings. New values may be added.

primary_color.description: Primary color, from the session or link theme, or from branding settings.

text_color.description: Text color from branding settings, as a six-digit hex value.

title.description: Title shown in place of the merchant's business name.

CheckoutTipConfig.description: Tip settings for a checkout: whether tips are enabled, the percent or fixed amount options, the default tip, and custom tips.

custom_tip_enabled.description: Whether buyers can enter a custom tip amount.

default_smart_tip_money.description: The preselected fixed tip, with a positive amount in the same currency as smart_tip_money_options. Its amount and currency must match one of the effective smart_tip_money_options: the ones sent here, or else the ones inherited from tipping settings. An inherited preselection that isn't one of the effective options is dropped.

default_tip_percent.description: The preselected tip percent, from 1 through 100 with at most four decimal places. Must match one of the effective tip_percent_options: the ones sent here, or else the ones inherited from tipping settings. An inherited preselection that isn't one of the effective options is dropped, and checkout preselects no tip.

smart_tip_money_options.description: Three fixed tips to offer, each with a positive amount. On a checkout session they must use the session's currency. On a payment link they must share one currency, and a checkout opened from the link offers only those in its currency.

smart_tips_enabled.description: Whether checkout offers fixed tip amounts instead of tip percentages.

tip_percent_options.description: Three tip percents to offer, each from 1 through 100 with at most four decimal places.

CloseCheckoutSessionRequest.description: The request body for: Close checkout session.

expected_version.description: Optional expected version of this resource. A stale value returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with the current version. Retrieve the resource and rebuild the request before retrying.

reason_message.description: Your note explaining why you are closing the checkout session. It is not shown to the buyer.

CloseOrderRequest.description: The request body for: Close order.

collected_money_behavior.description: Send keep to close while keeping collected money. Required when collected money remains refundable to its original tenders, after pending refunds. Closing does not refund money, and the order remains refundable. Accepted when nothing was collected.

expected_version.description: Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.

reason_message.description: Your note explaining why you are closing the order. It is not shown to the buyer.

CollectInvoiceRequest.description: The request body for: Collect invoice.

CollectInvoiceResult.description: The invoice is the primary resource and expected_version target; invoice_payment_attempt records the collection outcome.

CompleteReturnRequest.description: The request body for: Complete return.

ConfigurationVersionRequest.description: The request body for: Revoke an API key.

code.description: The six-digit code from the email or the text.

ConfirmCustomerVerificationRequest.description: The request body for: Confirm a customer email verification.

ConfirmEmailChangeRequest.description: The request body for: Confirm an email change.

ConfirmPaymentIntentRequest.description: The request body for: Confirm payment intent.

expected_version.description: Optional expected version of this resource. A stale value returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with the current version. Retrieve the resource and rebuild the request before retrying.

payment_source_token.description: Opaque processor or browser payment source token.

save_payment_method.description: On /confirm, saves cards only for standalone payment intents. Saves the card this confirmation collects for the payment intent's customer, with usage off_session, so you can charge it later without the buyer: subscriptions, automatic invoices, or the customer's default. Send true only when the buyer agreed to that on your page. Requires customer_id on the payment intent, a card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay credential in stripe.confirmation_token (created with setup_future_usage off_session) or payment_source_token, and payments.payment_methods.write. Flint saves the card once the payment is approved, sends payment_method.activated, and sets payment_source.card.payment_method_id. If the bank asks the buyer to authenticate, current_payment_action carries it; that one authentication also covers the saved card. For order-owned payment intents, POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay saves only on_session cards using the checkout session's own credential.

expected_version.description: Optional expected version of this resource. A stale value returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with the current version. Retrieve the resource and rebuild the request before retrying.

payment_method_id.description: Saved Flint payment method ID belonging to the customer making this payment.

save_payment_method.description: On /confirm, saves cards only for standalone payment intents. Saves the card this confirmation collects for the payment intent's customer, with usage off_session, so you can charge it later without the buyer: subscriptions, automatic invoices, or the customer's default. Send true only when the buyer agreed to that on your page. Requires customer_id on the payment intent, a card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay credential in stripe.confirmation_token (created with setup_future_usage off_session) or payment_source_token, and payments.payment_methods.write. Flint saves the card once the payment is approved, sends payment_method.activated, and sets payment_source.card.payment_method_id. If the bank asks the buyer to authenticate, current_payment_action carries it; that one authentication also covers the saved card. For order-owned payment intents, POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay saves only on_session cards using the checkout session's own credential.

CreateCheckoutSessionConfirmSavedPayment.description: After a payment that sent save_payment_method_phone, the buyer confirms the card it saved. Channel sms texts the number given with the payment; channel email emails the customer's email only when it matches the payment's email, otherwise returning 409. The response masks the email. Send no email. Available on the paid session, or an open session whose payment is approved for later capture, while payment_method_save.status is pending. A texted code saves the card with the number when the payment created the customer, the buyer confirmed their email in this checkout, or the number already opens their saved details; otherwise payment_method_save.email_confirmation_required becomes true and an emailed code finishes the save. An emailed code alone saves the card by email.

Use HTTPS and a lowercase DNS hostname. Do not include a path, query, fragment, or default port. In test mode, localhost, names ending in .localhost, and 127.0.0.1 also work over HTTP or HTTPS.

Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

CreateCheckoutSessionSavePaymentMethodVe.title: Verify an email to save a payment method

CreateCheckoutSessionUseSavedPaymentMeth.description: The buyer asked to use details saved at this merchant. By auto, the default, Flint texts the number saved with the email's details, or emails a code when they have cards saved by email and no number; otherwise it sends nothing and returns CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_SENT. The response's channel says which. By email, Flint sends a code only when the email has saved details and an active card saved by email or with a number; the response is the same either way. By sms, Flint texts the saved number or returns CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE. Auto and sms reveal whether the email has saved details; sms also reveals the number's last two digits. Always offer email alongside sms. A texted code opens only cards saved with that number; an emailed code opens only cards saved by email.

CreatePaymentLinkRequest.description: The request body for: Create payment link.

buyer_fields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

checkout_session_expires_in_seconds.description: Seconds each checkout session the link starts stays open, from 60 to 86,400. Omit it to use your checkout settings, or 24 hours. It doesn't end the link; use sales_end_at for that.

delivery_method_ids.description: Complete delivery method selection for the link. A link without delivery methods offers settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids when its order has items to deliver. Send an empty array to clear the selection. Omit it on PATCH to leave the selection unchanged. Null and duplicate IDs are not accepted.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Values can't be empty strings. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint, are not returned, and cannot be written through the public API. Metadata pairs plus custom fields must not exceed 44; 6 of the order's 50 pairs are reserved for Flint. Metadata keys and values, custom_field_ keys and largest possible answers, and Flint metadata must fit within 32768 UTF-8 bytes. Text and textarea answers are budgeted at four bytes per Unicode code point, including optional fields. Each checkbox answer is budgeted at five bytes (the length of false). If the combined budget is exceeded, lower max_length on some fields, use fewer custom fields, or reduce metadata. These limits apply to standard and plan links and are checked against the merged configuration on update.

payment_link_type.description: Payment link type. Omit to use standard. Explicit values must be standard, donation, or event; empty or padded values are invalid.

redirects.description: Where checkout sessions started from this payment link send the buyer after payment, cancellation, or expiration.

sales_end_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp after which the link stops starting checkouts and resolve returns PAYMENT_LINK_SALES_ENDED. Unset means sales do not end on their own, except that an event link without sales_end_at stops selling at event_config.event_at. A checkout opened before the end can still start payment for up to 15 minutes after it.

destinations.description: Default destinations for allocations Flint plans. Allowed with full, amount without tender_allocations, and targets. Each key defaults to original, and a key for a tender absent from the refund has no effect. Not allowed with tender_allocations or gift_card_load_id; use destination on each explicit allocation. new_gift_card on a payment intent is store credit and requires a payment belonging to an order. Payments without an order return 400 INVALID_REQUEST with a NOT_ALLOWED detail at destinations.payment_intent. The merchant keeps the cash and the original processing fee is not returned; no processor refund is made. New gift card codes are returned for 24 hours. The refund reports each result in tender_allocations, without echoing destinations.

x-enum-descriptions: The card can no longer receive credits.
The card was reported lost or stolen.
The refund could not be funded.
Your available balance could not cover the refund.
The card issuer declined the credit.
The refund was stopped at the merchant's request.
The payment is under dispute, or a bank return took the money back first. The buyer already has it through their bank.
On partially_succeeded: one or more payment refunds failed. Read payment_refunds.

status.description: Summary of payment_refunds and tender_allocations. Only failed is final: succeeded and partially_succeeded can still change when a bank rejects a refund after accepting it. Follow refund.updated.
x-enum-descriptions: At least one payment refund or tender allocation is still in progress.
Every payment refund and tender allocation succeeded. Can still become partially_succeeded or failed after a bank rejection.
Some payment refunds or tender allocations succeeded and the rest failed or were canceled. failure_reason is payment_refund_failed. Can still become failed.
No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again.

CreditNote.description: A correction against an issued invoice. Credit notes reduce what is owed; refunds return what was already collected.

allocated_money.description: Credit applied to the invoice, net of reversed allocations.

available_money.description: Credit available to allocate or refund. Zero on draft and void notes. On issued notes, total_money equals allocated_money plus pending_refund_money plus refunded_money plus available_money.

buyer_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

created_at.description: When the credit note was created.

invoice_id.description: The invoice this credit note corrects.

issued_at.description: When the credit note was issued. Absent on a draft.

No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again.

line_items.description: Itemized corrections against frozen invoice lines. Amount and quantity corrections share each source line's remaining value, discount, and tax across issued, non-void credit notes. Drafts reserve no credit.

memo.description: Free text shown on the credit note, up to 4096 characters. null when unset.

merchant_id.description: The merchant that owns the credit note.

pending_refund_money.description: Credit reserved by linked refunds that have not resolved yet. Released if a refund fails or is canceled.

reason.description: Why the invoice is being corrected. Shown on the credit note document.

refunded_money.description: Credit consumed by linked refunds that succeeded.

reversed_at.description: When the allocation was reversed and its credit returned. Absent while the allocation stands.

type.description: quantity credits whole units and requires quantity. amount credits a named figure and requires amount_money. The two are mutually exclusive.

CreditNoteIssueAllocationInput.description: Credit to apply to the invoice when issuing a credit note.

amount_money.description: Credit to apply. Omit to apply the smaller of the credit available after issue and the invoice's outstanding balance. An explicit amount must be positive, use the invoice's currency, and fit both balances. Either way, the allocation must leave the order's unpaid tip outstanding.

CreditNoteLineItem.description: One correction calculated from the frozen invoice line's remaining billed value, discount, and tax. The source line's inclusive or additive tax mode is preserved. Current catalog prices and tax settings do not affect the correction. Stored issued values are never recalculated by a read.

correction.description: The correction that produced this line, using the same shape accepted by draft writes. Amount corrections return the requested billed value in amount_money, equal to total_money.

credit_note_line_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the credit note line item.

discount_money.description: The credited share of the frozen line's remaining allocated merchandise discount, rounded half up in currency minor units.

invoice_line_item_id.description: The invoice snapshot line this corrects.

name.description: Label of the credited invoice line.

subtotal_money.description: Credited subtotal before the credited discount, in the source line's inclusive or additive price units. Balances the total after tax and discount are rounded from the remaining pool; it is not a rounded per-unit price.

tax_money.description: The credited share of the frozen line's remaining tax, rounded half up in currency minor units. Included tax is already part of total_money. Tax-exclusive consideration is total_money minus tax_money.

total_money.description: Billed value credited by this line. For inclusive tax, subtotal_money minus discount_money. For additive tax, subtotal_money minus discount_money plus tax_money. A full remaining-value correction consumes the exact remaining components.

CreditNoteLineItemInput.description: A credit note line you supply when creating or updating a credit note: the invoice line item it credits and how much, or an existing line to keep.

correction.description: How much of the invoice line to credit, by quantity or by amount.

credit_note_line_item_id.description: Existing credit note line item to retain. Omit to create a new line item.

invoice_line_item_id.description: The invoice snapshot line to credit.

CreditNoteRefundInput.description: Refund details you supply when issuing a credit note: the reason, an optional message, and an optional amount.

amount_money.description: Credit to refund. Omit to refund all available credit, which Flint resolves once when it accepts the request.

reason.description: Why the refund is being made.

CustomDomain.description: A merchant hostname for hosted checkout or customer account pages.

active_payment_attempt_count.description: Payment attempts in progress on this checkout hostname; null for customer account domains.

created_at.description: When this domain resource was created, in RFC3339 format.

dns_records.description: DNS records to add for setup or verification. For an archived hostname, records that can be deleted.

hostname.description: Configured hostname, normalized to lowercase without a trailing dot.

last_checked_at.description: When the domain was last checked, in RFC3339 format; null when no check time is available.

payment_method_domain_id.description: Payment method domain associated with this hostname, or null when none is reported.

redirect_expires_at.description: End of the redirect window for an archived hostname. After archive, dns_records lists records you can delete.

status.description: Current setup and availability state of the hostname. Archived domains retain their resource identity.

status_reason.description: Machine-readable detail for the current status, or null when no reason is reported.

type.description: Whether the hostname serves checkout pages or the customer account Flint hosts.

updated_at.description: When this domain resource was last updated, in RFC3339 format.

CustomDomainDNSRecord.description: A DNS record for configuring or verifying a custom hostname.

name.description: DNS name at which to publish this record.

type.description: DNS record type to publish, such as cname or txt.

value.description: DNS record value to publish at name.

email.description: Customer email, or null when the customer has none. Unique among the environment's customers.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this customer in an external system, or null when none. Not returned to customer sessions.

internal_note.description: Internal note about this customer, or null when none. Not returned to customer sessions.

is_merchant_verified.description: Flag you set on the customer, for example after checking ID in store. Promotion and delivery rules can match it. Flint does not set it; it is unrelated to customer verifications, which prove a buyer controls an email address.

name.description: Customer name, or null when none.

phone.description: Customer phone number, or null when none.

segment.description: Free-form label you assign, such as wholesale, so promotion and delivery rules can match groups of customers. It is not an ID; Flint does not check it against any resource. Null when none. Not returned to customer sessions.

x-enum-descriptions: The customer can be changed and used for new purchases.
Deletion was approved and is in progress. The customer can't be changed, charged, or signed in to.
The customer's personal data was erased. Only its ID, created_at, and the records that reference it remain. It can't be changed or restored.

CustomerAccountPresentation.description: How a customer account is presented: its account name and custom domain. Send null to clear a value.

CustomerAccountRouteTemplates.description: Route templates for a merchant-hosted customer account: email preferences, invoice, order, return, and subscription pages. Send null to clear one.

CustomerAccountSettings.description: Customer account settings: hosted mode, merchant account URL, presentation, route templates, and what buyers may do to their own subscriptions.

buyer_capabilities.description: Replaced as a whole: send every field you want to keep. What buyers may do to their own subscriptions in Flint's buyer account or through a customer session, in either mode. Merchant credentials are not bound by it. Buyers can always cancel. Written as a whole: an update that includes buyer_capabilities replaces the stored value, and each field it omits takes its default. Effective settings include every default.

presentation.description: Patch object: fields you send are applied, fields you omit are unchanged.

route_templates.description: Patch object: fields you send are applied, fields you omit are unchanged.

CustomerAddress.description: An address saved on a customer's profile.

phone.description: E.164 phone number. Limited to 30 characters (Unicode code points).

CustomerDeletionRequest.description: A request to delete a customer's personal information.

retention_policy.description: What deletion keeps. `retain_required_commerce_records`: orders, invoices, credit notes, payments, and refunds stay for accounting, tax, and disputes, without the customer's email address or phone number. Issued invoices and credit notes keep the buyer name, billing address, and tax ID they were issued with, because tax law requires them. Orders keep the delivery recipient's name and address. Contact copies created while deletion is finishing are erased within minutes, with another check about 24 hours later.

CustomerEmailDeliverySettings.description: For each kind of customer email, whether Flint sends it or the merchant sends it.

CustomerEmailPreferences.description: A customer's email preferences: checkout reminders and shipping updates.

checkout_reminders.description: A reminder after leaving checkout without paying.

customer_id.description: Flint customer ID fixed by the customer session.

shipping_updates.description: Emails about shipments and deliveries, such as shipped, out for delivery, and delivered.

CustomerReceivableBalance.description: A customer's outstanding and overdue amounts in one currency.

CustomerReceivables.description: A customer's receivable balances by currency and when they were observed.

CustomerSession.description: A session granting a customer access to their saved details.

expires_at.description: When the current secret stops authenticating account calls.

revoked_at.description: When the session was first revoked. Present exactly when status is revoked.

status.description: active means the session can be refreshed and its secret works until expires_at; revoked means none of its credentials work.

refresh_token.description: Single-use refresh token. Returned only on create and refresh; retry rotation with the same Idempotency-Key.

secret.description: Current server-held customer session secret. Returned only on create and refresh.

CustomerSessionWithSecret.description: A customer session with its `secret` and `refresh_token`, returned only when the session is created or refreshed.

CustomerSessionsRevocation.description: The result of revoking a customer's sessions: the customer ID and how many sessions were revoked.

CustomerVerification.description: An email verification requested for linking guest purchases.

status.description: pending while the code can be confirmed; confirmed while an unused proof can link purchases; used after linking; expired when the code or proof expires.
x-enum-descriptions: The code has not been confirmed and has not expired.
The code was confirmed and the unused proof has not expired.
The verification was used to link purchases.
The code or confirmed proof expired.

DecideReturnInspectionLineItemRequest.description: The request body for: Decide return inspection line item.

x-enum-descriptions: The inspected units were accepted for the Return.
The inspected units were rejected for the Return.
The inspected units need a merchant's acceptance decision.

expected_version.description: Optional version of the return inspection. A stale value returns VERSION_CONFLICT with the inspection ID and its current version.

DecideReturnRequest.description: The request body for: Decide return.

completion_mode.description: Omit to use the mode shared by all pinned policies that set completion_mode, or automatic when no pinned policy sets one. Conflicting pinned policy modes return 400 naming completion_mode only when completion_mode is omitted. An explicit manual or automatic value is used as sent.
x-enum-descriptions: The merchant completes the Return after every completion blocker clears.
Flint completes the Return when every completion blocker clears.

DeclinePaymentReviewRequest.description: The request body for: Decline a payment review.

add_to_block_lists.description: Add the payment's card fingerprint, email and IP address to Flint's default block lists, so later payments with any of them are blocked. Values the payment didn't have are skipped. Defaults to false.

DeliveryAddressAdvisoryResource.description: An address verification result for a delivery address or buyer location. `suggested_address` may offer a correction.

suggested_address.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

DeliveryAddressInput.description: An address you supply for delivery quotes, previews, and selections.

state.description: State, province, or region. State conditions read it as a subdivision of the address's country: send its code with or without the country prefix, such as NY or US-NY. In the US and Canada, the English name, such as New York, also matches. US addresses also accept the USPS military codes AA, AE, and AP. If the address country is listed by a state condition but state names no subdivision of that country, the condition cannot be decided: the method or rate is left out as cannot_calculate (invalid_buyer_input).

DeliveryAddressResource.description: An address as returned on delivery quotes, selections, previews, and pickup locations.

DeliveryArrivalEstimate.description: The estimated arrival date range for a delivery option, as calendar dates in the option's timezone.

earliest_date.description: Calendar date in the option timezone. Do not parse it as a UTC timestamp.

latest_date.description: Calendar date in the option timezone. Do not parse it as a UTC timestamp.

DeliveryAvailability.description: When a delivery method can be scheduled: weekly intervals, blackout intervals, lead time, and how far ahead a buyer can book.

preparation_lead_time_seconds.description: Notice the merchant needs before a window starts, in seconds. A buyer can choose a window until this long before it starts. Quotes offer only windows that can still be chosen, so a window already under way is not offered.

DeliveryBlackoutInterval.description: A local start and end time during which a delivery schedule offers no windows.

DeliveryBusinessDayRange.description: A minimum and maximum number of business days, used in transit time estimates.

DeliveryBuyerLocationInput.description: The buyer's location for pickup or local delivery, supplied as an address or a coordinate, chosen by `type`.

DeliveryBuyerLocationResource.description: The normalized buyer address or coordinate used for this quote.

DeliveryBuyerLocationResourceAddress.description: The normalized buyer address or coordinate used for this quote.
DeliveryBuyerLocationResourceAddress.title: DeliveryBuyerLocationResourceAddress

DeliveryBuyerLocationResourceCoordinate.description: The normalized buyer address or coordinate used for this quote.
DeliveryBuyerLocationResourceCoordinate.title: DeliveryBuyerLocationResourceCoordinate

DeliveryCalculatedPricingStrategy.description: Delivery pricing calculated from a base fee, distance, weight, and per-item handling, with minimum and maximum fees, by currency.

base_fee_currency_options.description: Base delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

maximum_fee_currency_options.description: Maximum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

minimum_fee_currency_options.description: Minimum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

per_item_handling_fee_currency_options.description: Handling fee per item by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

DeliveryCalculatedPricingStrategyInput.description: Calculated delivery pricing you supply for a delivery method: base fee, distance and weight rates, per-item handling, and fee limits, by currency.

base_fee_currency_options.description: Base delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

maximum_fee_currency_options.description: Maximum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

minimum_fee_currency_options.description: Minimum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

per_item_handling_fee_currency_options.description: Handling fee per item by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

DeliveryCallbackPricingStrategyInput.description: Delivery pricing you supply that comes from a delivery rate callback (`delivery_rate_callback_id`), with minimum and maximum fees by currency.

maximum_fee_currency_options.description: Maximum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

minimum_fee_currency_options.description: Minimum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

DeliveryCallerSuppliedPricingStrategyInp.description: Delivery pricing where you supply the rate when creating a delivery quote, bounded by minimum and maximum fees by currency.

maximum_fee_currency_options.description: Maximum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

minimum_fee_currency_options.description: Minimum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

DeliveryCandidateOutcomeResource.description: The result of evaluating one delivery method for a choice group, selected by `type`: available with an option, unavailable, input required, cannot calculate, or requires checkout context.

failure_category.description:
Why Flint could not calculate the method and the action that can make calculation succeed.
- `dependency_failure`: Retry after the dependent service recovers.
- `timeout`: Retry after the timed-out dependency recovers.
- `malformed_response`: Fix the callback response so it matches the documented response schema, then retry.
- `callback_transport_failure`: Restore callback DNS, TLS, network connectivity, and response timing, then retry.
- `callback_circuit_open`: Restore the callback and wait for circuit recovery before retrying.
- `callback_result_invalid`: Fix the callback result fields or values identified by the callback logs, then retry.
- `callback_unavailable`: Retry when callback capacity is available, restore the configured callback endpoint, or choose a non-callback pricing strategy.
- `pricing_failure`: Fix the method pricing configuration or matching rate, then retry.
- `schedule_failure`: Fix the method schedule, timezone, or requested window, then retry.
- `option_lifetime_too_short`: Lower the method's minimum option lifetime below the quote's remaining lifetime. A quote for a cart with tracked inventory lasts just under 5 minutes.
- `geography_failure`: Fix the destination, origin, or geographic configuration, then retry.
- `routing_failure`: Fix inventory routing or origin assignment, then retry.
- `invalid_configuration`: Correct the invalid delivery configuration identified by diagnostics, then retry.
- `invalid_buyer_input`: Correct the buyer input identified by the outcome, then retry.
- `address_verification_failed`: Correct the address fields rejected by verification, then retry.
- `address_could_not_be_verified`: Confirm or correct the address, or retry when address verification is available.

- `inventory_unavailable`: Choose an origin or method backed by available inventory.

DeliveryCountryCondition.description: A delivery eligibility condition that matches when the address country is one of `values`.

subject.description: Address facts tested by this condition. destination_address is the shipping destination. buyer_location is the buyer's current pickup or local-delivery location.

DeliveryCustomerBooleanCondition.description: A delivery eligibility condition that tests a true or false fact about the customer against `value`.

DeliveryCustomerSegmentCondition.description: A delivery eligibility condition that matches customers in one of the listed segments (`values`).

DeliveryDistance.description: A distance as a `value` in meters, kilometers, or miles.

DeliveryDistanceUnitPrice.description: A distance rate for calculated delivery pricing: a price by currency for each `unit_quantity` of `unit`.

unit_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity of the selected unit charged at each configured currency price; fractional quantities are not supported.

DeliveryDistanceUnitPriceInput.description: A distance rate you supply for calculated delivery pricing: a price by currency for each `unit_quantity` of `unit`.

unit_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity of the selected unit charged at each configured currency price; fractional quantities are not supported.

DeliveryEligibilityExpression.description: A boolean expression containing exactly one operator or typed condition at each node. Expressions support at most 8 levels and 100 total nodes.

customer_merchant_verified.description: Matches the is_merchant_verified flag you set on the customer against value.

customer_segment.description: Matches the free-form segment you assign to the customer against values.

DeliveryEligibilityMismatch.description: An eligibility condition that rejected a delivery method, with its condition type, its path in the expression, and the field tested.

condition.description: The configured eligibility condition family that did not match.

expression_path.description: The condition's path in the configured eligibility expression, starting at $.

field.description: The eligibility fact evaluated by the condition. Buyer fact values are not included.

negated.description: Whether the condition matched inside a not expression and therefore rejected the method.

DeliveryEstimateRule.description: How a delivery method estimates timing, chosen by `type`: no estimate, a transit time, or a schedule window.

DeliveryEstimateRuleInput.description: The timing estimate rule you supply for a delivery method, chosen by `type`: none, a transit time, or a schedule window.

DeliveryExternalPricingStrategy.description: Delivery pricing that comes from outside Flint, from a delivery rate callback or the caller, bounded by minimum and maximum fees by currency.

maximum_fee_currency_options.description: Maximum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

minimum_fee_currency_options.description: Minimum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

DeliveryFixedPricingStrategy.description: A fixed delivery price, by currency.

DeliveryFixedPricingStrategyInput.description: A fixed delivery price by currency, supplied for a delivery method.

DeliveryFulfillmentDetails.description: Details of a local delivery fulfillment: courier, timing window, instructions, and tracking. Some fields are omitted for credentials that don't act for the verified customer.

carrier.description: Carrier responsible for the local delivery.

courier_pickup_at.description: Time at which the courier collected the order.

courier_pickup_window_duration_seconds.description: Width of the promised courier pickup window, from 0 to 86400 seconds.

courier_provider_name.description: Delivery network or merchant fleet provider handling the job.

courier_support_phone.description: Buyer-safe support number for the courier or merchant fleet.

delivered_at.description: When the items were delivered, in RFC3339 format.

dispatched_at.description: When the delivery was dispatched, in RFC3339 format.

dropoff_notes.description: Driver-facing notes for the final handoff. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

expires_at.description: Deadline after which an undelivered job should enter merchant review.

external_delivery_id.description: Stable delivery job ID owned by the courier or merchant dispatch system.

instructions.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

no_contact.description: Whether the buyer requested a no-contact handoff. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

prep_time_duration_seconds.description: Expected preparation time before courier pickup, from 0 to 86400 seconds.

ready_at.description: Time at which the order became ready for courier pickup.

service_area_id.description: Delivery service area assigned to this fulfillment.

timezone.description: Timezone used to display the local delivery window.

tracking_url.description: Absolute HTTPS carrier tracking URL. Embedded URL credentials are rejected. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

window_end_at.description: End of the promised delivery window, in RFC3339 format.

window_start_at.description: Start of the promised delivery window, in RFC3339 format.

DeliveryInputConstraint.description: The rules for an input a delivery method needs, chosen by `type`, such as allowed values, length limits, supported countries, or offered time windows.

DeliveryInputRequirement.description: An input a delivery method needs, such as an address field or time window, with its `field_path`, purpose, and constraint.

DeliveryInventoryAssignmentRequest.description: Assigns a quantity of an inventory item at a location to a demand when creating a delivery quote.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

DeliveryInventoryReservationSummary.description: The inventory reservation held for a delivery selection: its owner, status, expiry, and the next action required.

DeliveryLocalDeliveryDetails.description: Details of a local delivery option: instructions and service level.

DeliveryLocationSet.description: The locations available to a delivery method.

configuration.description: Current member Locations and selection rules.

created_at.description: Time the location set was created.

current_delivery_location_set_revision_i.description: Immutable revision used for new quotes.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata.

name.description: Merchant-facing location set name.

status.description: Current location set lifecycle status.

updated_at.description: Time the location set last changed.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version for location set writes.

DeliveryLocationSetConfiguration.description: The location IDs in a delivery location set.

DeliveryLocationSummaryResource.description: A pickup location shown on a delivery option: its name, address, instructions, and timezone.

DeliveryMerchantDiagnostic.description: A merchant-only diagnostic explaining why a delivery method produced no option, with its outcome, recommended action, and eligibility mismatches.

code.description:
Stable reason the method did not produce an option.
- `eligibility_no_match`: The configured eligibility expression excluded the method.
- `method_unavailable`: The method was unavailable for this evaluation.
- `input_required`: The buyer or caller must provide more information to evaluate the method.
- `checkout_context_required`: A checkout session is required to evaluate the method.
- `dependency_failure`: Flint could not check whether the method is available.

configuration.description: Current eligibility, pricing, origin, estimate, and tax configuration.

current_delivery_method_revision_id.description: Immutable revision currently used for new quotes.

description.description: Optional buyer-facing description.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata.

recommendation_priority.description: Marks this method as recommended. Within each choice group, the available method with the lowest value is recommended and listed first. Ties go to the lower display_position, then the method ID. Null never recommends the method.

charge_tax_category.description: Tax category of the delivery charge, which decides its automatic tax and appears in tax records and reporting. code.description:
Stable reason a configured pickup location was left out of the results or cannot supply the order.
- `pickup_location_inactive`: The Location is inactive, so it was left out.
- `pickup_location_geography_unavailable`: The Location has no usable published geography, so it was left out.
- `pickup_location_inventory_unavailable`: The Location does not allocate inventory, so it cannot supply the order's tracked items. It is listed with an unavailable outcome. Items without tracked inventory need no allocation.
- `pickup_location_dependency_failure`: Flint could not resolve the configured Location.

DeliveryPostalCodeCondition.description: A delivery eligibility condition that matches the address postal code against exact or prefix `values`.

subject.description: Address facts tested by this condition. destination_address is the shipping destination. buyer_location is the buyer's current pickup or local-delivery location.

values.description: Postal codes, each with its country. Flint compares codes in uppercase without spaces or hyphens. An exact value matches that code, and a prefix value matches every code that starts with it. A five-digit ZIP code in the US or a US territory also matches the ZIP+4 codes within it, so 07030 matches 07030-5788, which address verification returns for a full address. A ZIP+4 value matches only that ZIP+4.

DeliveryPostalCodeValue.description: A postal code or postal code prefix with its country, used in a postal code condition.

A method that waits on the buyer's address or store, or on an address the buyer must correct, already lists the recipient fields it requires. Those requirements name the method's choice group and have no delivery_option_ids.

DeliveryProfileConfiguration.description: Whether delivery planning applies to items under a delivery profile, and if so the allowed delivery types, resolution mode, origin policy, packing rules, weight, and dimensions.

allowed_types.description: Required as a non-empty unique list when requirement is required. quote accepts shipment, pickup, and local_delivery. manual accepts digital and service.

combination_policy.description: Required for quote resolution and forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual. Controls which delivery obligations can share a choice group.

origin_policy.description: Required for quote resolution and forbidden for none or manual resolution. fixed_location requires location_id. inventory_routing forbids location_id and applies only to tracked inventory. method_origin forbids location_id.

requirement.description: Whether delivery planning applies. none forbids every other configuration field. required also requires resolution_mode and allowed_types, plus the fields required by that resolution mode.

resolution_mode.description: Required when requirement is required. quote plans physical delivery and requires origin_policy, combination_policy, and splitting_policy. manual supports digital and service items and forbids physical planning fields.

splitting_policy.description: Required for quote resolution and forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual. Controls whether a line item quantity can be split across delivery assignments.

covers_all_items.description: True when this is the physical catalog default and every active physical catalog obligation uses it.

execution_legs.description: Where the group's items leave from, one leg per origin Location, when all of its methods leave from the same Locations. Omitted when the origin depends on the chosen method, such as shipping from a warehouse or picking up at a store. Each option then lists its own execution_legs.

method_types.description: Types of the delivery methods that can serve this group's items, each listed once, in the order the methods display. A type is listed before its options are priced, such as a local delivery that waits for the buyer's address, and stays listed while its methods need more input or cannot serve the current input. options lists what the buyer can choose now. A method whose type these items do not allow is left out, and the list is empty when no method can serve them.

DeliveryQuoteExecutionLegResource.description: One leg of a delivery choice group, identifying the origin Location the group's items leave from.

DeliveryQuoteLineItemResource.description: An order line item, or one bundle component of it, and the quantity covered by a delivery choice group.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

DeliveryQuoteMethodResource.description: A delivery method offered in a delivery quote, with its name, type, display position, and revision.

recommendation_priority.description: Marks this method as recommended. Within each choice group, the available method with the lowest value is recommended and listed first. Ties go to the lower display_position, then the method ID. Null never recommends the method.

DeliveryRadiusCondition.description: Eligibility condition that matches when the destination or buyer location is within `maximum_distance` of an origin, measured in a straight line.

subject.description: Address facts tested by this condition. destination_address is the shipping destination. buyer_location is the buyer's current pickup or local-delivery location.

DeliveryRadiusOrigin.description: The point a radius condition measures from: a specific Location (`location_id`) or the delivery method's own origin (`method_origin`).

The result must be a configuration you could create. Requires expected_version. An empty configuration is invalid.

DeliveryRateCallbackConnectionCheck.description: Result of checking the connection to a delivery rate callback endpoint, with its status, latency, HTTP status code, and failure category if it failed.

failure_category.description:
Why the callback connection check failed and the action that can make the next check succeed.
- `authentication_or_http_error`: Return a 2xx status for a signed request. A 401 usually means the wrong secret or a body parsed before verification.
- `blocked_target`: Use a public HTTPS callback target allowed by Flint's outbound network policy.
- `connection_error`: Restore network connectivity to the callback host, then test again.
- `dns_error`: Fix the callback hostname or its DNS records, then test again.
- `invalid_response`: Return a 2xx application/json response within maximum_response_bytes. For a test delivery, the body must also follow the callback response rules. Then test again.
- `request_error`: Flint couldn't complete the request for another reason. Check the URL and your server logs, then test again.
- `timeout`: Acknowledge the callback within its configured timeout, then test again.
- `tls_error`: Fix the callback certificate and TLS configuration, then test again.
