buyer_contact.description: Buyer contact recorded on the order, including guest contact when retained. Omitted when the order has no recorded contact.

closed_at.description: When the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at the transition and never changed.

closed_reason.description: Why the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at closure. Unrecognized reasons are returned as other; new values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection completed, including zero-balance completion through POST /pay.
A merchant closed the order through POST /close.
The order's invoice was marked uncollectible.
A newer subscription renewal attempt replaced this unpaid order.
The return resolution that created this replacement order was canceled.
The stored closure reason is not recognized.

created_at.description: When the order was created, in RFC3339 format.

customer_id.description: Customer associated with the order, when one is set.

fulfillment_status.description: Aggregate progress across the order's fulfillment quantities.
x-enum-descriptions: No quantity has been fulfilled or canceled.
Some quantities have been fulfilled and others remain.
Every quantity was fulfilled or canceled.

order_id.description: Stable identifier of the expanded order.

order_number.description: Human-readable order number for receipts and merchant reference.

payment_intent_ids.description: Payment intents associated with the order.

payment_status.description: Collection progress. An invoice write-off also completes collection without receiving the written-off amount.
x-enum-descriptions: Part of the total was collected and a balance remains.
Collection is complete, including when the remaining invoice balance was written off.

pricing_amounts.description: Order totals before accounting for collected payments and refunds.

settlement_amounts.description: Payments, refunds, credits, and amounts still owed for the order.

status.description: Whether the order still accepts changes and new payments. Refunds, fulfillment, disputes, returns, and metadata or note edits continue on a closed order.
x-enum-descriptions: You can edit the order and collect payment.
The order no longer accepts changes to what was sold or new payments; closed_reason says why.

updated_at.description: When the order was last updated, in RFC3339 format.

ExpandedOrganizationSummary.description: An organization's summary fields, such as its name, status, and parent, returned when the organization is expanded.

status.description: Current status. Archived: deleted. API keys can no longer read or list the organization.
x-enum-descriptions: Archived: deleted. API keys can no longer read or list the organization.

ExpandedPackageSummary.description: A package's summary fields, including carrier, tracking, status, and supported actions, returned when the package is expanded.

created_at.description: When the package was created, in RFC3339 format.

delivered_at.description: When the package was delivered, in RFC3339 format.

expected_delivery_at.description: When the carrier or merchant expects this package to arrive. Null when no estimate is set. Retained after delivery as history. This estimate is separate from the fulfillment's promised shipment window.

fulfillment_id.description: Fulfillment whose items are in the package.

package_id.description: Stable identifier of the expanded package.

service_code.description: Carrier service used for the package.

shipped_at.description: When the package was shipped, in RFC3339 format.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

ExpandedPaymentIntentSummary.description: A payment intent's summary fields, including amount, status, and capture method, returned when the payment intent is expanded.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

capture_method.description: When money is collected. Defaults to automatic.
x-enum-descriptions: The payment is collected when it is confirmed.
Confirming places a hold. Capture all or part of it, or cancel it, before authorization_expires_at.

customer_id.description: Customer linked to this payment intent.

order_id.description: Order this payment intent belongs to. Create it through the order and confirm it with POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay. Capture and cancel use POST /v1/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/capture or /cancel for every payment intent. Order-owned intents accept PATCH for metadata and external_reference_id.

payment_intent_id.description: Flint payment intent ID.

payment_source.description: Summary of the card or bank account used for the payment. Absent until a payment source is attached.

refund_status.description: How much of captured_money has been refunded, including value issued as store credit, based on refunded_money.
x-enum-descriptions: Part of captured_money has been refunded.
All of captured_money has been refunded.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. The payment_intent.updated event reports changes into this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. The confirm result's current_payment_action describes a standalone payment's step; call confirm with an empty body to retrieve it again. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.
A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent.

available_payout_methods.description: Payout methods available through Flint for this destination. Only standard is currently available.

status.description: Current status. Archived: deleted, and still readable by ID.

arrival_date.description: Calendar date the bank is expected to receive the funds, in YYYY-MM-DD format using the UTC date of the expected arrival.

balance_source_type.description: Balance source this payout draws from. Flint chooses the source when balance_source_type is omitted at create. Clients must accept source types added in future releases.

method.description: Payout method. instant can appear on imported payouts; unmapped methods are returned as other.

delivered_at.description: When the shipment was delivered, in RFC3339 format.

direction.description: Whether the shipment sends items to the buyer or returns items to the merchant.

handed_off_at.description: When the carrier accepted the shipment, in RFC3339 format.

package_count.description: Total number of packages attached to the shipment, including voided packages.

return_id.description: ID of the Return this shipment sends back. Present only on return shipments.

ExpandedSubscriptionPlanSummary.description: A subscription plan's summary fields, including name, billing interval, currency, and status, returned when the plan is expanded.

status.description: Active plans accept new signups. Inactive plans refuse new signups with PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE while existing subscriptions keep renewing. Archived plans are read-only and their status is set only by DELETE /v1/subscription-plans/{subscription_plan_id}.

ExpandedSubscriptionSummary.description: A subscription's summary fields, including status, billing period, and next billing time, returned when the subscription is expanded.

next_billing_at.description: When Flint next starts a scheduled renewal charge, as an RFC3339 timestamp. Present only while a trialing or active subscription has a billing date and isn't set to cancel at the end of its period. Absent when no renewal is scheduled: a paused subscription resumes at scheduled_resume_at, a past_due one reports the failed billing date in missed_billing_at and retries at next_retry_at, an incomplete one retries at next_retry_at, a scheduled start begins at starts_at, one set to cancel ends at scheduled_cancel_at, and an external schedule awaiting a date reports awaiting_billing_schedule.

x-enum-descriptions: In the free trial. Nothing has been charged.
Current. After a trial it is active while the first charge runs.
A charge failed and Flint is retrying, or waiting for a new payment method.
The first period's payment is being collected, or is held (see delivery_hold and inventory_wait). Don't provision yet.
Created with a scheduled start. Nothing is charged before starts_at. At starts_at Flint collects the first period; it becomes active once paid, or past_due if the payment fails.
Terms come from the subscription plan in subscription_plan_id.
Terms come from subscription offers; each offer line carries subscription_offer_id. There is no subscription_plan_id.

File.description: An image uploaded to Flint. Create the file, PUT its bytes to upload.url with upload.headers, then complete it. Attach a ready file with images[].file_id on a catalog resource or file_id in a branding image field. A ready unattached file expires after 24 hours; attachment removes that deadline. Each upload has its own file_id, including uploads of identical bytes.

content_type.description: The stored image media type when ready; the declared upload media type otherwise.

expires_at.description: When this file expires if it stays in its current status. While awaiting_upload, equals upload.expires_at. While ready and unattached, 24 hours after processing or 7 days after its last detachment. Omitted while attached and in every other status.

failure_code.description: A safe failure category, present only when failed. Unknown processing causes use processing_failed.

height.description: The stored image height in pixels, present only when ready.

size_bytes.description: The stored image size when ready; the declared upload size otherwise.

upload.description: Present only in the create response while awaiting_upload. GET never returns upload credentials. PUT bytes before upload.expires_at, then complete the file.

url.description: The canonical image URL, present when ready. Attach the file with images[].file_id, or copy this URL into source_url on another resource.

width.description: The stored image width in pixels, present only when ready.

FileUpload.description: The signed upload target for a file: the URL, HTTP method, headers to send, and when the URL expires.

expires_at.description: When the signed upload URL expires, 15 minutes after creation. Create a new file if it expires.

headers.description: Headers to send verbatim with the upload.

url.description: A signed upload target. Send the bytes with method and headers verbatim; keep the URL out of logs.

status.description:
Current fulfillment lifecycle status. Read supported_actions for available transitions.
- `pending`: Work has not started and has not been accepted. Approval may be required before work can begin.
- `accepted`: The provider accepted the fulfillment; work has not started.
- `on_hold`: Work is paused. Release the hold to restore active_hold.previous_status, or use a supported forward action.
- `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
- `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
- `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully.
- `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
- `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
- `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
- `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
- `picked`: The assigned items have been picked.
- `packed`: The assigned items have been packed.
- `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.
- `no_show`: The pickup or appointment was missed. Read outcome for the recorded reason.

GetOrCreateReturnResolutionCheckoutSessi.description: The request body for: Create a Return resolution checkout session for the current buyer; Get or create return resolution checkout session.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page where you render this embedded checkout, such as https://shop.example.com. Only this origin can show the checkout's gift card challenge and receive its result. It does not let the browser call the Flint API. Accepted only when surface is embedded. Use HTTPS and a lowercase DNS hostname. Do not include a path, query, fragment, or default port. In test mode, localhost, names ending in .localhost, and 127.0.0.1 also work over HTTP or HTTPS.

payment_return_url.description: Embedded sessions only. Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

redirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

return_url.description: Where the checkout sends the buyer after paying, such as the Return's page in the customer account. Limited to 2048 characters (Unicode code points) before trimming surrounding whitespace. It must be an HTTPS address of the merchant's customer account: /{merchant_id} on Flint's account host, the merchant's active custom account domain, or the host of customer_account.merchant_account_url when the merchant hosts the account. HTTP is accepted only for localhost in test mode. Anything else fails with INVALID_RETURN_URL. An alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on embedded checkout; keep them consistent when sending both.

surface.description: Defaults to hosted. The same surface reuses the open checkout. A different surface replaces it only while no payment is in progress; otherwise the request returns CHECKOUT_SURFACE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED.

GiftCardRedemption.description: Independent redemption resource. Operational reservations are separate from immutable posted transactions. Refund captured value with `POST /v1/refunds`, using a `tender_allocations` entry with `tender_type` `gift_card_redemption` and this redemption's ID. Refunds keep the redemption `captured` and increase `refunded_money`.

expires_at.description: When an uncaptured manual reservation expires. null for automatic capture, which posts immediately.

idempotency_key.description: Your Idempotency-Key for the command that created this record. null when Flint created it or no key was sent.

order_payment_attempt_id.description: The order payment attempt the redemption belongs to. Set for source_type flint_order; null for external.

remaining_refundable_money.description: Captured value not yet refunded. A refund allocation to this redemption can be at most this amount. Zero while the redemption is reserved, canceled, or expired.

sale_reference.description: Your reference for the sale the redemption pays for. Set for source_type external; null for flint_order.

provenance.description: When and where the stock moved. Optional; when omitted, the movements record the time Flint received the command as occurred_at and a null source_system.

expected_version.description: Transfer version the caller last read.

target_lost_quantity.description: Cumulative quantity that should be recorded as lost in transit. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

provenance.description: When and where the stock moved. Optional; when omitted, the movements record the time Flint received the command as occurred_at and a null source_system.

expected_version.description: Transfer version the caller last read.

target_returned_quantity.description: Cumulative quantity that should have returned to the origin. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

provenance.description: When and where the stock moved. Optional; when omitted, the movements record the time Flint received the command as occurred_at and a null source_system.

Invoice.description: A bill issued to a customer.

cc_emails.description: Additional recipients copied on the invoice email and every reminder.

closed_at.description: When the current closed interval began. Cleared when status returns to open or partially_paid. A direct move between closed statuses preserves this timestamp.

collection.description: How this invoice is collected, resolved when the draft is written. Send this object back when updating its collection policy.

collection_block_status.description: Whether collection is blocked. While it is inventory_blocked, collection attempts return INVOICE_COLLECTION_BLOCKED.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection is paused because items on a subscription renewal invoice ran out of inventory. Collection attempts return INVOICE_COLLECTION_BLOCKED.
The inventory block ended. Flint voids the renewal invoice when stock returns and collects the renewal on its order instead.

credit_money.description: Credit note credit allocated to this invoice, minus reversed allocations. Unallocated credit isn't included.

currently_due_money.description: The part of the balance due now. Without schedule_entries, it equals outstanding_money. With schedule_entries, it is the outstanding amount of the first entry, in schedule order, whose due time has arrived and that still has a balance, or 0 when there is none. It is the amount the next collect call or checkout session charges. To total everything past due, add the outstanding_money of the entries whose status is due or overdue. Always 0 unless the invoice is open or partially_paid.

customer.description: Summary of the billed customer. Returned only with expand=customer.

customer_id.description: Customer billed by this invoice. Absent when the invoice has no customer.

x-enum-descriptions: Flint emailed the invoice to recipient_email and sends its reminders.
You deliver the invoice and its reminders, using public_url and the invoice.reminder_due webhook.

due_at.description: When payment is due. With payment terms, issue sets it from issued_at and the terms, counted in the invoice's timezone. Absent when the invoice has no due date.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system. Use it as your sync key: it isn't printed on the invoice. null when unset.

footer.description: Fine print at the bottom of the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. null when unset.

invoice_number.description: Sequential document number assigned when the invoice is issued. Numbering is per merchant, with test and live mode numbered independently.

is_overdue.description: Whether the invoice is open or partially_paid and past due with a balance remaining. Without schedule_entries, due_at has passed and outstanding_money is above zero; with them, at least one entry is overdue. Computed when the invoice is read.

issued_at.description: When the invoice was issued. Absent on a draft.

late_fee_money.description: Late fees assessed after issue, minus waivers, including amounts since paid or written off. Itemized in late_fees.

late_fees.description: Late fees assessed on this invoice, each with its paid, waived, written-off, and outstanding amounts. late_fee_money is their assessed total minus waivers.

memo.description: Message to the customer, printed on the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. null when unset.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata.

order.description: Summary of the backing order. Returned only with expand=order.

order_id.description: The order this invoice bills. Every invoice has one; quick pay creates it.

outstanding_money.description: What is still owed: total_money + late_fee_money - paid_money - credit_money - written_off_money, never below zero. 0 on paid, credited, uncollectible, and void invoices; equal to total_money on a draft. Refunds don't change it.

paid_at.description: When the invoice most recently became paid. Cleared when status leaves paid and set again on a later paid transition.

paid_money.description: Payments collected toward this invoice, online or as recorded manual payments, minus reversed payments, including payments toward late fees. Never below zero. Refunds don't reduce it; they are in refunded_money.

payment_due.description: The resolved due-date policy. Send this object back when updating the draft; payment_terms captures the term's current revision again.

payment_terms_snapshot.description: The payment term captured on the draft, with its due date rule and late fee policy. Later changes to the payment term don't affect this invoice.

po_number.description: The buyer's purchase order number, printed on the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. null when unset.

public_url.description: The hosted invoice link where the buyer views and pays the invoice. Present after issue on API reads, except a list filtered by idempotency_key; webhook payloads leave it out. regenerate-public-link replaces it. Anyone with the link can open the invoice, so treat it as a secret.

recipient_email.description: Where Flint emails the invoice and its reminders. Email delivery requires it at issue. null when unset.

reference.description: Your reference for the invoice, printed on the invoice and PDF. The buyer's purchase order number goes in po_number. It cannot change after issue. null when unset.

refund_status.description: How much of the collected money has been refunded. It doesn't change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Some money has been refunded, less than paid_money.
Refunds have returned all of paid_money.

refunded_money.description: Money refunded to the buyer after collection. Refunds don't reopen the balance; refund_status summarizes them.

reminders_paused.description: Whether automatic reminders are paused. Set reminders_paused on PATCH /v1/invoices/{invoice_id} to change it.

reminders_paused_at.description: When automatic reminders were paused. Absent while reminders are active.

remit_to_address.description: Where the buyer sends offline payments, shown on the invoice. Defaults to the invoice settings remit-to address.

schedule_entries.description: The payment schedule, in schedule order. Always [] when the invoice has no schedule and is collected in one balance.

scheduled_issue_at.description: When Flint will issue and deliver this draft. null when no issue is scheduled. Cleared when the draft is issued or voided, or when you send null.

service_date.description: The calendar date of the billed service, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The invoice and PDF print it as written, without timezone conversion. null when unset.

snapshot.description: The billing content of the invoice: line items, discounts, charges, tip, tax, and totals. A draft previews the backing order; issue freezes it, and later order changes don't reach an issued invoice.

status.description: Current invoice status. paid and credited close the current balance and can reopen to open or partially_paid after a payment or credit allocation reversal; invoice.reopened reports that change. void and uncollectible are final. Refunds change refund_status without reopening the balance.
x-enum-descriptions: An editable invoice that has not been issued.
An issued invoice that remains open for collection.
An issued invoice with positive net collection and an outstanding balance.
The current balance is cleared and positive net collection remains. Allocated credit or waived fees can help close it. Payment or credit allocation reversals can reopen it.
A voided invoice that cannot be collected. Final.
An invoice whose outstanding balance was written off. Final.
The current balance is cleared with positive applied credit and no positive net collection. Reversing credit allocation can reopen it.

subscription_id.description: The subscription the backing order belongs to, copied when the draft is created and never changed. null when the order isn't part of a subscription.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the invoice's calendar dates, such as due dates from payment terms and reminder and late fee day counts. At issue, an invoice without one takes the invoice settings timezone.

total_money.description: What the issued invoice bills, equal to snapshot.pricing_amounts.total_money. Fixed at issue; a draft previews the backing order total. Late fees are in late_fee_money.

uncollectible_at.description: When the invoice was marked uncollectible.

version.description: Current invoice version. Send this as expected_version when updating the draft.

viewed_at.description: When the buyer first opened the invoice through its hosted invoice link. Recorded on a best-effort basis.

written_off_money.description: The balance written off when the invoice was marked uncollectible, including unpaid late fees.

InvoiceActivity.description: Read-only invoice history row for timeline rendering and debugging. Detail fields are present only on the activity types their descriptions list. The invoice and the referenced resources remain authoritative for state and money movement.

activity_type.description: What happened. other means an activity this API version doesn't describe yet. New values may be added; treat an unrecognized value like `other`.

actor_id.description: Merchant ID of the actor, when actor_type is merchant. Some system activities also carry the merchant ID.

actor_type.description: Who performed the activity: the merchant (an API key or dashboard user), the buyer, or Flint on a schedule or in response to a payment event. Absent when no actor was recorded.

amount_money.description: Amount of the payment, refund, or late fee. Present on payment_applied, manual_payment_recorded, manual_payment_reversed, refund_succeeded, late_fee_assessed, and late_fee_waived, and on updated when a card refund changed or a credit note refund was requested.

channel.description: Delivery channel. Present on delivery_sent and reminder_sent.

checkout_session_id.description: Checkout session the buyer paid through. Present on payment_attempt_started for hosted payments.

collection_block_reason.description: Why collection was blocked or unblocked. Present on collection_blocked and collection_block_resolved.

credit_money.description: Total credit applied to the invoice. Present on credited.

credit_note_id.description: Credit note that requested the refund. Present on updated when a credit note refund was requested or changed.

description.description: Human-readable Flint description of the activity.

due_at.description: Due date that triggered the activity. Present on overdue, reminder_due, and late_fee_due.

error_code.description: Public error code of the failed scheduled issue. Present on issue_failed.

expected_amount_money.description: Amount the processing payment is expected to settle. Present on payment_processing.

invoice_activity_id.description: Flint invoice activity ID. IDs begin with inevt_.

invoice_delivery_attempt_id.description: The delivery attempt that sent the email. Present on delivery_sent and reminder_sent.

invoice_late_fee_id.description: The late fee. Present on late_fee_assessed and late_fee_waived.

invoice_manual_payment_id.description: The manual payment. Present on manual_payment_recorded and manual_payment_reversed.

invoice_payment_attempt_id.description: The payment attempt. Present on payment_attempt_started and payment_processing.

invoice_schedule_entry_id.description: Schedule entry the activity applies to. Present on overdue, reminder_due, late_fee_due, late_fee_assessed, and late_fee_waived when the invoice has a payment schedule.

payment_intent_id.description: Payment intent whose funds were applied. Present on payment_applied.

rail.description: Payment rail of the attempt. Present on payment_processing.

refund_id.description: Related refund. Present on refund_succeeded, and on updated when a card refund changed or a credit note refund was requested or changed. Read the refund for its current status.

to_email.description: Recipient of the email. Present on delivery_sent and reminder_sent.

written_off_money.description: Balance written off. Present on marked_uncollectible.

InvoiceAutopayRetryPolicy.description: When to retry a failed automatic invoice payment, as a list of day offsets.

InvoiceCheckoutSessionRequest.description: The request body for: Create an invoice checkout session for the current buyer; Get or create invoice checkout collection.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page where you render this embedded checkout, such as https://shop.example.com. Only this origin can show the checkout's gift card challenge and receive its result. It does not let the browser call the Flint API. Accepted only when surface is embedded. Use HTTPS and a lowercase DNS hostname. Do not include a path, query, fragment, or default port. In test mode, localhost, names ending in .localhost, and 127.0.0.1 also work over HTTP or HTTPS.

payment_return_url.description: Embedded sessions only. Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

redirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

return_url.description: Where the checkout sends the buyer after paying, such as the invoice's page in the customer account. Limited to 2048 characters (Unicode code points) before trimming surrounding whitespace. It must be an HTTPS address of the merchant's customer account: /{merchant_id} on Flint's account host, the merchant's active custom account domain, or the host of customer_account.merchant_account_url when the merchant hosts the account. HTTP is accepted only for localhost in test mode. Anything else fails with INVALID_RETURN_URL. An alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on embedded checkout; keep them consistent when sending both.

surface.description: Defaults to hosted. The same surface reuses the open checkout. A different surface replaces it only while no payment is in progress; otherwise the request returns CHECKOUT_SURFACE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED.

InvoiceCheckoutSessionResult.description: The invoice is the primary resource, with its checkout session, credential, and any invoice payment attempt.

InvoiceCollection.description: The invoice collection policy resolved at write time. The object can be sent back when updating a draft.

mode.description: How the invoice is collected, resolved when the draft was written.

mode.description: How the invoice is collected. merchant_default resolves when the draft is written, and reads return the resolved mode.
x-enum-descriptions: Use the invoice settings default_collection_mode, or buyer_initiated when it isn't set. Accepts neither payment_method_id nor payment_policy.

InvoiceDeliveryAttempt.description: One attempt to deliver an invoice by email, either the original send or a reminder, with its recipients and status.

cc_emails.description: Addresses copied on this email. Absent when none were copied.

delivery_type.description: Whether this attempt is the invoice email sent at issue or a reminder.
x-enum-descriptions: The invoice email sent when the invoice was issued.
A reminder email, sent on the reminder cadence or by send-reminder.

failure_reason.description: Present only when status is failed. Legacy failed attempts without a stored reason return rejected.
x-enum-descriptions: The email service refused the message, for example because of an invalid address.
Flint could not confirm the send. Check with support before resending.
Canceled before sending, for example because the invoice changed.

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice this delivery attempt belongs to.

sent_at.description: When the email service accepted the message. Absent until it does.

status.description: The outcome of this attempt. sent means the email service accepted the message.
x-enum-descriptions: Flint hasn't handed the email to the email service yet.
The email service accepted the message. A later bounce isn't reported.
The email wasn't sent. failure_reason says why.
Flint didn't send the email. suppression_reason says why.

suppression_reason.description: Present only when status is suppressed.
x-enum-descriptions: The merchant manages this email outside Flint.
The recipient unsubscribed from this email category.

to_email.description: Address the invoice was sent to. `null` after the customer was deleted.

InvoiceDiscount.description: A discount applied to an invoice, with its source, the discount amount, the amount actually applied, and any promotion.

InvoiceDocumentRow.description: One row of an invoice document, such as a subtotal, discount, tax, late fee, payment, or amount due, with its amount.

amount_money.description: The row's signed amount. Informational rows do not contribute to the sum.

credit_note_number.description: Number of the credit note a credit note row names.

is_informational.description: Whether the row is shown for information and left out of the sum, such as tax already included in prices, tax not applied, or money refunded to the buyer. A closing `total` or `amount_due` row is informational and states the sum. An opening or sole `total` row contributes to the sum.

name.description: Discount, charge, or tax jurisdiction name.

occurred_at.description: When the late fee was assessed or waived, or the credit note issued.

percent.description: Rate of a percent-based charge or a tax row, in percent units.

promotion_code.description: Promotion code of a discount row.

taxable_money.description: Taxable amount of a tax row.

InvoiceLateFee.description: A charge assessed because an invoice payment is overdue.

amount_money.description: The assessed fee: the policy's fixed amount, or its percent of base_outstanding_money.

base_outstanding_money.description: The unpaid balance the fee was calculated from, excluding late fees, captured at assessment.

invoice_schedule_entry_id.description: The schedule entry this fee applies to. Absent on an invoice without a schedule, where the fee applies to the whole invoice. Each invoice, or each entry, takes at most one fee, even after a waiver.

late_fee_policy.description: The late fee policy from payment_terms_snapshot, copied when the fee was assessed.

outstanding_money.description: What is still owed on this fee: amount_money - paid_money - waived_money - written_off_money, never below zero.

paid_money.description: Payments applied to this fee, minus reversed payments.

waived_at.description: When the fee was waived. Absent unless it was waived.

waived_money.description: The amount waived. A waiver removes the fee's whole outstanding amount at that time, so it is less than amount_money when part of the fee was already paid.

waiver_reason_message.description: Why the fee was waived, as given when waiving it.

written_off_money.description: The part of this fee written off when the invoice was marked uncollectible.

InvoiceLateFeePolicy.description: A late fee for overdue invoices: a fixed amount or a percentage, a grace period in days, and whether Flint applies it automatically.

application_mode.description: Whether Flint applies the one-time fee automatically after the grace period. Omission defaults to manual. Frozen when the invoice is issued.

percent.description: Percentage applied to the fee base_outstanding_money.

application_mode.description: Whether Flint applies the one-time fee automatically after the grace period. Omission defaults to manual. Frozen when the invoice is issued.

percent.description: Percentage applied to the fee base_outstanding_money.

application_mode.description: Whether Flint applies the one-time fee automatically after the grace period. Omission defaults to manual. Frozen when the invoice is issued.

percent.description: Percentage applied to the fee base_outstanding_money.

InvoiceLineItem.description: A line item on an invoice, with its quantity, unit price, discount, tax, and totals, and the product, variant, or bundle it came from.

bundle_components.description: The items inside a bundle line, as billed.

bundle_id.description: The catalog bundle the line was sold from. Absent unless source_type is bundle.

categories.description: The catalog categories of the line's item when it was billed.

description.description: Line item description as billed.

discount_money.description: This line's share of order and line-item discounts.

invoice_line_item_id.description: Flint invoice line item ID, stable across draft edits and issue while the backing order line keeps its ID. Credit notes credit lines by this ID.

name.description: Line item name as billed.

order_line_item_id.description: The backing order's line item. Tax rows in snapshot.tax_breakdowns reference the line by this ID.

product_id.description: Parent product of the line's variant. Absent on bundle and custom lines.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

selected_options.description: The product options chosen for the line, as billed.

source_type.description: The catalog item the line was sold from. Absent on custom lines.
x-enum-descriptions: Sold from a product variant, named by variant_id.
Sold from a bundle, named by bundle_id.

subtotal_money.description: base_subtotal_money + modifier_total_money. For a tax-inclusive price, it includes the tax.

tax_money.description: Tax on this line. Its rows in snapshot.tax_breakdowns give the rate and price_mode. For a tax-inclusive price, the tax is already inside subtotal_money.

total_money.description: What the line bills. For a tax-inclusive price, subtotal_money - discount_money; otherwise subtotal_money - discount_money + tax_money. In both cases the tax-exclusive value is total_money - tax_money.

unit_price_money.description: Price of one unit, before modifiers and discounts.

variant_id.description: The catalog variant the line was sold from. Absent unless source_type is variant.

InvoiceManualPayment.description: A recorded offline payment against an invoice. Its amount contributes to invoice paid_money while recorded; reversing it returns its full amount to outstanding_money. A payment can cover principal and late fees. Manual payments are separate from online payment attempts.

amount_money.description: Full amount received, including any principal and late fees covered.

invoice_id.description: The invoice this payment was recorded against.

invoice_manual_payment_id.description: Stable payment ID. IDs begin with omp_. Gift card loads funded by this payment expose this value as source.order_manual_payment_id.

payment_reference.description: Caller-owned check, wire, or bank reference, stored unmodified.

reversal_note.description: Note supplied when reversing the payment. Present only when reversed and a note was supplied.

reversed_at.description: When the payment was reversed. Present only when reversed.

status.description: Whether the payment is recorded or has been reversed in full.
x-enum-descriptions: The payment contributes to the invoice paid balance.
The payment was reversed in full and its amount returned to the invoice balance.

InvoiceManualPaymentResult.description: The recorded or reversed payment and the updated invoice. expected_version on either write fences the invoice; use the returned invoice version for the next write.

InvoicePaymentAttempt.description: An attempt to collect payment for an invoice.

canceled_at.description: When the attempt was canceled. An attempt canceled with its checkout session before payment started may not have it.

cancellation_requested_at.description: When cancellation of this attempt was last requested. It stays set when the payment processor refuses the cancellation or the payment settles first, so read status and canceled_at for the outcome.

checkout_session_id.description: The hosted or embedded checkout session the buyer pays through. Absent for automatic charges.

expected_amount_money.description: The amount this attempt collects: the outstanding balance, or the targeted schedule entry's outstanding amount.

expires_at.description: When a checkout attempt expires, matching its checkout session. Absent for automatic charges.

invoice_schedule_entry_id.description: The schedule entry this attempt collects. Absent when the attempt collects the invoice balance.

last_payment_error.description: Why the payment failed. Present only when status is failed.

payment_intent_id.description: The payment intent behind this attempt. Absent until payment starts, such as a hosted attempt the buyer hasn't paid yet.

rail.description: How the attempt collects: card, including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Affirm, or ACH debit.
x-enum-descriptions: Card, including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Affirm.

settled_at.description: When this attempt first settled successfully. Duplicate payment notifications preserve this timestamp.

status.description: Current payment attempt status. settled means this attempt completed successfully, even if the invoice still has an outstanding balance. invoice_payment_attempt.settled reports that completion.
x-enum-descriptions: Started and not yet resolved. Only one attempt per invoice is active at a time.
Payment failed. last_payment_error says why. Final.
The checkout expired before the buyer started paying. Final.
Payment was submitted and is waiting to settle, such as an ACH debit.

updated_at.description: When this attempt last changed. Duplicate payment notifications preserve this timestamp.

InvoicePaymentDue.description: The invoice due-date policy resolved at write time. The object can be sent back when updating a draft.

due_at.description: The due date set with type date. Present only with date. The top-level due_at is the effective due date for every type.

invoice_payment_term_id.description: The payment term applied, captured in payment_terms_snapshot. Present only with payment_terms.

type.description: How the due date was set.
x-enum-descriptions: The invoice has no due date.
The invoice is due at due_at.
The invoice follows the payment term invoice_payment_term_id. Issue computes the invoice's due_at from it.

due_at.description: The due date set with type date. Present only with date. The top-level due_at is the effective due date for every type.

invoice_payment_term_id.description: The payment term applied, captured in payment_terms_snapshot. Present only with payment_terms.

type.description: How the due date was set.
x-enum-descriptions: The invoice is due at due_at.

InvoicePaymentDueInput.description: When an invoice is due, used when creating or updating an invoice: no due date, a fixed time, payment terms, or a default.

discounts.description: The discounts applied to the backing order, frozen at issue.

pricing_amounts.description: The invoice's pricing totals. Its total_money is the invoice total that the top-level total_money reports.

requested_tip.description: The tip requested on the backing order, frozen at issue. Absent when none was requested.

seller_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

tax_breakdowns.description: Tax jurisdiction rows for this invoice. A draft previews the backing order's current rows; issue freezes them, and the API, hosted invoice, and PDF share the frozen rows. External tax produces these rows. Automatic tax doesn't, so an automatic-tax invoice reports its tax in pricing_amounts and each line's tax_money. On a newly issued external-tax invoice, rows sum to pricing_amounts.tax_money, and rows with price_mode inclusive sum to pricing_amounts.inclusive_tax_money. A row's order_line_item_id matches the same field on InvoiceLineItem; order_charge_id names a charge in charges. Always [] when no tax rows apply. Some older external-tax invoices have no frozen rows.

only.description: Stripe requirement paths to collect exclusively when effective_policy.targeting is targeted. They come from the targeted_requirements you sent or from Flint's remediation recommendation.

MerchantBillingBalance.description: Current Flint merchant billing balance for one billing account and currency.

merchant_billing_balance_id.description: Stable identifier for this billing account and currency balance projection.

observed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for the balance snapshot.

MerchantBillingEntry.description: An immutable merchant billing charge, credit, collection, correction, or write-off.

available_credit_effect_money.description: Signed change in available billing credit. credit_issued increases it; credit_applied and credit_refunded decrease it. Other entry types do not change it.

balance_transaction_id.description: Balance transaction for this collection or collection reversal, when present.

created_at.description: When Flint recorded the entry. Use created_after to pick up new entries, including late arrivals.

description.description: Human-readable description of the billing event.

dispute_id.description: Related dispute, when the entry is associated with a dispute.

event_fee_type.description: Event fee category. Present only for event_fee entries.

merchant_billing_entry_id.description: Stable entry ID. Re-reading an entry returns the same values.

merchant_billing_invoice_id.description: Related invoice issued by Flint, when applicable.

net_billing_effect_money.description: Signed outstanding effect minus the available credit effect. Charges and collection_reversal are positive; credit_issued, collection, custom_domain_collection, and write_off are negative; credit_refunded is positive; credit_applied is zero; correction may be positive or negative.

occurred_at.description: When the billing event happened. An entry can be recorded after entries that occurred later.

outstanding_effect_money.description: Signed change in the amount owed Flint. Charges (event_fee, invoice, custom_domain) and collection_reversal increase it; credit_applied, collection, custom_domain_collection, and write_off decrease it; correction may increase or decrease it. Credit issuance and refund do not change it.

payment_intent_id.description: Related payment intent, when the entry is associated with a payment.

related_merchant_billing_entry_id.description: Entry corrected, credited, collected, reversed, or written off by this entry, when applicable.

type.description: The billing event represented by this entry.
x-enum-descriptions: An event fee increases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
An invoice issued by Flint increases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A custom domain charge increases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A custom domain collection decreases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A correction increases or decreases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
Issued credit increases available credit without changing the outstanding balance.
Applied credit decreases the outstanding balance and available credit by the same amount.
Refunded credit decreases available credit without changing the outstanding balance.
A collection decreases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A collection reversal increases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A write-off decreases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.

MerchantBillingInvoice.description: A Flint invoice for the merchant's Flint subscription.

credit_money.description: Credit applied to the invoice: the sum of its credit line items. Never more than subtotal_money.

due_at.description: When payment of the invoice is due.

line_items.description: Invoice-owned line items. Subscription totals sum to subtotal_money; credit totals sum to credit_money.

outstanding_money.description: Part of total_money Flint still has to collect.

paid_at.description: When the invoice was paid. Removed if a reversed collection reopens it.

period_end_at.description: Exclusive invoice billing period end as an RFC 3339 UTC instant.

period_start_at.description: Inclusive invoice billing period start as an RFC 3339 UTC instant.

status.description: Collection state of the invoice. Flint issues an invoice as open and marks it paid once collected; a reversed collection returns it to open, and written_off means Flint stopped collecting it.

subtotal_money.description: Sum of the subscription line items, before credit.

total_money.description: What the invoice charges: subtotal_money minus credit_money.

voided_at.description: When the invoice was voided. Absent on invoices that weren't.

MerchantBillingInvoiceLineItem.description: One line on a merchant billing invoice, either a subscription charge or a credit, with quantity, unit price, and total.

name.description: Name of the subscription charge or credit.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

total_money.description: Unsigned line total, calculated as quantity multiplied by unit_price_money.

type.description: Whether the line adds a subscription charge or applies credit.

MerchantReadiness.description: A merchant's readiness to accept payments and receive payouts, with per-capability status and outstanding requirements.

MerchantWebhookEnvelope.description: Fields shared by merchant webhook payloads.

The merchant profile, status, API version, logo, or icon changed.
A product was created. Each variant it created sends product_variant.created.

A delivery selection became the order's committed fulfillment economics.

An invoice balance closed with positive applied credit and no positive net collection.
An invoice was issued and became open for collection.
A scheduled invoice could not be issued and remains a draft.
An invoice reached a configured late fee date.
A late fee was added to an invoice balance.
The unpaid remainder of an invoice late fee was waived.
An invoice's outstanding balance was written off as uncollectible.
A manual (offline) payment was recorded against an invoice.
A manual payment was reversed and its amount returned to the invoice balance.
An invoice passed its payment due date with an outstanding balance.
An invoice balance closed with positive net collection. Collection, allocated credit, waived fees, or reversal recovery can clear the balance.
An invoice payment attempt entered processing.
An invoice payment attempt was canceled.
An invoice payment attempt settled successfully. The payment may cover all or part of the invoice balance.
An invoice became partially paid or received another collection while a balance remained. Sent for online, gift card, and manual payments.
Part of an invoice's payment was refunded.
An invoice's payment was fully refunded.
An invoice reminder is ready to send.
An invoice balance reopened after a payment or credit allocation was reversed. The invoice is open or partially paid.
An invoice was sent to the customer.
An invoice draft, schedule, reminder settings, refund state, or other non-status detail was updated.
An invoice was voided and can no longer be paid.
An inventory claim requires a safe merchant action before commerce can continue.
An inventory count was applied and its variances were committed to inventory.
Returned units were received into Inventory, from a Return disposition or against the reservation line that consumed them.
A held or committed inventory claim became insufficiently protected.
An inventory reservation has no active held or committed quantity.
Held inventory quantity became committed order inventory.
An inventory reservation was created with exact location assignments.
A merchant-owned inventory hold reached its deadline.
Held or committed inventory quantity was released.
An inventory level has more protected claims than sellable physical stock.
An inventory transfer reached a terminal state.
Inventory in transit was recorded as lost.

Inventory in transit was returned to its origin.
The amount the merchant owes Flint or owns as account credit changed.
A merchant's payment, payout, or onboarding readiness was observed in live or sandbox mode.
Flint issued a merchant billing invoice.
A merchant billing invoice changed status.
An open order closed. closed_reason says why: paid, closed_by_merchant, checkout_expired, written_off, superseded, or return_resolution_canceled.
A fulfillment completed: every quantity it covers was fulfilled or canceled.
A fulfillment was created, by checkout or by your call.
A fulfillment event was recorded from a carrier, pickup flow, appointment system, or other fulfillment source.

A payout to the merchant's bank was created.
A payout failed and funds were returned to the balance.
A payout arrived at the merchant's bank.
A payout destination (bank account) was added.
A payout destination was removed. It stays readable by ID with status archived.
The merchant's payout schedule or settings changed.
A refund changed without entering a more specific lifecycle status.
An asynchronous report reached a terminal generation failure.
An asynchronous report completed and its authenticated CSV download is ready.
A Return completed after every required merchandise and buyer-value obligation cleared.
The merchant or policy automation recorded line-level Return decisions.

A Return or one of its line-level progress projections changed.

A Return receipt observation was superseded by an auditable correction.

A subscription trial is approaching its end.
A subscription moved to another plan, or to its plan's current lines and prices. When the change bills a new period, subscription.payment_succeeded is sent with it.

A subscription renewal needs an address, method, or rate correction before it can be charged.
A subscription delivery hold is approaching its pause date.
A subscription's delivery preference changed. Paid, unshipped renewals keep their existing destination.
A subscription billing cycle was skipped without a charge.
A subscription delivery method migration finished. Its counts and failures identify which subscriptions moved.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Values can't be empty strings. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint, are not returned, and cannot be written through the public API.

name.description: Name of the choice shown to buyers.

position.description: Display position of the choice within its group; lower values appear first.

selected_by_default.description: Whether this choice is selected when the buyer has not supplied selections for the group. A modifier set can override this value; unavailable choices are never selected by default.

show_on_fulfillment.description: Whether this modifier appears in fulfillment details.

show_on_receipt.description: Whether this modifier appears on buyer receipts.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the modifier. Only active modifiers can be offered to buyers.

taxable.description: Whether this modifier's price is taxable. A modifier set can override this value.

unit_price_delta_money.description: Amount added to the item's unit price for each unit of this modifier. A modifier set can override this value.

OnboardingAdvanceRequest.description: The request body for: Advance onboarding flow.

requested_capabilities.description: Exact initial Flint capability set. Include accept_card_payments and receive_payouts together. Optionally include accept_ach_debit_payments, or omit the field to use the card and payout default set.

OnboardingProfile.description: Contact and website details recorded for a merchant during onboarding.

OnboardingProfileInput.description: Contact and website details you submit for a merchant during onboarding. Send null to clear a field.

OnboardingStartRequest.description: The request body for: Start onboarding flow.

OnboardingStartResult.description: The result of starting onboarding: whether email verification began, plus the verification token and its expiry.

OnboardingState.description: A merchant's onboarding status, profile, next step, requested capabilities, and whether an API key can be issued.

country.description: Immutable business country for the selected stable provider-account target. Omitted until the target has selected an effective country.

requested_capabilities.description: Canonical Flint capability intent persisted on the selected stable provider-account target. The initial merchant-account configuration always includes accept_card_payments and receive_payouts and may also include accept_ach_debit_payments.

status.description: Onboarding workflow status for activation and remediation, not a durable account-readiness boolean.
x-enum-descriptions: All required onboarding steps are complete.
A person must complete the next onboarding step.
The next onboarding step requires additional information.

OnboardingVerifyEmailRequest.description: The request body for: Verify onboarding email.

OnboardingVerifyEmailResult.description: The result of verifying an onboarding email: the merchant and user, an onboarding session token, and the next step.

can_issue_api_key.description: Whether the merchant has no external API key and a default sandbox exists.

onboarding_session_expires_at.description: Expiry of onboarding_session_token. The token cannot be refreshed; verify the email again to get a new one.

Order.description: A customer's purchase and its payment and fulfillment progress.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the order, in this order: start_return, then resend_receipt. A buyer's read through a customer session on /v1/me, or in Flint's buyer account, lists both every time; a merchant read gets an empty list. A list of orders leaves start_return out, since only a read of one order checks return eligibility. start_return is due when the last open return window ends.

buyer_contact.description: Email and phone saved when payment started, from the pay request's buyer_contact or the paying checkout session's saved contact. It does not change the linked customer.

closed_at.description: When the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at the transition and never changed.

closed_reason.description: Why the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at closure. Unrecognized reasons are returned as other; new values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection completed, including zero-balance completion through POST /pay.
A merchant closed the order through POST /close.
The order's invoice was marked uncollectible.
A newer subscription renewal attempt replaced this unpaid order.
The return resolution that created this replacement order was canceled.
The stored closure reason is not recognized.

closed_reason_message.description: The caller note supplied when closing the order. System closures leave it absent. It is not shown to the buyer.

delivery_destination.description: The shipment or local-delivery destination committed for this order. Payment freezes this value; fulfillment recipient changes do not replace it. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

fulfillment_status.description: Aggregate progress across the order's fulfillment quantities.
x-enum-descriptions: No quantity has been fulfilled or canceled.
Some quantities have been fulfilled and others remain.
Every quantity was fulfilled or canceled.

governing_delivery_selection_id.description: ID of the delivery selection that governs this order, including pickup choices without a delivery destination. Read with GET /v1/orders/{order_id}; other order responses may omit this field. While present, change the destination through the delivery selection. Omitted when no selection governs the order.

inventory_exception_reason.description: Why inventory could not be committed after payment. The cause remains after resolution. Omitted when no reason was recorded. Unrecognized reasons are returned as other; new values may be added.

inventory_exception_resolution_message.description: The merchant note supplied when resolving the inventory exception. It is not shown to the buyer.

inventory_exception_status.description: Whether an inventory problem after payment needs attention.
x-enum-descriptions: Payment completed but inventory could not be committed.

inventory_reservation_id.description: The reservation holding stock for this order, when one exists.

inventory_routing_source.description: Where this order's tracked demand is routed. Required before an order containing tracked variants can hold stock.

payment_link_id.description: Payment link whose checkout created this order. Absent for orders that did not come from a payment link. Filter GET /v1/orders by payment_link_id to list a link's orders.

payment_status.description: Collection progress. An invoice write-off also completes collection without receiving the written-off amount.
x-enum-descriptions: Part of the total was collected and a balance remains.
Collection is complete, including when the remaining invoice balance was written off.

return_credit_settlements.description: Value applied to this order from items the buyer returned, such as an exchange's replacement order. Included in settlement_amounts.paid_money.

return_resolution_id.description: ID of the return resolution that created this order as a replacement. Omitted for orders a return did not create.

status.description: Whether the order still accepts changes and new payments. Refunds, fulfillment, disputes, returns, and metadata or note edits continue on a closed order.
x-enum-descriptions: You can edit the order and collect payment.
The order no longer accepts changes to what was sold or new payments; closed_reason says why.

subscription_cycle.description: Charged subscription cycle associated with this order. Signup is cycle 1; unpaid retries and skipped renewals do not advance the cycle.

subscription_delivery_changed_at.description: Time the subscriber changed delivery after this paid renewal was prepared. The order keeps its committed destination until you correct it or refund and replace it.

ticketed_event.description: Event and tickets this order sold through an event payment link. Absent on other orders.

version.description: Order version for optimistic concurrency. Send this value as the expected version when changing the order.

OrderActivity.description: Read-only order history row for merchant timeline rendering and debugging. The owning resource remains authoritative for state and money movement.

activity_type.description: The action recorded on the order. Omitted when the activity type cannot be identified. Clients must accept values added in future releases.
x-enum-descriptions: An item was added to the order.
An item on the order was changed.
An item was removed from the order.
A discount was applied to the order.
A discount was removed from the order.
A tip was requested on the order.
An additional charge was added to the order.
An additional charge on the order changed.
An additional charge was removed from the order.
The fulfillment associated with a charge changed.
The order's recorded balance or inventory exception changed.
The order was closed to further payment collection.
A payment was collected for the order.
An attempt to collect payment failed.
A refund was issued for the order.
An attempt to refund payment failed.
A checkout session was opened for the order.
A checkout session reached its expiration time.

A checkout session ends with order_paid_elsewhere when its order is paid outside the session. It ends with order_mutated when an edit closes or completes its order, or ends an invoice, return-resolution, or subscription-plan session. Other merchant edits keep checkout open. A session already past expires_at ends as expired.
Fulfillment work was created for the order.
Fulfillment work moved to another lifecycle state.

balance_delta_money.description: Change to the order balance narrated by this row. Informational rows have amount 0. Do not sum activity deltas to compute the order balance.

checkout_session_id.description: Related checkout session when activity_type points at checkout session lifecycle.

description.description: Human-readable Flint description. Provider-specific raw statuses and failure values are not exposed here.

payment_intent_id.description: Related payment intent when activity_type points at a payment attempt or payment outcome.

refund_id.description: Related refund when activity_type points at a refund outcome. Read the refund for the authoritative outcome.

running_balance_money.description: Order balance after this activity in chronological time. This is context for reading the log, not a reconciliation ledger.

OrderAuthorizationAmounts.description: The amounts authorized and still capturable on an order's payments, with the authorization expiry.

OrderCalculatedChargeTax.description: Tax settings for an order charge calculated by Flint or supplied by you, including the charge's tax category and whether it is taxable.

charge_tax_category.description: Tax category of the charge, which decides its automatic tax: shipping and delivery are taxed at the general rate, and a taxable charge in another category fails with AUTOMATIC_TAX_CHARGE_UNSUPPORTED. Omitted, the charge takes delivery from delivery_fee, shipping from shipping_fee, service_fee from service_fee, and handling from handling_fee; other types take none. The default follows type and is not returned.

OrderCalculatedLineItemTax.description: Tax settings for an order line item calculated by Flint or supplied by you, including the line item tax category and whether it is taxable.

OrderCharge.description: An additional charge applied to an order.

OrderChargeInput.description: A charge you add to an order, such as a delivery or service fee, set as a fixed amount or a percentage with its tax settings.

OrderChargeTaxAssignment.description: An externally calculated tax you assign to one order charge.

OrderDeliveryDestination.description: Where an order is delivered: the address, the recipient, and where the destination came from.

delivery_selection_id.description: Delivery selection that controls this destination, when checkout collected it.

OrderDeliveryDestinationAddress.description: The delivery address on an order.

OrderDeliveryDestinationAddressInput.description: The delivery address you supply on an order. Postal code and state are required for US addresses.

postal_code.description: Required for US addresses. Postal code when used by the destination country's postal format.

state.description: Required for US addresses. State, province, or region when used by the destination country's postal format.

OrderDeliveryDestinationInput.description: The delivery destination you set when creating or updating an order, with an address and an optional recipient.

OrderDeliveryDestinationRecipient.description: The name and phone number of the person receiving an order delivery.

OrderDeliveryDestinationRecipientInput.description: The recipient name and phone you supply for an order delivery. Send null to clear a field.

name.description: Send null to clear it.

OrderDiscount.description: A discount applied to an order, with its amount, status, and the line items and charges it covers. It comes from a manual discount or a promotion.

order_discount_id.description: Order discount ID. It starts with ad_. Pass it to POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/discounts/remove to remove the discount.

promotion_code.description: Promotion code used to create this discount. Present only when source is promotion and a code was used.

promotion_id.description: Promotion that created this discount. Present only when source is promotion.

OrderDraftLineItemInventoryDemandInput.description: The quantity of one inventory item that each unit of a draft order line item uses, supplied when creating the line item.

quantity_per_line_item_unit.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

OrderDraftLineItemTaxCalculationInput.description: A tax calculation you supply for a draft order line item, made of tax components and a price mode.

OrderDraftLineItemTaxInput.description: Tax settings you supply for a draft order line item: its tax category, whether it is taxable, and an optional tax calculation.

OrderDraftTaxComponentInput.description: One tax component of a draft line item calculation, with its jurisdiction, tax type, and percentage or flat amount.

OrderDraftTaxJurisdictionInput.description: The taxing jurisdiction of a draft tax component, identified by code, level, name, state, and country.

OrderGiftCardAllocation.description: The amount of an order that a gift card covers.

OrderGiftCardAllocationAcceptance.description: Accept the exact gift_card_estimate returned on the current order, including all selected cards and both totals. Requires an Idempotency-Key. Gift card payments collect the full amount due and may use one processor payment intent for the processor_money remainder.

order_version.description: Order version used to calculate this gift card allocation. Read the order again if its version changed.

OrderGiftCardEstimate.description: An estimate of how an order total splits between gift cards and the payment processor, and whether gift cards can pay it.

order_version.description: Order version used to calculate this gift card allocation. Read the order again if its version changed.

OrderGiftCardSelection.description: A gift card available to pay an order, with its available balance and the last four characters of its code.

last4.description: Last four characters of the card's current code.

OrderGiftCardSettlement.description: A gift card redemption applied to an order payment, with the amount, tip, and gift card.

last4.description: Last four characters of the card's current code.

OrderInventoryRoutingSourceInput.description: Where inventory for an order is allocated from: a fixed location, an allocation policy, or a specific policy revision.

OrderLineItem.description: An item purchased in an order.

fulfillment_quantities.description: Current quantities for each required fulfillment obligation: one entry for a single item or one per bundle component that requires fulfillment. Quantities use line units for single items and component units for bundles. required_quantity equals unassigned_quantity + assigned_quantity + fulfilled_quantity + canceled_quantity + failed_quantity. Omitted when the line needs no fulfillment or the order's obligations cannot be computed, including older lines without recorded requirements.

fulfillment_requirements.description: Fulfillment requirements fixed when the line item was created. direct describes a single item; components describes each bundle component. Omitted for older line items without recorded requirements.

purchased_gift_cards.description: Masked card identities for fully funded units of this purchase line. Partial consideration does not issue a card.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

refunded_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

x-enum-descriptions: Sold from a product variant, named by variant_id.
Sold from a bundle, named by bundle_id.

subscription.description: Recurring offer and cadence frozen for this line at signup.

subscription_id.description: Subscription created for this line after the order is paid.

subscription_offer.description: Applicable active offer for a one-time line, or the offer terms frozen for a subscribed line.

unit_dimensions.description: Dimensions of one unit fixed when the line was created. Omitted when unknown and for bundle lines.

unit_weight.description: Weight of one unit fixed when the line was created. Omitted when unknown and for bundle lines.

OrderLineItemFulfillmentComponent.description: Fulfillment requirements for one component of a bundle line item, with the component quantity per unit.

bundle_component_id.description: ID of the bundle component these requirements apply to.

quantity_per_line_item_unit.description: Number of this component per unit of the order line item; fractional quantities are not supported.

OrderLineItemFulfillmentProfile.description: Whether an order line item requires fulfillment, and the fulfillment types it allows.

allowed_types.description: Fulfillment types allowed for this item. Empty when fulfillment is not required.

OrderLineItemFulfillmentQuantities.description: Counts of how much of an order line item is assigned, fulfilled, failed, canceled, or still unassigned for fulfillment.

assigned_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Quantity owned by a non-terminal fulfillment, including a fulfillment on hold.

bundle_component_id.description: ID of the bundle component these quantities describe. Omitted for a single item.

canceled_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Quantity owned by canceled or no_show fulfillments.

failed_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Quantity owned by failed fulfillments that kept their quantity. Failed fulfillments that released quantity own nothing; their quantity becomes unassigned again.

fulfilled_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Quantity owned by completed fulfillments.

required_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Total quantity requiring fulfillment, in line units for a single item or component units for a bundle component. Equals the sum of the other five quantity fields.

unassigned_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Required quantity owned by no fulfillment, in any resolution mode. Includes quantity released by a failed fulfillment.

OrderLineItemFulfillmentRequirements.description: Fulfillment requirements for an order line item, given for a single item or for each component of a bundle.

components.description: Fulfillment requirements for each bundle component. Present for bundle lines.

direct.description: Fulfillment requirements for a single item. Present for non-bundle lines.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state. Package states are the source used to derive shipment status.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.
