post.description: Starts or resumes a payment attempt on the order. Set action to pay to charge the full outstanding balance, confirm_payment_intents to confirm order-owned payment intents, setup to save a newly collected token on a zero-balance order, or resume to continue an attempt after a pending client action. Each action accepts only its own fields. Only confirm_payment_intents accepts completion_behavior. A pay action without payment_source is valid only when the outstanding balance is zero. To continue a resumable attempt, send action: resume with order_payment_attempt_id and a new Idempotency-Key. An exact retry of the original request with its Idempotency-Key returns the stored response if the request completed, or recovers the same attempt if it was interrupted. Payment intents with manual capture return an active authorization instead of settling immediately. A replay preserves the original HTTP status and domain result. Client authority in order_payment_attempt.pending_actions is available only within 24 hours of the original request and while the matching current payment attempt has status requires_action. Otherwise pending_actions is empty. Read GET /v1/orders/{order_id}/payment-attempts/{order_payment_attempt_id} for the attempt's current state.

Send email to choose a recipient, or omit it to use the order's email. Requires Flint-managed receipt delivery. Sending is limited to once every five minutes per order and normalized recipient. Checkout credentials can send only to the address on file. If no address is on file, checkout credentials can send to at most three distinct addresses over the order's lifetime. Receipts sent for this order through this route count toward this limit, including failed deliveries and receipts sent with a secret API key. Merchant callers can choose any address.

patch.description: Updates non-lifecycle package fields such as carrier, tracking, expected_delivery_at, label access, measurements, metadata, and caller-owned external references. Descriptive fields can be corrected until the package is voided, regardless of shipment or fulfillment status. Corrections never email the buyer. Package status cannot be patched directly. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

post.description: Performs one action from the package's supported_actions. mark_shipped accepts carrier, service_code, tracking_number, and tracking_url; present fields replace tracking before the status change and shipped email in one transaction. Omitted tracking is unchanged and null is invalid. Other actions reject tracking fields. mark_shipped, mark_in_transit, and mark_out_for_delivery optionally set expected_delivery_at; send null to clear it. Delivery preserves the estimate as history. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Filter by order ID.
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.description: Filter by customer ID.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: Filter by invoice ID.
parameters.name: invoice_id

parameters.description: Filter by whether the merchant must capture the payment or respond to a dispute. A dispute requires action when its status is needs_response or inquiry_needs_response, evidence responses are allowed, and its deadline is absent or has not passed. Omit to include both groups.
parameters.name: is_action_required

parameters.description: Filter by payment intent status. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. The payment_intent.updated event reports changes into this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. The confirm result's current_payment_action describes a standalone payment's step; call confirm with an empty body to retrieve it again. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.
A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent.

parameters.description: Filter by the latest completed risk assessment. Repeat or comma-separate values. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: risk_level

x-enum-descriptions: The card processor's fraud screening found nothing unusual.
The screening found signs of higher fraud risk.
The screening found strong signs of fraud.
No screening result, for example because Flint blocked the payment before authorization or the payment method isn't screened.

parameters.name: payment_flow

parameters.name: return_resolution_id

parameters.name: query

patch.description: Applies a sparse update while status is requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, or requires_capture. In processing, succeeded, canceled, or expired it returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress or terminal_status, with the status in error.details[].current_status. amount_money can change only while status is requires_payment_method and before the first confirmation attempt; after that, create a new payment intent. customer_id can change only while status is requires_payment_method, and receipt_email only while it is requires_payment_method or requires_confirmation. Send null to clear tip_money, external_reference_id, receipt_email, or all metadata; amount_money and customer_id cannot be cleared. Order-owned intents accept only metadata and external_reference_id; amount_money, tip_money, customer_id, and receipt_email return INVALID_REQUEST with one NOT_ALLOWED detail per field. This route doesn't attach a payment source: send the buyer's credential to the confirm route.

post.description: Cancels a standalone or order-owned payment intent. Read supported_actions for the actions its stored state accepts. Canceling a hold moves all of capturable_money to released_money, and nothing is charged. A processing payment intent returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress; refund a succeeded one instead. Flint derives the owning order payment attempt. A leg held by an active order payment attempt may be refused. Omitted cancellation_reason stays absent. A fresh request for a canceled or expired payment returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; a same-key retry replays or recovers its original result. A checkout credential can cancel only its own order leg, with requested_by_customer or abandoned when a reason is supplied.

post.description: Captures a standalone or order-owned payment intent in requires_capture. Omit amount_money to capture all of capturable_money, or send a smaller amount for a partial capture. Flint releases the uncaptured remainder in the same request, and a payment intent can be captured only once. amount_money on the payment intent keeps the requested amount; captured_money and released_money record the result. Affirm payments can only be captured in full. Flint derives the owning order payment attempt; order_payment_attempt_id is not accepted. An expired authorization is refreshed before capture and refused with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status or authorization_expired. A fresh request for an already captured payment returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; a same-key retry replays or recovers its original result.

post.description: Confirms a standalone payment intent. For the first confirmation, send exactly one of stripe.confirmation_token, payment_source_token, or payment_method_id; without one, it returns FIELD_REQUIRED. After the buyer completes current_payment_action, call this route again with no body or {} to continue the same payment attempt. Flint confirms again only if the processor still requires it, and otherwise returns the current payment intent. Unverified fee fields are omitted. current_payment_action is null when no buyer action is needed. It can also be null while status is requires_action if Flint cannot produce the action yet; call confirm again with an empty body. Order-owned payment intents return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason order_owned and supported_actions; pay them through POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay using remediation.next_actions.

post.description: Queues a receipt for a succeeded payment intent and returns the payment intent unchanged. For an order-owned payment intent, sends the order receipt. Once sent, the receipt appears as a receipt_sent payment intent activity. Send email to choose a recipient. Omit email to use the order's receipt address for an order-owned intent, or receipt_email then the customer's email for a standalone intent. The saved receipt email stays unchanged. Requires Flint-managed receipt delivery. Standalone sending is limited to once every five minutes per payment intent; order receipt sending is limited to once every five minutes per order and normalized recipient. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key to replay the result without sending again.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payment links for the authenticated merchant.

parameters.description: Page size, default 20, max 100.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Cursor returned by the previous list response.
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.description: Filter by payment link status. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the caller-owned external reference ID.
parameters.name: external_reference_id

parameters.description: Search across payment link ID, external reference ID, name, and description. Text fields match any part of the value, and %, _ and \ are ordinary characters, not wildcards. IDs match from the start and need the type prefix, such as pl_01.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Filter by payment link type. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: payment_link_type

parameters.description: Filter by whether the payment link references a subscription plan.
parameters.name: has_subscription_plan

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to created_at; ties are broken by payment_link_id.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc.
parameters.name: sort_direction

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on updated_at.
parameters.name: updated_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on updated_at.
parameters.name: updated_before

parameters.description: Supported expansions: sales_summary, subscription_plan. Include the requested related resources using scoped batch reads for this page. Each relationship requires its existing target read scopes. Expansion changes the representation without changing pagination tokens. Limits: at most 10 unique expand paths per request; path depth at most 2. Repeat expand, for example expand=sales_summary&expand=subscription_plan, or pass one comma-separated value.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: API version for this request. Overrides merchant and partner app defaults.
parameters.name: Flint-Version

parameters.description: Your own ID for this request, such as a log or trace ID, 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters. Flint stores it as client_request_id on the request log. The X-Request-Id response header is Flint's request ID, not this value.
parameters.name: X-Request-Id

expanded.summary: Payment link with expanded subscription plan

expanded_sales_summary.summary: Payment link with expanded sales summary

get.description: Lists payment methods in every status except archived, newest first. Filter by status=active for the cards you can charge. Optionally filter to a customer. Filter by usage off_session to list the payment methods a subscription, automatic invoice, or default payment method can use.

parameters.description: Optional Flint customer ID filter.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: Page size, default 20, max 100.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Cursor returned by the previous list response.
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.description: Filter by payment method type. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Filter by status. Repeat the parameter or send comma-separated values to match any of several. Omitted, the list leaves out archived rows; name archived to include them. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter by usage: off_session payment methods can be charged without the buyer; on_session ones were saved by buyers for faster checkout. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: usage

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Supported expansions: customer. Include the requested related resources using scoped batch reads for this page. Each relationship requires its existing target read scopes. Expansion changes the representation without changing pagination tokens. Limits: at most 10 unique expand paths per request; path depth at most 2. Pass expand=customer.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: API version for this request. Overrides merchant and partner app defaults.
parameters.name: Flint-Version

parameters.description: Your own ID for this request, such as a log or trace ID, 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters. Flint stores it as client_request_id on the request log. The X-Request-Id response header is Flint's request ID, not this value.
parameters.name: X-Request-Id

post.description: Declines the payment and closes the review with `closed_reason: declined`. Flint cancels an uncaptured authorization, or refunds the remaining captured amount (captured minus earlier refunds) to the original payment method with reason `fraudulent`. Returns `200` when the review is closed, or when the refund already failed and the review is `open` again with `last_resolution_failure` set. Returns `202` while the refund is processing; wait for `payment_review.closed` or `payment_review.reopened`.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payouts with optional filters for status, currency, destination, method, and timing.

parameters.description: Filter by the original Idempotency-Key, after trimming surrounding whitespace. Matching is exact and case-sensitive. Returns current authorized resources, not the recorded response. A pending resource does not prove that the operation succeeded, and an empty list does not prove that it had no effect.
parameters.name: idempotency_key

parameters.description: Optional 3-letter currency filter.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Supported expansions: original_payout, payout_destination, reversed_by_payout. Include the requested related resources using scoped batch reads for this page. Each relationship requires its existing target read scopes. Expansion changes the representation without changing pagination tokens. Limits: at most 10 unique expand paths per request; path depth at most 2. Repeat expand, for example expand=original_payout&expand=payout_destination, or pass one comma-separated value.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: Optional payout method filter. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Optional Flint balance source type filter. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: balance_source_type

parameters.description: Optional payout destination ID filter.
parameters.name: payout_destination_id

parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the caller-owned external reference ID.
parameters.name: external_reference_id

parameters.description: Search across payout ID, external reference ID, description, and statement descriptor. Text fields match any part of the value, and %, _ and \ are ordinary characters, not wildcards. IDs match from the start and need the type prefix, such as po_01.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Optional payout status filter. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Filter by product type. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.description: Filter by status. Repeat the parameter or send comma-separated values to match any of several. Omitted, the list leaves out archived rows; name archived to include them. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter by category handle.
parameters.name: category_handle

parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the caller-owned external reference ID.
parameters.name: external_reference_id

parameters.description: Full-value match on ProductVariant.sku, case- and accent-insensitive, with no trimming. All exact variant filters must match the same non-archived variant, including inactive variants. matched_variant is the first matching variant by position, then variant_id; exact predicates take precedence over query for this witness.
parameters.name: sku

parameters.description: Byte-sensitive whole-value match on ProductVariant.external_reference_id, preserving whitespace, casing, and Unicode. All exact variant filters must match the same non-archived variant. matched_variant is one deterministic witness; page the nested variant list to enumerate all matches.
parameters.name: variant_external_reference_id

parameters.description: Exact match on ProductVariant.inventory_item_id. Multiple variants may share one inventory item; this does not match or synchronize the inventory item's SKU. On products, all exact variant filters must match the same non-archived variant.
parameters.name: inventory_item_id

parameters.description: Search across product ID, external reference ID, name, description, and SKU. Text fields match any part of the value, and %, _ and \ are ordinary characters, not wildcards. IDs match from the start and need the type prefix, such as prod_01.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Filter products with at least one non-deleted variant assigned to this delivery profile.

parameters.description: Search across variant ID, external reference ID, name, SKU, and barcode. Text fields match any part of the value, and %, _ and \ are ordinary characters, not wildcards. IDs match from the start and need the type prefix, such as var_01.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to position; ties are broken by variant_id.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to asc for position and desc for other sort fields.
parameters.name: sort_direction

parameters.description: Filter by assigned delivery profile ID.

parameters.description: Filter by delivery readiness. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of promotion codes in every status, ordered by created_at descending, then promotion_code_id descending. Archived codes are excluded unless status=archived.

parameters.description: Exact match on the parent promotion ID.
parameters.name: promotion_id

parameters.description: Exact match that ignores case and accents: CAFÉ matches cafe. This is the same rule that makes promotion codes unique. Codes preserve their original spelling. Leading and trailing whitespace are rejected, not trimmed.
parameters.name: code

parameters.description: Filter by status. Repeat the parameter or send comma-separated values to match any of several. Omitted, the list leaves out archived rows; name archived to include them. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter by whether a code can be redeemed now or why it cannot. available matches available: true; every other value matches unavailable_reason. Values are ORed and ANDed with status. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: availability

parameters.description: Page size, default 20, max 100.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Cursor returned by the previous list response.
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to created_at; ties are broken by promotion_code_id.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc.
parameters.name: sort_direction

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on updated_at.
parameters.name: updated_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on updated_at.
parameters.name: updated_before

parameters.description: Supported expansions: promotion. Expand each code's parent promotion. Expansion requires commerce.promotions.read. Limits: at most 10 unique expand paths per request; path depth at most 2. Pass expand=promotion.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: API version for this request. Overrides merchant and partner app defaults.
parameters.name: Flint-Version

parameters.description: Your own ID for this request, such as a log or trace ID, 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters. Flint stores it as client_request_id on the request log. The X-Request-Id response header is Flint's request ID, not this value.
parameters.name: X-Request-Id

parameters.description: Filter by status. Repeat the parameter or send comma-separated values to match any of several. Omitted, the list leaves out archived rows; name archived to include them. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter by whether a promotion can apply now or why it cannot. available matches available: true; every other value matches unavailable_reason. Repeat the parameter or pass comma-separated values; values are ORed. This filter is ANDed with status. Archived promotions still require status=archived. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: availability

parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the caller-owned external reference ID.
parameters.name: external_reference_id

parameters.description: Search across promotion ID, external reference ID, name, display name, description, and promotion codes. Text fields match any part of the value, and %, _ and \ are ordinary characters, not wildcards. IDs match from the start and need the type prefix, such as promo_01.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Filter to promotions with an explicit product target rule. Universal promotions are not included by catalog target filters.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: Filter to promotions with an explicit variant target rule. Universal promotions are not included by catalog target filters.
parameters.name: variant_id

parameters.description: Filter to promotions with an explicit bundle target rule. Universal promotions are not included by catalog target filters.
parameters.name: bundle_id

parameters.description: Filter to promotions with an explicit category target rule. Universal promotions are not included by catalog target filters.
parameters.name: category_handle

parameters.description: Filter by promotion redemption type. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: redemption_type

parameters.description: Filter by promotion discount class. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: discount_class

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to created_at; ties are broken by promotion_id.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc.
parameters.name: sort_direction

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on updated_at.

parameters.description: Filter by the original Idempotency-Key, after trimming surrounding whitespace. Matching is exact and case-sensitive. Returns current authorized resources, not the recorded response. A pending resource does not prove that the operation succeeded, and an empty list does not prove that it had no effect.
parameters.name: idempotency_key

parameters.description: Page size, default 20, max 100.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Cursor returned by the previous list response.
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.description: Filter by order ID.
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.description: Filter by payment intent ID.
parameters.name: payment_intent_id

parameters.description: Filter by customer ID.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: Filter by refund status. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: status

x-enum-descriptions: At least one payment refund or tender allocation is still in progress.
Every payment refund and tender allocation succeeded. Can still become partially_succeeded or failed after a bank rejection.
Some payment refunds or tender allocations succeeded and the rest failed or were canceled. failure_reason is payment_refund_failed. Can still become failed.
No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again.

parameters.description: Filter by refund reasons. Accepts comma-separated values or repeated parameters; empty entries are rejected. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. Values are trimmed and deduplicated in first-seen order; empty or unknown entries are rejected. Values within this filter are ORed; separate filters are ANDed.
parameters.name: reason

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on amount_money.amount. Requires currency.
parameters.name: min_amount

parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on amount_money.amount. Requires currency.
parameters.name: max_amount

parameters.description: Exact parent refund amount_money.currency filter, with or without amount bounds. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed and letters are uppercased. Amount bounds require currency.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the caller-owned external reference ID.
parameters.name: external_reference_id

parameters.description: Filter by linked Return ID.
parameters.name: return_id

parameters.description: Filter by linked ReturnResolution ID.
parameters.name: return_resolution_id

parameters.description: Search across refund_id, external_reference_id, and reason_message. Text fields match any part of the value, and %, _ and \ are ordinary characters, not wildcards. IDs match from the start and need the type prefix, such as ord_01.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to created_at; ties are broken by refund_id.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc.
parameters.name: sort_direction

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on updated_at.
parameters.name: updated_after

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on updated_at.
parameters.name: updated_before

parameters.description: Supported expansions: customer, order, payment_intent. Include the requested related resources using scoped batch reads for this page. Each relationship requires its existing target read scopes. Expansion changes the representation without changing pagination tokens. Limits: at most 10 unique expand paths per request; path depth at most 2. Repeat expand, for example expand=customer&expand=order, or pass one comma-separated value.
parameters.name: expand

post.description: Create or reuse a hosted or embedded checkout session for the buyer's balance on a replacement order linked to this return resolution. Returns 200 when reusing an existing session and 201 when creating one. Omit surface to use hosted. The same surface reuses the open session; changing surface replaces an idle session and is refused while a payment is in progress. Use redirects to set where the buyer goes after paying or canceling. The return_url field is an alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on embedded checkout and must be an address of the merchant's customer account. A reused session takes a new success destination only until a payment starts, then keeps its existing destination.

post.description: Retry a failed resolution. For gift_card_refund_destination_required, send gift_card_refund_destination: new_gift_card to persist the destination before starting the new attempt. The override is accepted for refund, exchange, and corrections of resolutions other than store_credit. A new attempt starts, historical payment and refund IDs stay on the resolution, and a late event from an earlier attempt cannot settle the new attempt. Fails with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, with the line's current_status, when a Return line the resolution covers is no longer approved, such as after it was canceled, and with RETURN_VALUE_EXCEEDED when an approved line no longer has the quantity the resolution covers. Retry is available only when failure_code allows it, and supported_actions includes retry in that case. A failure that retry cannot fix returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED; cancel the resolution instead.

post.description: Creates the link Flint's email about a Return carries, to put in buyer email or messages you send yourself. It opens the Return and its order in your Flint-hosted customer account without a sign-in. Withdrawing the Return needs the buyer to sign in. It works for 30 days or 10 opens, whichever comes first; after that the buyer signs in to see the Return. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same Idempotency-Key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. When customer_account.mode is merchant_hosted it returns ACCESS_LINK_MERCHANT_HOSTED, and for a Return whose order has no customer, ACCESS_LINK_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED. Send no request body or an empty object ({}). Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this resource's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its opens. Without an Idempotency-Key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with X-Request-Id before sending a new request.

post.description: Record one decision for every requested line atomically, then open the Return. To defer a line, decline its quantity or remove it with DELETE /v1/returns/{return_id}/line-items/{return_line_item_id} and open a separate Return for it. Omit completion_mode to use the shared pinned policy mode, or automatic when none sets a mode; disagreeing policies require an explicit completion_mode. completion_blockers reports uncovered approved quantity as resolution_not_selected alongside blockers for unfinished resolutions. Start from each buildable pinned policy proposal or the no-policy defaults, replace every supplied decision field, fill release_timing, and validate the result. When an automatic refund can no longer run through the original payment's provider, the request fails with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED; send automatic_resolution_type as null to resolve manually, or choose no_monetary_action.

post.description: Record decisions, receipts, inspections, dispositions, and resolutions for an existing requested or open Return in one request. On a requested Return, send one decision for every requested line; missing decisions return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason status_not_reached. Omit completion_mode to use the shared pinned policy mode, or automatic when none sets a mode; disagreeing policies require an explicit completion_mode. On an open Return, omit decision and completion_mode to keep committed values, or send those values unchanged; changed values return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason field_locked. completion_blockers includes resolution_not_selected for any uncovered approved quantity alongside blockers for unfinished resolutions. Refunds, payments, replacement orders, and inventory updates complete asynchronously. expected_version is optional and checked only when sent. If the Return has changed since that version, the request fails with VERSION_CONFLICT. When an automatic refund can no longer run through the original payment's provider, the request fails with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED; send automatic_resolution_type as null to resolve manually, or choose no_monetary_action. Requires Idempotency-Key and all three scopes: commerce.returns.write, commerce.returns.operations.write, and commerce.returns.resolutions.write.

post.description: Estimates the next renewal or a plan change, or evaluates a proposed subscription, delivery destination, or delivery method update without saving changes. next_renewal returns current recurring promotions, shipping, and tax for the next charged cycle. plan_change uses the same checks and pricing as change-plan, including unused paid item credit for billing_starts now. Tax is null when no tax address is available; a tax service failure returns 502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR. Malformed JSON, unknown fields and request-level problems (a missing or unsupported mode, fields that belong to another mode) return 400. In create mode, every problem with the proposed subscription is returned in errors with is_valid false, not only the first. A preview does not reserve inventory or guarantee a future shipping rate.

parameters.description: Filter by the subscription's selected delivery method.

parameters.description: Filter by the reason of the current delivery_hold. Does not match upcoming delivery issues. Accepts repeated keys, comma-separated values, or mixtures. parameters.description: Filter by Flint subscription plan ID.

parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the caller-owned external reference ID.

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to created_at; ties are broken by subscription_id.

parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc.

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at.

parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: True matches subscriptions with a delivery hold, an upcoming delivery hold, an inventory wait, or a delivery-action-required pause, plus past_due subscriptions and active or incomplete subscriptions whose billing date passed more than 24 hours ago without payment. post.description: Creates a link to one subscription in your Flint-hosted customer account, to put in buyer email or messages you send yourself. Omit purpose or send subscription_view for read-only access without a sign-in. Send subscription_manage to also let the buyer cancel, pause, or undo a scheduled cancellation, subject to your store's policy and the subscription's state. subscription_manage requires commerce.subscriptions.write; subscription_view requires commerce.subscriptions.read. Neither purpose permits other subscription changes or access to another subscription. Both work for 14 days or 5 opens, whichever comes first; after that the buyer signs in. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same Idempotency-Key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. When customer_account.mode is merchant_hosted it returns ACCESS_LINK_MERCHANT_HOSTED. Send no request body, an empty object ({}), or an optional purpose. Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this resource's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its opens. Without an Idempotency-Key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with X-Request-Id before sending a new request.

post.description: Cancels a subscription and records who asked, why, and when in cancellation_details. With cancel_immediately: true it ends now. Otherwise, trialing ends at trial_end_at, active at current_period_end_at (or now when a renewal delivery hold has expired), and past_due at next_retry_at instead of that retry. Scheduled, incomplete, paused, and past_due without next_retry_at require cancel_immediately: true or return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason period_end_unavailable. Read scheduled_cancel_at for the scheduled end time. A buyer's cancellation follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

post.description: Replaces the subscription's lines and recurring options with the active target plan's current terms. With billing_starts next_renewal, changes terms now without charging and keeps the current period and next billing date. With billing_starts now, charges a new period and credits unused paid item time after promotions; the plan changes only when payment succeeds. If the credit exceeds the new item charge, choose next_renewal. Omit interval and quantity to keep their current values; the target plan must offer them. Contract terms and existing recurring promotions are preserved. Requires Idempotency-Key; retry with the same key to recover the same result. Returns status 200 for a decline, with a closed unpaid order, failed order_payment_attempt, and unchanged subscription. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error and update the subscription payment method before trying again. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. After a confirmed CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION with billing_starts now, refresh the subscription and send a new Idempotency-Key. The buyer account cannot change plans.

post.description: Charges the next renewal now, ships it when the subscription has delivery, and moves the next billing date forward by one interval. Available while the subscription is active on a Flint-owned billing schedule (billing_schedule_owner is flint), is not set to cancel at the end of its period, is not in a trial, and has no delivery hold or renewal in progress. The subscription's payment method must be active and allow off-session charges. Requires Idempotency-Key; retry with the same key to recover the same attempt. Returns the subscription, renewal order, and payment attempt with status 200, including when the payment is declined. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error for a failed payment.

post.description: Asks Flint to resume a paused subscription. Returns 202 while the subscription is still paused, with resume_requested_at set. Flint then makes it active, or past_due while an overdue period is collected, and sends subscription.resumed. If Flint can't resume it, it stays paused, resume_requested_at clears, and Flint sends subscription.updated. Any other status fails with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED. To undo a scheduled cancellation, use reactivate.

x-enum-descriptions: The merchant's available or pending balance changed.
A new balance transaction (charge, refund, dispute, payout, fee, merchant billing collection, or adjustment) was recorded.

A bundle's own fields, images, categories, modifier set or components changed. Copied category names and handles, component variant summaries and delivery readiness send no bundle events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A category was deleted. It can no longer be retrieved.
A category was updated. Assigned product and bundle counts and targeting_reference_count send no category events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A hosted checkout session was closed before payment completed.
A hosted checkout session was created.

A checkout session was invalidated because its order closed or was paid elsewhere, an invoice, return-resolution, or subscription-plan change ended it, or a replacement session superseded it. Other order edits keep hosted and embedded sessions open and do not send this event.
A hosted checkout session became paid.
A hosted checkout session became partially paid.
A draft credit note was created.
A draft credit note was updated.
A credit note amount was allocated to its invoice.
A credit note allocation was reversed.
A customer's personal data was erased and its status is now deleted.
A customer deletion request completed and the customer was anonymized.
A buyer requested deletion of their customer account data.
A customer deletion request failed and can be retried.
A customer deletion request entered processing.
A customer deletion request was rejected.
A delivery location set was activated.
A delivery location set was archived.
A delivery location set was created.
A delivery location set was deactivated.
A delivery location set configuration changed.
A delivery rate callback was activated.
A delivery rate callback was archived.
A delivery rate callback was created.
A delivery rate callback was deactivated.
A delivery rate callback configuration changed.
An emergency delivery dependency revocation was created with a safe estimated impact.
A delivery selection became the order's committed fulfillment economics.
First observation of a dispute, in any status.
The inquiry closed without becoming a chargeback.
The dispute status first became lost.
The status entered needs_response or inquiry_needs_response and a response is allowed. This includes inquiry escalation.
The dispute status first became prevented.
Another change to the public dispute representation, including a move to other. Sent only when no condition event applies.
The dispute status first became won.
A merchant environment was granted to a partner app install.
A merchant environment grant was revoked from a partner app install.
An early fraud warning was reported for a payment.
An early fraud warning changed actionability or dispute linkage.
A fulfillment completed: every quantity it covers was fulfilled or canceled.
A fulfillment was created, by checkout or by your call.
A fulfillment's status or details changed, such as its recipient, schedule, or metadata. Terminal status changes send their own events.
A fulfillment event was recorded from a carrier, pickup flow, appointment system, or other fulfillment source.
A gift card was issued. The masked resource includes its posted, reserved and available value.
A gift card balance, reservation, lifecycle, credential or descriptive association changed.
A gift card funding lot was recorded with face value and consideration provenance.
A gift card funding lot's remaining value or risk restriction changed.
A gift card recipient notification was created. The snapshot includes its recipient, status and version.
A gift card recipient notification's delivery status changed. Retrieve the notification for current delivery history.
An exact gift card redemption was reserved or captured.
A gift card redemption was captured, released, expired or refunded.
An immutable gift card financial movement was posted. Corrections create new transactions.
An inventory count was applied and its variances were committed to inventory.
An inventory level has more protected claims than sellable physical stock.
Returned units were received into Inventory, from a Return disposition or against the reservation line that consumed them.
An inventory claim requires a safe merchant action before commerce can continue.
A held or committed inventory claim became insufficiently protected.
An inventory reservation has no active held or committed quantity.
Held inventory quantity became committed order inventory.
An inventory reservation was created with exact location assignments.
A merchant-owned inventory hold reached its deadline.
Held or committed inventory quantity was released.
An inventory transfer reached a terminal state.
Inventory in transit was recorded as lost.
Inventory was received at a transfer's destination.
Inventory in transit was returned to its origin.
Stock returned for a blocked subscription renewal invoice. Flint voids the invoice and charges the renewal on its order.
Collection on a subscription renewal invoice is blocked because the renewal could not get stock.
An invoice balance closed with positive applied credit and no positive net collection.
A scheduled invoice could not be issued and remains a draft.
An invoice was issued and became open for collection.
A late fee was added to an invoice balance.
An invoice reached a configured late fee date.
The unpaid remainder of an invoice late fee was waived.
An invoice's outstanding balance was written off as uncollectible.
An invoice passed its payment due date with an outstanding balance.
An invoice balance closed with positive net collection. Collection, allocated credit, waived fees, or reversal recovery can clear the balance.
An invoice became partially paid or received another collection while a balance remained. Sent for online, gift card, and manual payments.
Part of an invoice's payment was refunded.
An invoice's payment was fully refunded.
An invoice reminder is ready to send.
An invoice balance reopened after a payment or credit allocation was reversed. The invoice is open or partially paid.
An invoice was sent to the customer.
An invoice draft, schedule, reminder settings, refund state, or other non-status detail was updated.
An invoice was voided and can no longer be paid.
An invoice email delivery attempt failed.
An invoice email delivery attempt was suppressed.
A manual (offline) payment was recorded against an invoice.
A manual payment was reversed and its amount returned to the invoice balance.
An invoice payment attempt was canceled.
An invoice payment attempt entered processing.
An invoice payment attempt settled successfully. The payment may cover all or part of the invoice balance.
A merchant's payment, payout, or onboarding readiness was observed in live or sandbox mode.
The merchant profile, status, API version, logo, or icon changed.
The amount the merchant owes Flint or owns as account credit changed.
Flint issued a merchant billing invoice.
A merchant billing invoice changed status.
A modifier group's own fields or modifiers changed. Owned collections are included in this object. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A modifier set's own fields, groups or inline modifiers changed. Owned collections are included in this object. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
An open order closed. closed_reason says why: paid, closed_by_merchant, checkout_expired, written_off, superseded, or return_resolution_canceled.
An order has an inventory failure that requires operator action.
An order inventory exception was resolved.
An order became fully paid, including by a manual payment on its invoice. Use payment_intent.succeeded for each successful online payment.
An order first became partially paid, including by a manual payment on its invoice. Use payment_intent.succeeded for each successful online payment.
A shipment package changed, including status, details, or contents. List the package items to read its contents.
A partner app install was created.
An environment grant's permissions changed: the merchant re-authorized, or you removed or narrowed a permission.
The install was revoked by the merchant or by you. revoked_by says which.
A payment intent authorization expired before capture.
A payment intent fulfillment hold was activated or released.
A payment was submitted and is awaiting its final outcome.
The payment requires a customer action such as 3D Secure authentication.
The payment was authorized and is awaiting capture.
A payment intent changed without entering a more specific lifecycle status.
A payment link changed, including being activated or deactivated. Sales through the link don't send this event.
A payment method became active and can be charged.
A saved payment method was deleted. It stays readable and can't be charged again.
A payment review was resolved or closed by a payment lifecycle change.
A payment was placed into manual review.
A declined review's refund failed, so the review is open again and needs a decision.
A payout to the merchant's bank was canceled.
A payout to the merchant's bank was created.
A payout failed and funds were returned to the balance.
A payout arrived at the merchant's bank.
A payout destination was removed. It stays readable by ID with status archived.
A payout destination (bank account) was added.
The merchant's payout schedule or settings changed.
A product was archived. Its variants were archived with it and send no events of their own.
A product was created. Each variant it created sends product_variant.created.

A product's own fields, options, images, categories or modifier set changed. Variant changes send product_variant events instead, although they also change the product's rollups and version. Rollups (default_variant, price_range, active_variant_count, variant_count, available_for_sale and delivery_configuration_status) and copied category names and handles send no product events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A variant was archived on its own. Archiving its product sends only product.archived.

A product variant was updated. Copied selected option names and values, available_for_sale, effective_images and delivery readiness send no variant events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A promotion was archived. Its codes were archived with it and send no events of their own.
A promotion was created. Each code it created sends promotion_code.created.

A promotion was updated. Changes to codes_summary, uses_count, available and unavailable_reason, including redemptions and schedule boundaries, send no promotion events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A promotion code was archived on its own. Archiving its promotion sends only promotion.archived.

A promotion code was updated. Changes to uses_count, available and unavailable_reason, including redemptions and schedule boundaries, send no promotion code events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A refund changed without entering a more specific lifecycle status.
An asynchronous report reached a terminal generation failure.
An asynchronous report completed and its authenticated CSV download is ready.
A Return completed after every required merchandise and buyer-value obligation cleared.
The merchant or policy automation recorded line-level Return decisions.
A completed Return was reopened for additional work.
A Return or one of its line-level progress projections changed.
A merchandise disposition was recorded for a Return.
A Return disposition changed execution state.
Acceptance was decided for a Return inspection observation.
A Return inspection observation was recorded.
A Return inspection observation was superseded by an auditable correction.
A Return receipt observation was recorded.
A Return receipt observation was superseded by an auditable correction.
An unmatched Return receipt line was verified against the expected merchandise.
A proposed buyer-value resolution was created for a Return.
A Return resolution changed proposal, gate, effect, or fulfillment state.
A shipment changed, including status, details, or package count.
A subscription's first paid period was collected, or it was created already paid or imported, so it is active. Sent once per subscription.
A subscription was set to cancel at the end of its billing period.
A subscription billing cycle was skipped without a charge.
A subscription renewal needs an address, method, or rate correction before it can be charged.
A subscription delivery hold is approaching its pause date.
A subscription's delivery preference changed. Paid, unshipped renewals keep their existing destination.
A subscription used its automatic payment retry budget.
A subscription renewal failed and is past due.
A subscription moved to another plan, or to its plan's current lines and prices. When the change bills a new period, subscription.payment_succeeded is sent with it.
A subscription's scheduled cancellation was undone, so it renews as usual.
A subscription trial is approaching its end.
A subscription changed and no more specific subscription event describes the change.
A subscription delivery method migration finished. Its counts and failures identify which subscriptions moved.
A subscription payment retry was created.

get.description: Streams canonical merchant webhook events created after the connection opens or after the supplied event ID. SSE event IDs are resumable webhook event IDs. Control records include ready, gap, withheld, and disconnect. Gap records indicate cursor_unavailable or payload_expired; withheld records hide payloads the caller cannot read. Backpressure emits disconnect with reason backpressure and resume_cursor identifying the last sent event, so clients can reconnect without losing events.

releases.overview: Balance transactions report fees as positive charges that match the payment's `processing_fee_money`, name their timestamp `occurred_at`, and identify the related resource by its own ID field. Tax categories split into `line_item_tax_category` for items and `charge_tax_category` for charges, so the field name tells you which set of values applies.

changes.summary: Balance transaction fee charges are positive and fee credits are negative.
changes.action: Read a positive `fee_money` as a fee charged and a negative one as a fee returned. `net_money` is unchanged.

changes.summary: Balance transaction relationships use resource-specific IDs.
Balance transactions use occurred_at for the transaction timestamp.
Tax categories use line_item_tax_category for items and charge_tax_category for charges.
changes.action: Replace `tax_category` with `line_item_tax_category` on product variants, modifiers, bundles, and line item taxes, and with `charge_tax_category` on delivery methods and charge taxes.
